reviewList.text:
Such a lovely spa experience! I was in da nang for three days and ended up coming here twice because I enjoyed it so much. 😂

I tried the 2-hour four-hand massage and it was honestly so relaxing. The massage was great, the staff were friendly, and they were also having a discount, so the value for money was really good.

Another unexpected highlight: they have two super cute little dogs at the spa! 🐶🐶 They were absolutely adorable and made the whole place feel even more welcoming.

And here’s the best part ：if you book a full 2-hour treatment, they provide free pickup! My friend and I were picked up in a clean and comfortable car with a really friendly driver and taken to Hoi An. After a 2-hour massage, not having to worry about transport was such a nice touch.

Honestly, for the price, service, massage and free pickup, I think this place is fantastic value. Would definitely recommend it if you’re visiting da nang，and I’d happily come back again! ❤️

At the second branch, Min was especially helpful. He made sure to understand our massage pressure and preferences and was very attentive throughout. Our therapists, Thuy (massage) and Lieu (hair spa), were professional and checked in with us to make sure everything was comfortable. In both branches, they immediately serve you refreshment drinks even without any booked services yet.

The only small suggestion for the massage would be to give a heads-up before turning or moving the client, rather than doing it unexpectedly.

We also loved the little touches afterward — calming tea, snacks, another serving of their delicious artichoke drink when we asked, and even bottled water to take home.

Overall, a wonderful experience! We’ll definitely visit again when we’re back in Da Nang and would happily recommend this spa to friends.

reviewList.text:
A deeply healing and memorable massage experience 🐉✨ I had bookmarked Dragon Spa when I first arrived in Vietnam because I’m naturally very drawn to dragons- I was born in the Year of the Dragon, dragons are the symbol of my own business, and they’ve always held special meaning in my life. So when I found myself walking along the beach and felt the pull to get a massage, I checked my saved places and noticed Dragon Spa was just down the street so I decided to walk over.

The owner was very warm and welcoming. While I waited, I was offered tea and a herbal foot soak. At first the water felt quite hot, but the owner gently encouraged me to let my feet adjust, explaining that the warmth was good for my body - and he was right! After a few moments, it became incredibly soothing, and it was actually lovely to sit and relax into it. 🍵

My massage therapist was truly exceptional. I’ve had massages all over the world, and you can immediately tell when someone is deeply skilled. She released tension I didn’t even realize I was carrying, and gently cracked and aligned different areas of my body, which left me feeling physically lighter and more open. I’ve recently gone through a difficult heartbreak, and as she worked on my shoulders, I felt emotions and old memories releasing in a way that was both gentle and deeply healing.

The spa itself is very clean, peaceful, and calming. After my session, I was offered tea again, and I left feeling relaxed, renewed, and genuinely cared for.

I feel very aligned with the energy of this place and will absolutely be returning when I’m back in this beach area. 🙏🐉

reviewList.text:

I was truly able to relax here.

reviewList.text: From booking the appointment with the receptionists to the massage and facial, my experience here was wonderful - a chef’s kiss to my first trip to Vietnam. reviewList.text:
I had an absolutely outstanding experience at Annona Spa, located inside the Prince Hotel at 92 Vo Nguyen Giap. The spa is set in a beautiful five-star hotel environment — everything is exceptionally clean, tidy, and well-maintained, creating a very relaxing and comfortable atmosphere.
I travel frequently and, whenever I do, I always go for a massage to relieve fatigue — especially after long days of walking, when my legs, feet, and back feel sore. Over the years, I’ve visited many spas in different countries, always choosing places that are clean, well-equipped, and highly rated.
I can honestly say that this has been one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had.
All staff members are very professional, well-groomed, and neatly dressed. Everyone is warm, polite, and genuinely friendly — from the front desk to the therapists. The level of service is consistently excellent.
What makes this place truly special is that each therapist has their own unique skills and techniques, so every visit feels different and refreshing. The massage itself is strong, professional, and delivered with real care and dedication. They continuously check if the pressure is comfortable and adjust based on your preference, which makes the whole experience very thoughtful and personalized.
You can really feel that they put their heart into their work — focused, attentive, and committed from beginning to end.
Considering the quality of service, the environment, and the professionalism, this spa offers excellent value for money compared to similar experiences in other countries.
Highly recommended — I will definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: William Li

reviewList.text: From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed by the staff in the lobby. Trang was lovely, recommending treatments suitable for me to ensure I got the best value for money. Ngan provided the massage and she was simply excellent. It was the BEST massage I’ve had in as long as I can remember. It felt even, not too repetitive and felt unique. Thank you for a wonderful experience, Trang and Ngan!

reviewList.text: I had a 90 minute body massage and a 60 minute facial. It was so relaxing! The pressure was amazing. Ms Lan checked with me to ensure that I was happy with the pressure and that everything was okay. I feel so relaxed after and my skin is now glowing. Highly recommend. Thank you all so much.

places.name: Tam’s Deep Tissue Massage & Pain Relief

reviewList.text:
Came in looking like a shrimp 🦐—my lower back was so tight I was leaning forward, my right back muscles had tightened up and pulled my body slightly to the right, plus my neck and shoulders were a mess.

Pros: Tâm has impressive knowledge of anatomy and sports stretching. The stretches were definitely the “good pain” kind, but afterwards my body felt so much lighter, less swollen, and I could stand much straighter. He also gave me mouthwash and Bàu Mây salt & pepper to take home, which was a nice surprise. Super friendly too!

Cons: Since he’s Vietnamese… be prepared for a lot of chatting 😂.

Overall, if you’re looking for someone who actually understands how the body works instead of just giving you a relaxing massage, I’d definitely recommend this place.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a wonderful massage experience with Tam! He was very professional, friendly, and attentive throughout the session. His deep tissue massage was excellent, with the right amount of pressure to relieve muscle tension and tightness. He really knows how to target sore muscles and make you feel relaxed and refreshed. Truly appreciate his skills, dedication, and excellent service. Highly recommended, especially for anyone looking for a good deep tissue massage. Will definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: DL

reviewList.text: This is not a traditional spa massage. I wanted a deep tissue and stretch massage. I am leaving pain free, now. Was it painful, yes. Was it enjoyable, no. Was it exactly what I wanted, absolutely. Did he keep saying I am doing 5% pressure when it felt like 500% and I wanted to die, so instead I just laughed, yep. Highly recommend. GREAT PLACE!

reviewList.text:
I recently had a session at Tam’s Advanced Pain Relief & Muscle Rehab Clinic in Da Nang, and I have to say, it was quite an experience! After struggling for a while with long-term issues in my neck, shoulders, and back, I realized I needed some serious help. I found this clinic through Google, and it was conveniently located near my hotel, which was a plus.

Nick Nguyen was my therapist, and I won't lie—it really hurt! He worked deep into the muscles, and there were definitely moments when I felt uncomfortable. But honestly, that's exactly what I needed. It was intense, but you could tell he was getting to the root of the problem.

I left feeling a bit sore but also relieved. I'm genuinely glad I found this place because I felt like I was finally tackling my issues. I’m already planning to go back for a second session before I head home! If you’re looking for effective muscle therapy, I highly recommend giving Tam’s a try.
reviewList.author: Rashpal Padham

reviewList.text: This is the real deal 💯, and by the real deal I mean Tam does not hold back. He is strong and goes deep. Its definitely a challenge. With this comes quite a bit of pain at the really sensitive/tight areas. I could have told him to go softer but I wanted the relief and it was worth it in the end.  I went in with tight and aching hips and lower back and he fixed it completely.  On top of this he removed years of deep tension under my scapulars and shoulders. I felt like I had gained back relief and mobility after years of build up. I can highly recommend but be prepared.

reviewList.text: The best massage experience in Da Nang! Everything was perfect, from the friendly staff to the excellent massage. reviewList.author: Hoa Nguyen

reviewList.text:
I came in without high expectations. I just wanted to loosen up my back and body after a tough week. I left feeling like a different person.

I booked 90 minutes. Not sure if it's officially called a sports massage, but it was a focused, muscle-oriented massage with real attention to tight spots. Pressure was firm, the work was thorough and the full 90 minutes was used properly.

And in the result my back and shoulders felt lighter and more mobile right after, and the effect held through the evening. And for the quality of work, the prices are very fair.

A solid place for anyone who wants a real working massage rather than just light relaxation. I plan to come back regularly and would recommend it to friends
reviewList.author: Ekaterina Zhiganova

reviewList.text: Wonderful service and massage. I asked for a healthy massage of my back and I got the UV lamp heating and hot stone massage, so my back feels a lot better now.

reviewList.text: This is an excellent spa; the staff are enthusiastic, and the place is exceptionally clean and smells wonderful.
reviewList.author: Phan Quang Minh

reviewList.text:
We had such a wonderful experience here! It’s a small local spa that seems to be mainly for Vietnamese customers, so the staff didn’t speak much English, but they were incredibly kind, welcoming, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.

The spa was very clean, and the massage therapists did an amazing job. It was one of the best massages we’ve had in Vietnam! After the massage, we were served homemade yogurt and tea – especially the tea was absolutely delicious.

The prices are unbelievable for the quality of the service. If you’re looking for an authentic local spa with outstanding massages, friendly staff, and great value for money, this is the place to go. We highly recommend it and would definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Adriana Wendl

reviewList.text: They opened recently and it’s a lovely neighborhood spot! The owner is very sweet and the prices are great too. They also offered homemade yoghurt after your massage and they were very tasty. Would definitely recommend it 😊
reviewList.author: Shye

reviewList.text: This Spa is really nice. My friends and me went there twice while we were in Danang. On the first day we went there quite late, a bit after 8 o'clock. The owner stayed open for us and we went one after another. She is really friendly and we got great tea and some yoghurt. The spa is not in the main part, but really worth going to and the prices are really good. I like that it's not one of those main tourists spots but something more local. We communicated easily with translation apps. I did a foot massage and a full body massage which were both really good. My friends did the hair washing and facial spa, there are different options. But all three of them were very happy with their treatments.
reviewList.author: Pauline Thiesler

A very professional and traditional, family-friendly massage centre. The staff are extremely sincere, polite, and dedicated to their work. I personally experienced their foot massage, and it was absolutely wonderful and relaxing.

The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming. They truly care about customer satisfaction.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional, relaxing, and family-friendly massage experience. Will definitely visit again!

reviewList.text: Very nice spa , really amazing staff with amazing service and and relaxation atmosphere,  surely recommended.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars – An Amazing Spa Experience in Da Nang!

What a wonderful experience at Loki Spa in Da Nang, Vietnam! I treated myself to an incredible four-hands massage, and it was pure relaxation! Having two therapists working in perfect harmony was such a luxurious and soothing experience.

I also enjoyed a gorgeous cat-eye pedicure, beautifully done with great attention to detail. My toes look fabulous!

A special mention to the beautiful owner, whose warmth and welcoming presence made the experience even more memorable.

Loki Spa is a lovely little gem in Da Nang, offering a wonderful combination of relaxation, beauty, and hospitality. I thoroughly enjoyed my visit and would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a little pampering while in Vietnam! 💕✨
reviewList.author: Queen Kalua

reviewList.text: Great services and I did nail manicure. The staff is experienced and speedy. The prices able to negotiate again. Will revisit.

places.name: Ly.Haus Hair Wash - Body Massage - Facial

reviewList.text:
I came to this spa based on the reviews on Google Maps, and I was blown away by the quality of the service.
My therapist, Lu, was incredibly welcoming. Before starting the hair wash, she asked if I wanted my ears cleaned—which I definitely didn't want—and checked what water temperature would be most comfortable for me.
She also gave me an amazing, deep head massage. She was completely dedicated to the process; every movement was gentle, slow, and calming. She put on soothing music and kept checking in to make sure everything felt good and that I was comfortable.
The prices are a bit higher than in average salons, but I think it’s completely justified.
First, Lu uses products from the Vietnamese brand Cocoon, which are definitely not cheap.
Second, you can tell she genuinely loves her job and puts real care and quality into everything she does.
The price is 100% worth it, and I highly, highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Ellie Latina

reviewList.text:
The whole experience was great!

Before I even come there, the owner was very responsive on messenger.

Location: location is fine, probably 5 mins away from the tail of the dragon bridge by motorbike. The sign board is a little bit small tho, but it is not really hard to find.

Prices: I feel like the prices are actually cheap compared to other places where the prices are double or even triple the amount. I only paid 250k vnd for the back massage and hair wash. 👍👍👍

The experience: The therapist was very accomodating and naking sure that the pressure is just right. I came in with back pain and she was able to focus in the parts that were really tensed. The last part of the massage was actually amazing when she streched my back and the cracking sounds were very satisfying. 🤣 After the massage was the shampoo, it was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep 😂. I have a really long hair but she was very patient especially when blow drying my hair. After, there was a small treat (yogurt) which I also enjoyed.

The only downside that I have noticed was that the place is quite small since the business is relatively new so it may be hard if you want to go as a couple or as a group. So, I hope more people can discover this place so she can get a bigger place next time!

I would definitely come again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviewList.text: Nice massage and service and free snacks, will come here again
reviewList.author: Chuck

reviewList.text:

I highly recommend this spa — I will definitely come back again! ✨

reviewList.text: This place is such a hidden gem tucked away down a little side street, and it’s 100% worth finding. I had the head spa and massage and it was honestly one of the most relaxing experiences I’ve had. My therapist was amazing, checking in throughout to make sure I was comfortable and enjoying everything. The whole experience felt so thoughtful and the price was incredible for what you get. If you’re in Da Nang, don’t skip this place. I’ll definitely be back!

places.name: Meliá Vinpearl Danang Riverfront
places.address: 341 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, Phường, An Hải
places.summary: Polished rooms & suites in a refined riverfront hotel offering restaurants & an infinity pool.

reviewList.text:
An Unforgettable Stay with Spectacular Views and Truly Compassionate Service
We recently stayed in a family suite on level 36 at the Meliá Vinpearl Danang Riverfront, and it was an absolutely spectacular experience. The panoramic river and city views from that height are breathtaking, offering an amazing backdrop both day and night. The suite itself was beautifully spacious, modern, and perfectly set up for a comfortable family stay.
While the property and the views are incredible, what truly sets this hotel apart is its world-class, deeply caring hospitality. On our very last day, my mother unfortunately fell ill with diarrhea. A lovely staff member named Evelyn went completely above and beyond to look after us. She thoughtfully provided medication to help my mother and graciously offered us a complimentary late check-out so she could rest comfortably before our journey home.
Evelyn’s genuine care and empathy turned a stressful health situation into a moment of deep gratitude. This level of exceptional personal service is rare and shows how much the team truly cares for their guests. We cannot recommend this hotel highly enough and will certainly return!
reviewList.author: Ellie Xi

reviewList.text: This hotel is amazing, absolutely stunning. Great rooms, incredible breakfast and the staff are so beautiful. We had some help from Chloe on front desk that went above and beyond helping with a day trip to Ba Na Hills. Highly recommend this hotel. Easy grab to everything and right next to Vincom shopping centre.
reviewList.author: Nadine King

reviewList.text:
We had such an amazing stay here! The room was super clean, beautiful, and so comfortable. A huge thank you to Lilly, Kay, and Chloe for being extraordinarily warm and helpful throughout our trip
your tips and support meant a lot to us!

The location is super convenient—just 15 minutes from the airport and super close to shopping malls, museums, and the famous swing bridge. Also, the breakfast buffet was great, especially with so many tasty Korean dishes to choose from!

Highly recommended, and we’d definitely love to come back!
reviewList.author: SRWN SKPTK

reviewList.text:
Dear Hotel Team,

I would like to express my sincere thanks to the hotel staff, especially the reception ladies, for their warm welcome, kindness, and excellent service.

They were very friendly, helpful, and professional, and they made our stay more comfortable and enjoyable.

Thank you very much for your hospitality. We truly appreciate everything you have done for us, and we hope to stay with you again in the future.

Best regards,
Abdelilah
reviewList.author: Abdou Filali

reviewList.text:
The hotel is exceptionally well located, offering a wonderful view of the river with the Dragon Bridge close by. Even though the lobby gets very busy, the staff handles the check-in and check-out process seamlessly. Rooms are spacious and surprisingly quiet. The breakfast buffet is varied and caters well to all tastes, including Western guests.

I would especially like to recognize the outstanding help and support we received from the Public Relations Manager, Ms. Dung. She made us feel right at home and professionally resolved every inquiry we had during our stay. She even introduced us to the General Manager, Jorge Jimenez Arean, who kindly greeted us on our way to Hoi An. As I always say in my reviews, "people make places"—and this hotel is no exception. I highly recommend staying here when visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Luis M. Mir

reviewList.text: The coconut scrub was so soothing and relaxing. Loved that they have clean shower facilities so you can refresh and wash away all the coconut oil and scrub right after. They served welcome tea and fresh fruit before and after the massage. The whole vibe was so chill. Will definitely come back!
reviewList.author: bella chow

reviewList.text: We walked in on a Monday morning during happy hour discount and were attended to right away. This visit didn’t disappoint at all. This place is reasonably priced, the ladies performed professional massage, the menu has plenty of options for massages (we chose the 60 minute aroma therapy). It was very pleasant environment. My favourite part was the tea and fruits before and after the session. The whole place is clean and smelled good with essential oils. We will come back again, probably every week for the rest of our trip in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Fred Hollows

reviewList.text: Such an amazing experience!!! The ambiance was absolutely incredible, and everything was so clean. The scent throughout the place was wonderful, and all the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming!!! The massage therapist was also excellent. Everything was just perfect! Highly recommend! ❤️
reviewList.author: jiale

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An Outstanding Spa Experience – Highly Recommended!

We had an absolutely wonderful experience at Golden Lotus Spa in Da Nang! From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with genuine warmth, friendliness and professionalism. The staff were exceptionally respectful, attentive and accommodating, creating a relaxing and welcoming environment throughout our visit.

The facility was beautifully maintained, exceptionally clean and wonderfully peaceful. The traditional Southeast Asian theme, featuring beautiful bamboo elements and natural décor, created an authentic, calming atmosphere. Despite its popularity, the spa maintained a lovely sense of quietness and tranquillity, making it perfect for relaxation.

What particularly impressed us was the family-friendly atmosphere and the genuine hospitality of the staff. The fresh fruit served was delicious, and the high-quality tea was a lovely touch that enhanced the overall experience.

Booking through WhatsApp was incredibly easy and convenient. Communication was seamless, with staff speaking excellent English and responding promptly to enquiries. The service menu was clear, straightforward and easy to understand, with plenty of options available.

Golden Lotus Spa certainly lives up to the high standards associated with the Golden Lotus name. Everything was organised, professional and delivered with genuine care and respect.

A truly positive and memorable experience! We enjoyed our visit so much that we are already planning to return tomorrow. Highly recommended to anyone visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: khazen b

reviewList.text:
This is definitely a must go to massage shop in Danang!!! First, the space is very relaxing and spacious, giving you that luxury relaxing vibe. They first give you some tea and natural healthy snacks for you to start relaxing, then takes you upstairs to gently spa your feet with flower petals and scrubs. I got a 1hour foot massage, and its more than enough. While the massage, they do a complimentary cucumber facial so you can relax fully, even if its just a foot massage!!
After the massage they make sure you take your time to gather yourself and relax, as they give you tea with seasonal fruit, for me mango!! All of their food taste so good and healthy, it was clearly a detox! The place is super clean too, and the price is cheap. Would definitely recommend!
My recommend:
Lotus foot massage 60 mins
Masseuse: N.327 Mis.Ly

Aroma massage 60 mins
reviewList.author: 김민경

reviewList.text:
Oil massage full body 60 mins. Really professional. The place is also very well kept and quite big. Would surely recommend to make reservations since they were booked out for the day before when we wanted to come here. Very responsive on WhatsApp.

They are at a small Premium to the one that I went yesterday, which is also reviewed earlier.

I think the Premium is totally worth it for the following reasons -
1. Can book ahead on WhatsApp
2. They take care of small things like putting a small rolled towel under the ankle during leg massage. And they put a sheet to cover your hands once the massage is done
3. Temperature in the room was just right
4. The head hole was of the right size. Most places it is too small for my head

Will surely come again on my next trip to Danang!

They take a 3% surcharge for credit card. But the good thing is that they clearly take a surcharge for the masseuse which I think is really good. #respect :-)
reviewList.author: Ravi Sairaman

reviewList.text:
The best massages ❤️ We absolutely loved the hot stone massage and aromatherapy oil massage — it was incredibly relaxing and left us feeling completely refreshed.

A special thank you to our therapists, No. 607 and No. 457 ✨🙏🏻 They are absolutely wonderful ladies with great experience! They were attentive, professional, gentle, and really knew exactly what they were doing.

The whole spa is also incredibly well-organized and comfortable. There are separate changing rooms for men and women, with individual lockers that can be securely locked with a key. Everything is so thoughtfully arranged and designed with guests' comfort in mind — every little detail has been carefully considered.

The staff were extremely welcoming, friendly, and attentive. We were greeted with tea and delicious candied fruit, and after the massage we were served a lovely mango 🥰

Highly recommended — a wonderful place with excellent service, amazing therapists, and a genuinely relaxing atmosphere!❤️
reviewList.author: Полина Бугаенко

reviewList.text: Had one of my best massage experience here in Vietnam today. The lady was strong and gave a firm but comfortable massage. Place is very chill and comfortable. Upon entering you will be provided with sandals,  served tea and some snacks before and after the massage. After tea is served you will be given a list to fill out, in which you can let them know whete do you need more attention and the strength lvl etc. After that you will be brought to the changing room to get change. After which you will be taken to do a foot soak and continued by the massage. Overall a very nice massage experience here, will be back if I ever come to danang again.
reviewList.author: Ron “Ronster” 荣少

reviewList.text: I had a head spa, ear cleaning, and facial treatment, and I really enjoyed the experience.All the treatments were carried out with great care and attention, and everything felt wonderful.The facilities were very clean, with shower booths and hair dryers available. I also appreciated being able to use as many towels as I needed.The tea and fresh fruit served before and after the treatments were a lovely touch.I also brought a large suitcase, but the staff kindly stored it for me without any hassle.Overall, it was a wonderful and relaxing experience. I would definitely recommend this place!
reviewList.author: 牧田茉里

reviewList.text:
Great spa. This time, they mentioned us to come early 15 min which we did.
I went there 2 times on Friday and Sunday both for a hot stone massage. You can choose your oil if you choose a 90minutes massage between lavender, rose, ylang ylang. Price is around 450k for 60 minutes and 650k for 90 minutes not including 5% service charges but including VAT.
I particularly recommend the masseuse 607, she is really skillful and can apply strong pressures on muscles if needed. You will be offered hot tea and a fresh wet towel before going to your massage. They have an elevator if needed. You can leave your luggage there. In the locker room, they will give you changing clothes. They will start by gently cleaning your feet 🦶 👣 , then going to your massage room. You can request a private room when booking. Once your massage done, you can take a warm shower if needed. Finally, they will offer you mango and hot tea once going back downstairs. Perfect experience from beginning to end.
reviewList.author: Anh Mèo

places.name: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort
places.summary: Premium getaway offering a private beach, 2 outdoor pools & a spa, plus restaurants & bars.

reviewList.text:
An Absolutely Amazing Experience – Beyond Expectations!

Once again, my stay at InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort was nothing short of amazing! Every moment was truly memorable, thanks to the exceptional hospitality and outstanding service throughout our stay.

A special thank you to  Ly Nguyen at citron, Adam, Luke, Nguyen, and Hannie, whose attentiveness, thoughtfulness, and incredible attention to even the smallest details made us feel genuinely cared for. Their service went above and beyond our expectations and made our trip even more special. It is the people who make a place truly unforgettable, and they certainly made a difference!

The resort itself is absolutely stunning. The facilities are excellent, the swimming pools are amazing, and both the room and its breathtaking views are simply spectacular. The Club Lounge was another highlight, offering a wonderful atmosphere, delicious food, and an excellent selection of drinks.

Everything came together to create such a wonderful and memorable experience for our family. We are truly grateful to the entire team for making us feel so welcome and special.

Thank you for another unforgettable stay. We can’t wait to come back again!
reviewList.author: Phuong Dang

reviewList.text:
An unforgettable stay with views to match

This is easily one of the most beautiful resorts I’ve ever visited. I stayed in the Panoramic Room Oceanview on the Sky level, and the views were nothing short of breathtaking. Honestly, I could have happily spent the whole trip without leaving my room.

If you’re considering Club access, I’d say it’s well worth it. Breakfast with that view made the early mornings more than worth it. The service throughout was top tier: attentive, warm, and never intrusive.

There’s no shortage of activities, though it’s worth noting they aren’t included in the room rate, so plan accordingly. The cable car was a convenient touch, especially since my friends were staying on different levels and we could move between them easily. And don’t skip the spa; it’s a must.

Overall, an excellent experience from start to finish. I’m already looking forward to coming back.
reviewList.author: Mary B

reviewList.text:
The hotel is beautiful and has a really nice location. We enjoyed our stay, but honestly, I think it needs to improve quite a bit considering its price.

We also stayed at Four Seasons during the same trip, and comparing the two experiences, there was a noticeable difference in the overall quality and service.

The Club Lounge was a bit disappointing. The drinks were good, but the food selection was quite limited and could definitely be improved. Breakfast was also below our expectations, both in terms of variety and quality. I think the hotel really needs to work on its food offering, especially in the Club Lounge and at breakfast.

One thing we really liked about the Club membership was the airport lounge access. That was a great benefit, and the airport lounge itself was actually very nice.

Overall, it’s a lovely hotel with great potential, but for the price it charges, I expected a better experience. I hope they take these comments positively and make some improvements.
reviewList.author: Ahmet Sevinç

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a wonderful experience at Long Bar! The ambience was excellent, the food and drinks were great, and the overall service made our visit even more enjoyable.

A special mention to AN, his outstanding hospitality, friendly behaviour and attentive service. He was extremely helpful and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit.

Thank you, AN, and the entire team at Long Bar for making our experience memorable. Highly recommended! Will definitely visit again. 😊
reviewList.author: vikrant sharma

reviewList.text:
Stunning views, a wonderful breakfast, and exceptional service!

This resort is definitely worth a visit. The architecture and interior design blend beautifully with the surrounding nature, creating a truly breathtaking atmosphere.

The staff were incredibly friendly, and a special thanks to Ms. Ly and Thomas for their warm hospitality and attentive service during breakfast. They made our morning truly memorable.

We also got some amazing photos! Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Bryan Lim

places.name: DAHAN Spa
places.address: 498/6 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
We arrived in Da Nang on an early morning flight and didn’t get much rest, so our first stop was a massage.

I chose the 60-minute Signature Massage, while my son had the Children’s Massage. It was very convenient for a parent traveling with a child, since we could both relax at the same time.

My massage focused on overall relaxation, especially the shoulders, back and legs, which felt great after the flight. The pressure could also be adjusted based on preference. My son’s massage was much gentler and suitable for children.

The spa was quiet and comfortable, and it was a really nice way to start our first day in Da Nang before heading out for sightseeing.
reviewList.author: Lu Gan

reviewList.text:
Had a fabulous, relaxing afternoon with my family at this spa. We only discovered it on our last day, which was such a shame! From the hotel pickup to the refreshing drink after our massage, everything was exceptional.
I absolutely loved the 90-minute bamboo massage—it was one of the best massages I've had. The staff were welcoming, the atmosphere was peaceful, and the whole experience was incredibly relaxing.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality massage and a truly relaxing spa experience. We'll certainly be back next time!
reviewList.author: Jesal Patel

reviewList.text: Amazing, relaxing spa experience, and wonderful massage. They have a wide range of massage selection, including aroma, hot stone and bamboo massage. My partner did the bamboo massage and said it was awesome, great for untangling muscle knots and relaxing stiffness. Very reasonable price with private rooms/bathrooms, delicious mangoes post-massage and also hotel transfers. Came twice during our short stay here and wish we discovered it earlier :) thank you!
reviewList.author: Chasing Sunsets

reviewList.text: Experience was 10/10 here! I highly recommend. They really prioritize your satisfaction down to every detail and it was a real plus with how well they spoke Korean for my mom since that’s her primary language. If you’re looking for a sweet treat afterwards too, they also own a mango dessert shop called Pink Mango which they had ready for us right after our massage was over. They also provided us free mango drinks along with mango slices.
reviewList.author: Genie Kim

reviewList.text: The facilities is great and sparkling clean. Everything feels and looks like luxury! Only thing is you can choose only 3 areas to focus on in the 60 min massages so my massues didn't do full body but missed some areas. Overall it was very good. We were a group of 3 ladies and they put us all in the same room no curtains in between the beds. They also give you a foot scrub at the beginning and it was very good. They offer drinks amd food as well.
reviewList.author: Elena Testori

attribution.name: dahan spa danang - Best Spa Massage Danang 다한스파 다낭점

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointed! Great tips and trust in return for sloppy work and excuses
I just got a cat-eye manicure at this shop yesterday (costing 300,000 VND). I thought the service was good back then and even went out of my way to exchange money to give the nail artist a tip. Trusting them, I came back today to get a pedicure, also paying 300,000 VND. However, I was met with completely unreasonable double standards and treatment:
1. Excuses and Inconsistent Standards: The nail tech first excused herself by saying my toenails were too small for cat-eye style and I could only get a regular solid color. But yesterday when doing my fingers, they explicitly said they could mix colors and do cat-eye. Today, they refused any color blending, showing completely inconsistent standards.
2. Severe Drop in Quality and Time: Yesterday’s manicure took 50 minutes, while today’s pedicure was rushed and finished in just 25 minutes. The final result looks like cheap, ordinary nail polish—completely incomparable to a proper cat-eye effect.
3. Heartless and Defensive Attitude: When I raised the issue with the shop, they rudely brushed it off by saying "pedicures naturally take less time," completely dodging the core problem: charging the price of a cat-eye while only providing a cheap single-color polish without any mention of a refund!
We treat the shop with kindness, trust, and tips, only to be met with sloppy, low-quality service and a defensive attitude. It is completely unacceptable! I have retracted my 5-star review from yesterday and posted this honest review to expose their true colors—"nice on the first visit, dismissive on the second." I will definitely never come back again!
reviewList.author: Teresa Tracy Chang

reviewList.text:
I had a really good experience at Suzy Nails & Foot Massage. I did ear cleaning, a back massage and a foot massage, and everything was very comfortable and well done.

Special thanks to staff No. 6, who took care of me. The ear cleaning was especially comfortable and clean. For the back and foot massage, she adjusted the pressure according to what I was comfortable with, which made the whole experience very relaxing.

Really happy with the service and would definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: Amos Yap

reviewList.text: Served by Bonnie. She was really skillful, strong and know how to adjust her strength according to the customer. I fall asleep while she was doing the pedicure. Very comfortable. 😴
reviewList.author: Joseph Goh

reviewList.text:
If you're traveling in Da Nang, Vietnam, I highly recommend Suzy Massage to relax and recharge after a long day.

It was my first time trying an exfoliating treatment, and I was really impressed! I felt so refreshed afterward.

A special thanks to ZANG for the excellent service and kindness. She was incredibly friendly and professional.

I feel completely refreshed. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience! Highly recommended! :D
reviewList.author: Wooheesung Woo

reviewList.text: Lisa was so detailed and took her time to make sure my nails came out perfect! Love them! Will definitely come back again! The salon was clean and professional. All the ladies were so kind!
reviewList.author: Linh Trujillo

places.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
places.address: 26XW+XQ4, 81 Hoàng Kế Viêm, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Vietnamese Hair Wash + Massage Experience – Highly Recommended!

I visited Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm and chose the 90-minute Vietnamese hair wash + massage package with 30 minutes of sauna, and the whole experience far exceeded my expectations! Special thanks to massage therapists Nhi and VU — their service was truly professional. The hair wash was careful and thorough from the start, with great attention to scalp cleansing, water temperature, and technique — my hair felt fresh and clean afterward. The massage was even more impressive: strong enough pressure without being painful, working deep into tight muscle points with excellent comfort; every area was handled carefully with a smooth rhythm, and I could really feel their dedication and experience. The sauna session also left my body thoroughly refreshed after a good sweat. Clean environment, friendly service, and excellent value for money — I will definitely return on my next trip to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Wix A

reviewList.text: I walked past and saw this spa which looked very beautiful. I went inside and thankfully they had space for me to have a hair wash head spa appointment. The spa is very professional, clean and luxurious. Vi did my treatment and she was amazing. She washed my hair gave me a massage and dryed my hair afterwards with a lot of care. At the end I received some treats, a pudding tea and biscuits. The treatment was so worth it! Thank you Vi💛
reviewList.author: Rachel Westbrook

reviewList.text: Nguon Spa Da Nang gives excellent quality service. Full body massage and hair spa are so relaxing. Worth the price. The staffs are very nice too. They give complimentary drinks and snack. They will make you feel comfortable all the way. Thank you to Mai and Nhi for giving me a wonderful experience.
reviewList.author: Mima Savvy

reviewList.text:
I had a 90 minute massage scheduled with Anh BT with a focus on my neck, shoulders, and lower back. Anh BT did not disappoint. Her technique, her pressure, was excellent and throughout the massage she had great communication always being sure to check in to make sure I was ok.

I only received a massage although the spa does offer other services such as facials, scrubs, and hair treatments. Unfortunately my appointment was very last minute so it was the only service I was able to get.

Upon arrival you are greeted warmly by the staff and welcome with an iced tea and dates. The place looks very clean and the staff are very friendly and professional.

I highly recommend this place if you are in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Alissa Fontanos

reviewList.text:
From beginning to end, everything was absolutely phenomenal! I honestly loved every bit of the experience!

We got the 30-minute dry sauna + 60-minute body massage package, and it was such a treat!

It started with a cup of tea before the dry sauna. They also gave us complimentary prunes and changed our shoes into their cozy slippers. We then started by changing into their provided clothes before heading into the sauna.

And the dry sauna? THE BEST! 👌 It was made with Himalayan salt pebbles, which made the whole experience even more satisfying. I could literally feel my body releasing all that tension as I sweated it out. My pain was practically crying its way out! 😅

What I particularly appreciated was that they had a dedicated shower area after the sauna and before the massage. Such a thoughtful touch! You get to rinse off all the sweat, so you’re fresh and comfortable before your massage.

For the massage, they offered different oil options, and we chose rose. 🌹 Another great detail was that they allowed us to choose two specific areas of the body to focus on, which made the experience feel more personalized.

The massage itself was wonderful! The masseuse would occasionally check if the pressure was okay, making sure I was comfortable throughout. They also incorporated heating pads into certain parts of the massage, which made it even more relaxing.

Overall, I absolutely loved the entire experience! From the thoughtful little touches, the Himalayan salt sauna, the shower facilities, to the personalized massage, everything was well thought out. You can really tell they put effort into making their guests feel comfortable and pampered.

Definitely an experience worth having. I’d happily come back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Jessica Compuesto

attribution.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely recommended!

We had a 90-minute massage and it was honestly one of the best massages we’ve had in Vietnam so far. Very professional, relaxing, and exactly the right amount of pressure.

The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, and the whole atmosphere was calm and welcoming. You can really tell that they know what they’re doing.

We will definitely come back. Highly recommended – 5 stars plus from us! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: DyFlora

reviewList.text:
Just do a 60 mins hot stone body massage and massage skill from Ms. Vân is so good. My body feel relieved and my muscles no longer hurt. Facilities is clean and rooms are big. Just remind that price price are serperates with tips (service charges)
Overall:
Service: 5/5
Facility: 5/5
Price: 4/5
Location: 4/5

Will i come back later? Yes.
reviewList.author: Nguyen Minh Vu

reviewList.text: Amazing experience I had a package for the massage, facial, face pack and hair wash! I was floating out. They take good care of you tea and snacks. I have never felt so relaxed! Thank you my mum loved it too
reviewList.author: carly bickerton

reviewList.text:
I got a massage from other places but this was the only place that i loved during my travel.
friendly staff, professional massage
tea and snacks before also after the massage.
There was a lots of kinds massage you can choose where you want to get a massage also wheter it is soft or strong
Highly recommended
reviewList.author: Misheel Galbadrakh

reviewList.text:
Busy expect to wait or make an appointment in advance.

Excellent hospitality they offered sweet teas and coconut cookies while you wait. Watermelon and hot tea when you end.

Don't bother paying extra for scented oils as you can't smell anything during the massage.  Perhaps was too diluted.

Had my first ever 4 hands massage.  Could feel two hands were stronger had more energy.  The other two were hesitant or maybe she's ending her shift late in the day.  Reminded her to increase pressure 4-5 times but was unheeded.  The masseuses could be external contractors as they left the shop when we finished  Best to have massage here early in the day perhaps.

3% fee for credit card.
reviewList.author: Porter KHOR

reviewList.text: I decided to try this spa since it was recommended to me by a friend. I chose the 90-minute Aroma Herbal Journey. The pressure was just to my liking. I’ve been working out a lot, so I felt much lighter after the massage, and it got rid of the stiffness and soreness in my neck. However, I did wake up with some soreness in the middle of my back the next day. I think a bit too much pressure was applied there, even though I wasn't in pain during the session. The staff were very kind and polite, and the service was great. The intake form was also very helpful, as it meant I didn't have to explain my preferences directly to the massage therapist.
reviewList.author: Revelyn Pearl Artieda

reviewList.text: Herbal Spa which I experienced on Friday, 23rd October 2026 is simply awesome & by far the best spa I have been to during my 6 days stay in Danang.  It's the grand finale I must say before heading to the airport. We (4pax) paid for a 2.5 hrs Herbal Massage & Cupping for body & feet each at a reasonable price. The masseuses are very skilful & professional & most important they didn't skive in their job unlike Maya Spa. I feel relaxed, shoulders are lighter & can sleep better at night. This Spa definitely deserves a 6-star rating! I hope to come back again next year.
reviewList.author: Betty Lim

reviewList.text:
Wonderful experience. My wife and I did a couples massage in the same room. They’re very accommodating and professional. Calm, relaxing and accommodating.  Appointment is recommended but they also do walk in. We booked online and they contacted via WhatsApp to confirm everything and we arrived early as recommended. They go through everything and how you like your massage intensity and where to focus on as well as where to be gentle.

We liked it so much we came back again before we left central Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Tony T

reviewList.text: Absolutely delighted to be here. Before you go in, you will fill in a simple form to help them tailor their services for you. You can choose your own essential oil. I personally really recommend the blossom one. The staff are really friendly. The massage experience was relaxing, with soft music in the background. They have warm pads for your neck and different body parts. Their coconut biscuits are delicious. Overall, it is definitely a 5-star experience.
reviewList.author: 0v0 Tree

reviewList.text: The most relaxing massage I’ve had! I did the Four hands package and absolutely loved it. Would definitely come here again. All the staff can speak English well so made it very easy to communicate.
reviewList.author: Clarissa Lundy

reviewList.text: We had a great massage experience here! The staff were very friendly and professional, and the massage was relaxing and refreshing. The prices are reasonable, and it's excellent value for money. Highly recommended if you're looking for a good massage in Da Nang! 😊❤️
reviewList.author: 최정선

reviewList.text: I walked past and smelled very nice aroma scent coming out, and then noticed it is a spa. Given the good review, I decided to give it a go. It turned out to be really great. The masseur is very attentive. I was having a sensitive nose, she thought I was cold so she turned up the aircon, added blanket, and prepared tissue for me. I would want to come back again!
reviewList.author: Joyce Y

reviewList.text: My husband and I just enjoyed an incredibly relaxing yet energizing 2 hour massage!  Cong Spa and Nail is a quiet, cozy and beautiful spa just a quick walk from the Han Market and River.  We have had the Dry Massage which incorporates stretching and deep massage as well as the aromatherapy massage.  The therapists were amazing!  Miss Huong, Miss My and Ms. Ly are phenomenal! We have been here several times over the past few months and the staff and therapists above are consistently outstanding!
reviewList.author: K Carter

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience here! The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and the massage was absolutely amazing. The therapist was professional and paid great attention to detail, making sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire session.

The atmosphere was relaxing, the place was clean, and the service was excellent. I felt so refreshed and relaxed afterward.

Highly recommended! I would definitely come back again on my next visit to Da Nang. Thank you for the great experience!
reviewList.author: 김수진

reviewList.text:
Went to this spot as a solo female around 1pm on a Tuesday with no reservation. Just had to wait 15m! I got the 2 hour massage because I’ve been averaging 20k steps around Vietnam and really needed it, especially cuz I’m leaving tomorrow morning and going to be on a flight. Very pleasant and relaxing experience! Organized, not chaotic, peaceful, exactly what I needed. I would definitely come here again!

They were attentive to the form I filled out, place was very clean and safe! I especially liked that my massage was in a private room with private bathroom.
reviewList.author: Leah Acosta

reviewList.text:
Amazing massage, excellent service, and unbeatable value for money!

We had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa! From beginning to end, everything was relaxing, professional, and enjoyable.

The massage therapist was fantastic, with excellent technique, the perfect amount of pressure, and great attention to detail. We enjoyed a 60-minute full-body massage with hot stones for only 300,000 VND, which is incredible value for the quality of the treatment!

The hot stones added another level of relaxation, and one detail we especially appreciated was how perfectly they removed the massage oil afterward. We left feeling refreshed, clean, and completely relaxed, without that greasy feeling you sometimes get after an oil massage.

The entire experience was comfortable, peaceful, and well worth every dong!

If you're looking for a great massage in Vietnam at an amazing price, this place is definitely worth visiting! Excellent therapists, wonderful treatment, and fantastic value for money. We would happily come back again!
reviewList.author: Assaf Liran

reviewList.text:
As soon as you walk up you’re greeted with warmth and asked to remove your shoes. They place them in bins for collecting after you’re done and provide you with slippers to wear while in the spa.
Group of 3, 2 received a combo with shampoo and foot massage, I opted for the 90min foot massage. They ask if you’re ok with a face massage that comes with the shampoo, this was appreciated. We were also offered 2 plates of fresh mango and hot tea. A lovely touch.
We were sat together and immediately made comfortable. A towel placed over us like a blanket, warm neck rests and eye masks. My foot massage included leg and thigh massage, and finished with a quick neck and shoulder massage.
Everyone loved the experience, I would highly recommend this spa any time. Just note you are in a large, but serene room with other people. Some of which are not mindful of the quiet environment and used their phone with sound. So stupid.
We ended our treatments with complimentary beverages, the menu has been shared many times and appeared to be the same. Very good mango smoothies and the cutest bottle of water.
reviewList.author: Alisha R

reviewList.text: Wonderful experience! We had foot massages and full body massages. We came back multiple times on our stay. Lovely staff and delicious mango smoothies!
reviewList.author: Jen Wilson

reviewList.text:
Best massage exp we had so far here in Danang!
Tried other spas but this is the best one.
They even have welcome drinks & fruits + free water and drinks.
Pressure is on point based on how we requested it and we enjoyed it alot.

I got foot massage and my husband tried full body oil massage. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Fem Somera

reviewList.text:
Yesterday, we went for a massage at this place and were very impressed. The therapist who massaged me was lovely and friendly. The therapist who worked on my boyfriend seemed a bit less cheerful, but that’s okay.

Before the massage, they served ripe mango and tea, both of which were absolutely delicious. We chose the 1-hour foot massage, and near the end of the session, they also used hot stones, which felt amazing and was a very relaxing experience.

If you’re looking for a massage shop with good service, we highly recommend this place. 😊
reviewList.author: Maliwan Street to Suite

reviewList.text: I love this spa!! It was my first time ever getting a massage, and the whole process was smooth and comfortable. The entire staff is so friendly and helpful, and they would ask if the strength pressure was ok during the massage. I was given a sheet before my massage, it asked about my preferences and what part of my body to focus more on. The massage will be catered to you! Afterwards they gave me snacks and tea, I feel so refreshed!
reviewList.author: Kody

reviewList.text: We had a 90 minutes full body massage with hot stones, the place is nice and clean they have a change of clothes to have a massage in and a locker with key to lock up your belongings very good massage highly recommend. There's a 20% promo discount at certain times we went around 12.00pm on a Wednesday and a 5 % credit card fee if paying by card but we still got 15% off in total. Also get a drink and snack after the massage.
reviewList.author: Jeff

reviewList.text:
I chose this venue over a few others on the same street, and the initial impression was lovely. The entrance area is beautifully decorated, fresh, and has a very pleasant aroma. The reception staff were incredibly welcoming, and even though I walked in without a booking, they accommodated me seamlessly. The pricing at the entrance is also very transparent and clear, which I appreciated.

However, a few aspects of the experience could be improved. The foot-washing process takes place in the waiting area rather than being done privately by the therapist. Having your feet washed in full view of everyone else waiting felt rather uncomfortable; a bit more privacy here would go a long way.

Additionally, you are asked to leave all your belongings in a separate changing room. While they provide a key, it feels quite flimsy and easy to misplace or break. Leaving all my personal items completely out of sight in a different room made me feel slightly uneasy, especially since the venue doesn't take responsibility for them.

As for the treatment itself, I had a head and neck massage. Having tried many places in Da Nang, I found this one to be rather average. It is great for the price, but given the beautiful standard of the building, I expected a slightly higher quality of therapy.
Furthermore, toward the end of the 60-minute session, I became quite cold, as my hair was wet and the air conditioning hadn't been adjusted.

After the treatment, they offered a choice of a snack - banana or a boiled egg. While I imagine the egg is meant to be a unique touch, it felt a bit impractical for a post-massage snack. Peeling a boiled egg involves dealing with shells and trying not to make a mess, which defeats the purpose of trying to fully relaxed.

For payment, they only accept cash or QR code. It is not the most convenient setup, but manageable. Overall, it is a beautiful space, but i think I will choose another place next time .
reviewList.author: Julia Alexandrova

reviewList.text:
Tried contacting them via WhatsApp about 30 minutes before arrival, but the response was a little slow. However, when we reached around 8:30 pm via walk in, we were still able to start our 90-minute aromatherapy session almost immediately.

There are separate male and female changing rooms with lockers. We were first brought to the respective changing rooms to freshen up and store our belongings, then guided up to about level 3 for the treatment.

The room was simple with two beds, and the massage started promptly. My masseuse was amazing—her strokes were excellent and the entire 90 minutes felt incredibly relaxing. They also used hot stones and heated compress bags. The hot stones surprised me at first, but I quickly got used to them. The heated bags were placed under my neck and on my forehead, then moved to my stomach, and finally used to cover my eyes during the front massage. It felt so good that the 90 minutes passed way too quickly.

After the session, we were ushered back downstairs to change, returned the locker keys, and made payment. There is an additional 5% charge for credit card payments.
reviewList.author: Tan.W

reviewList.text: The massage therapists are talented and give better than average massages, but the services are overpriced because of the amenities and layout. First, the locker room has no privacy, so customers are forced to change openly near each other. Second, the shared massage rooms don't close the curtains, so it is like a row of sardines—not a pretty sight. Aside from extremely budget local spas, most other spas around the city close the curtains to create some privacy. Overall, it is difficult to return here after visiting other spas around.
reviewList.author: Rosie C.

reviewList.text:
A family of four (10 and 7 years old) got 90 minutes of full service care
I loved it!
Please check your earwax(?) after hearing
After shampooing, dry your hair with a dryer♡♡
Make sure to go! There's a reason why it's famous
All the visitors are Korea!^^
reviewList.author: 서한나

reviewList.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at 88 Spa & Nail. I went in to book an appointment and the staff initially asked me to wait since there was no availability at 7 PM but a slot at 9 PM was open. I agreed and opted for the 90-minute combo pack. However, later another staff member refused and told me they only provide services to “Korean people.”

This kind of discrimination is unacceptable. If a spa advertises services openly to the public, then all customers should be treated equally. Turning people away based on nationality is not only unprofessional but also disrespectful.

If you’re not Korean, I would not recommend visiting this place at all. There are many other spas in Da Nang that treat customers fairly and professionally.
reviewList.author: Abhijeet

reviewList.text: Omg! I am in love with this place. Facial/hair care from Woo-ann was wonderful! She was very professional and attentive. Also my nail turned out perfect! Tsu(?) took her time to make it as pretty as possible. Love the pick-up service as well. I highly recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Amanda K

reviewList.text: It was awesome!! You should get this massage!! We felt so good. We will miss this massage.
reviewList.author: 최라윤

reviewList.text: Really great service. Nails came out so pretty!
reviewList.author: Smile Boutique of Hurst 817-725-8222

reviewList.text:
A Five-Star Plus Spa Experience Without the Luxury Price Tag!

Had an absolutely amazing experience at Golden Lotus Spa in Da Nang!

What impressed me most was the value for money. The prices are quite reasonable, comparable to what you would pay at the beachside spas, but the facilities and amenities here are on a completely different level.

The attention to detail is outstanding. You are provided with a personal locker to keep your belongings safe, fresh spa clothing to change into, and proper shower facilities after your treatment. Another lovely touch is the choice of fragrances, allowing you to select your preferred aroma before the spa session.

The entire experience feels premium, comfortable and thoughtfully organised. It is these little details that make a big difference.

If you are in Da Nang and looking for a quality spa experience without spending a fortune, Golden Lotus Spa is definitely worth visiting.

Highly recommended! A wonderful combination of excellent facilities, comfort and affordability.
reviewList.author: Sai Patnaik

reviewList.text:
In over a hundred of massage experiences I had at home and abroad, I think this one is the best I ever had!

From stepping right at their door, the quality of service has become exceptional. The people in the reception are very welcoming.

You will be directed to the waiting area where you they will serve you tea and a treat. You will accomplish a form where they will tell you your preferences and points to be focused on.

They will show you the changing area and locker, which is separate for ladies and gents. They have shower, changing clothes, blower, comb, at others, which you can use.

You will be headed to the upper floors where the massage rooms are.

Ms. Lai was my masseuse and she is the best. She first washed my feet with warm water and salt.

The massage is exceptional! I haven’t experienced that technique until now. I had their signature massage and opted for the strong pressure. Ms. Lai is very skillful and she’d ask you once in a while if the pressure is good.

After the massage, you will be received in their pleasant area where you can have your snack and drink.

I only paid 380k dong for a 60-min massage including the service charge as it was happy hour. Indeed, a value for money!
reviewList.author: Hyacinth Aldueso

reviewList.text: Did a 60min foot + 30min head and shoulder massage. Experience is great, everything is done while lying down. Did a shampoo afterwards. Just take note service charge is included according to length of service. They serve drinks before and after massage with a fruit plate. Overall I feel relaxed and satisfied.
reviewList.author: Vicky Huang

reviewList.text: Had a great massage!  I love strong massages and the masseuse was able to deliver. Felt my knots melted away,  I wish they have an option for 2 hour lotus massage, 2x1 hour pricing is not attractive. Overall great experience and worth re-visiting.
reviewList.author: yves yong

reviewList.text: Just went here with my hubby and had an amazing 60minutes feet massage. It was clean. The decor was nicely done and you end with yummy mangos and other treats. Everyone was really nice. We were lucky to be taken cared of day of without a wait. Will definitely come back and refer to friends and family.
reviewList.author: Lien

reviewList.text:
Absolutely wonderful experience from beginning to end. I booked the 165 minute Sum Spa Package and was incredibly impressed by the quality of the service and attention to detail throughout.

Bella took care of me and she was amazing! Incredibly skilled, gentle, and attentive to my comfort throughout the entire experience. The massage was excellent, and I also loved the body scrub, facial, and especially the head spa with the scalp scrub and head massage. Everything felt thoughtful, relaxing, and completely unhurried.

I especially appreciated all the little details - the warm herbal bags and blankets, the essential oil I selected, fresh towels and clothing after my shower from the scrub, and my hair in the end. They served fresh fruit and tea and arranged a complimentary driver back to my hotel.

I left completely relaxed with incredibly soft skin and fluffy, clean hair. Exceptional service, amazing value, and such a beautifully designed experience from start to finish. Thank you so much to the Sum Spa Team for taking such wonderful care of me. I will absolutely be returning!
reviewList.author: Sofia Wakabayashi

reviewList.text:
Wonderful therapist

Lina was absolutely wonderful! She was so kind and gentle, and her hands were incredibly soft. She really listened to my needs and respected the fact that I don’t like too much pressure. The whole experience was very relaxing and comfortable. They also offer free drop off or pick up. I would definitely recommend her and will come back again! ❤️
reviewList.author: YU LIU

reviewList.text:
My boyfriend and I arrived at 8pm for our 8:30pm booking, but unfortunately, there was some internal miscommunication. Fiona, the receptionist, sincerely apologised and asked if we were okay to wait another 20 minutes. We could genuinely feel her sincerity, and we were more than happy to wait. ❤️

When the massage started, I felt that the initial therapist might not have been as experienced, so after about 5min, I requested to change to another therapist. Anna took over, and she was experienced, professional, and really good! The reception team also kept checking in with me to make sure I was feeling comfortable, which made me feel much better and showed how much they cared about their customers.

I was actually recommended to this place, and despite the initial hiccup, the way the team handled the situation really impressed me. Their sincere apologies, attentiveness, and willingness to make things right made me feel valued as a customer. 🥰

I’m definitely willing to come back again and recommend this place to others because of their excellent customer service. 🙏🏻

Thank you, Anna and Fiona, for taking such good care of us today! ❤️
reviewList.author: Tiana Lau

reviewList.text: Did the sum signature massage. Therapist was superb. Her technique and skills was so good that I felt so relax afterwards. Would definitely come back again every time i visit danang.
reviewList.author: Bianca Lai

reviewList.text:
One of the Most Relaxing Spas I Found in Da Nang

After days of exploring Da Nang, walking along the beach, and climbing mountains, sometimes your body just asks for one thing…

A good massage.

That’s exactly what I found at Sum Spa Da Nang.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere changes.

🌿 Soft lighting
🎵 Calm music
🌸 Pleasant aromas
😊 Friendly staff who make you feel welcome from the start

Whether you’re looking for a traditional Vietnamese massage, a relaxing oil massage, or simply a quiet place to unwind, Sum Spa offers the perfect break from the city’s busy streets.

After an hour, you’ll probably walk out feeling lighter, more relaxed, and ready for another day of exploring.
reviewList.author: Resulizm B.

reviewList.text: I walked in to Honey SPA and welcomed by a friendly front desk Mimi who can communicate in great english. They also has excellent masseuse that relieves all my body ache.
reviewList.author: Penny Tang

reviewList.text: I've come here 4 times in a month and each time seems better than the last. The staff is great, always friendly. I have always had a great massage! I absolutely recommend it.  Pro tip - I don't drink tea but the tea after the massage is heavenly.
reviewList.author: Steve Turner

reviewList.text: From the receptionist to the masseuses, everyone was polite and professional. I really appreciated the end-to-end experience - starting with a relaxing foot soak and tea, followed by incredibly thorough massages, and ending with tea and a biscuit. I chose Package 3 and honestly felt like I was in heaven. I left feeling completely relaxed and peaceful. It’s absolutely worth a visit, especially after a long travel day or a full day of walking.
reviewList.author: Mellissa N

reviewList.text: It was a great experience. Everyone was nice. The massauer lady was skillful and knew what she was doing. There was a complimentary herbal tea which was delicious. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Ivett Makk

reviewList.text:
Best massage i've had in Danang and i've been getting massages every other day.

Perfect way to end the trip before heading to the airport!

Service is friendly and incredible, my masseuse Lee has magical hands- my back pain is now gone. So relaxing!!

Highly recommend. 100/10
reviewList.author: Katrina

places.name: SEN Boutique Spa
places.address: 70 Lê Quang Đạo, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: I had an incredible experience here. The massage was incredibly relaxing and therapeutic. The therapist was attentive and noticed my bug bites and wounds, ensuring that I was comfortable with the massage in those areas. I also thoroughly enjoyed the face massage at the end and the complimentary tea and sweet soup served at the reception. Overall, I highly recommend this spa and give it a perfect 10/10 rating!
reviewList.author: 姚天鸣（Faye yao）

reviewList.text:
Definitely not worth 530,000 VND. I’ve had much better massages for around 200,000 VND. The therapist seemed young and inexperienced — it felt like she was simply rubbing a huge amount of oil over my body rather than actually working on the muscles.

I specifically asked her to focus on my neck, shoulders and the area between my shoulder blades, but she barely touched those areas and spent a lot of time on my arms, lower back and head instead.

The shower was literally inside the toilet area, there was no proper shower gel, and the towel they gave me smelled damp and unclean, as if it hadn’t been properly washed or dried. I didn’t even want to use it, so I got dressed while I was still wet. Even after showering, I left feeling completely covered in oil.

I came in in a great mood and left feeling extremely uncomfortable and disappointed.
reviewList.author: Zhaniya Murtaza

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience at Sen Boutique!
I read a lot of reviews trying to get the perfect massage package for my last day of my trip. Reviews can be very mixed, but ultimately we decided on Sen Boutique because it was nearby our hotel, and had the package we were looking for, with a good rating.

It did not disappoint! We were so pleased with the Sen Boutique Package! I message them about an hour before on WhatsApp and they replied quickly to help me book the package for 2 people.

When we arrived, we were greeted with Tea and the Form to note if you have any injuries, allergies, etc.

The steam room was great and located next to showers and lockers to clean up afterwards. Our massage therapist came when the time was up in the sauna and brought us to the room for a Foot Soak, before beginning the massage and facial.

Both my partner and I agreed that our therapist did GREAT. Applying smooth and even pressure, not too hard, checking in along the way, the technique and transitions were professional level and we felt well taken care of, and incredibly relaxed.

It was the perfect end to our trip, and we left here glowing! I am so happy we chose to go with this Spa
reviewList.author: Ashley Ann

reviewList.text: I loved everything about this place. From the moment you walk in it feels like you're transported to a relaxing paradise. The staff are welcoming and accommodating - serving you tea immediately in the serene reception area. I had an amazing signature massage in a private room with a skilled massage therapist. I was then served more tea/snacks at the end. The only issue I had was that they take cash only so I had to find the nearest ATM as this was my third time visiting!
reviewList.author: Mahbuba Ahmed

reviewList.text: Ly was an amazing therapist, she was so sweet and continually made sure I was comfortable. 10/10 recommend. And the establishment is so aesthetically pleasing.
reviewList.author: Allen V

places.name: Santa Luxury Hotel
places.address: 362W+PP6, 09 Đỗ Bá, Bắc Mỹ Phú, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
We had such a wonderful stay at this hotel! The rooms were very clean and well-maintained, and the bathrooms were spotless as well. The overall ambience of the hotel was beautiful, peaceful, and very welcoming.

One of the biggest advantages is its location. It’s extremely close to the beach, close enough that you can easily walk there. It’s also very conveniently located near the Night Market and Dragon Bridge. Hoi An and Ba Na Hills are also easily accessible from here. We rented scooters and rode to both places, and the journey was very safe and convenient.

Another great thing for us was the number of Indian food options around the hotel. There were plenty of restaurants serving both North Indian and South Indian food, so finding something we enjoyed was never a problem.

Overall, a lovely hotel with clean rooms, beautiful ambience, a fantastic location, and plenty of food options nearby. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it! ✨
reviewList.author: Aayushi Jaiman

reviewList.text:
I really, really love this hotel! I wish I had taken more photos because we had such a lovely stay here!

Their customer service is amazing! I had an issue with an ATM not dispensing my cash when I tried to withdraw money but charged me, and the staff even helped me call the bank to sort it out, despite it being a Saturday. I really appreciated that so much!

They also offer free afternoon tea with some snacks, which I absolutely loved! We got connecting rooms for me and my family, and we had a beautiful ocean view too!

My only suggestion would be to be a little more thorough with the room cleaning. But other than that, I have no complaints! I really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Rhealaine Sayson

reviewList.text:
We stayed 3 nights at Santa Luxury and had an excellent experience. We booked four Deluxe Ocean View rooms for our group — rooms were clean and comfortable, breakfast was solid, and the location is great, close to the beach and the An Thuong area.

The highlight was the staff. Tracy at the reception was amazing — she took real time to share the best sightseeing spots and where to eat like a local, and her tips genuinely made our trip better. Also, staff at the buffet were exceptional and very friendly. That kind of personal help is rare.

Would happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Maunil Parikh

reviewList.text: - Ms Tara is awesome. She was very friendly and provide good service to and they have great variety of dishes in the free morning breakfast like pho, spaghetti, salad, pastries, coffee, fruit juice, omellete, fried egg, mangos, bacon, indian fried rice etc. If you like asian food this will be a good value hotel stay. Good experience. I will definitely come back
reviewList.author: dinh ma

reviewList.text:
We recently stayed at this wonderful property, and it exceeded our expectations in every possible way. From the moment we checked in, the hospitality was top-notch.

Our room was a sea-facing one, and waking up to the stunning ocean views every morning was pure bliss.

A special mention to Jenna and Daisy. Their warm, welcoming nature and professional approach truly made us feel right at home. They were always attentive to our needs, ensuring our stay was smooth and comfortable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxed vacation with excellent service.
reviewList.author: ajay akash

places.name: Pam Spa Sora & Massage Da Nang

reviewList.text: Amazing treatment in this very professional SPA. The reception also the therapists are breathing kindness and professionalism.  Receing you with a cup of tea and a delicious cake. At the end of treatment, they offer you again a cup of tea and slice of fruits. Big thanks to Thuy Nga for her professionalism and kindness.  I highly recommend this spa after a hard day of exploring DA Nang and around.
reviewList.author: Mohamed SELOUGHA

reviewList.text: Me and my gf came here and loved it. I had a Thai massage. I’m used to getting oiled up but here I the therapist used tiger balm which I liked a lot. My muscles were very sore because of the gym and after the message my pain was gone. Definitely recommend to come here!
reviewList.author: Moritz Harwalik

reviewList.text: Very nice staff . I had a full body oil for 60mins.It was great. When finished the spa stop at the 1st floor they have cold fresh mango waiting for you
reviewList.author: Jibbydoi D.

reviewList.text:
Came across this spa walking to our hotel (beside wink danang center hotel)
place is very near the riverside and han market.

The staffs are really accomodating. Reception speak good english and are very courteous and helpful. Prices are reasonable especially their combo packages.

Place is cozy and clean.

Massage was amazing and the therapist speak little English but understood when i need to increase or decrease massage pressure.

Overall amazing experience.
reviewList.author: MD Primeluxe Travel and Tours

reviewList.text:
Pam Spa Sora & Massage in Da Nang is so good. It was literally few steps from our AirBnB.

As soon as you get inside they give coconut water and some snacks. Then after the service they give you Mango slices and another drink.

Ngoc Nho (number 84) she was so good, It was one of the best massage that I have had for a long time. She listened to what intensity of the massage that I want and she was great. I highly recommend her, she was a small women but she was so good. I got the Thai Massage with oil and they had hot stones. As a women I have never had a another woman sat on me and just used her strength to massage me. OMG it felt better with all the walking we've been doing.

The place was clean, smells good and the staff were all very friendly.

My Daughter had fake nails extension and Art and she loved it. To all my fellow Canadian who is coming to Da Nang please visit this place. It's affordable and definitely cheaper that what we pay back in Canada. Worth every penny. You can Grab it from your hotel.  Would definitely be back here if we visit Da Nang again, and will recommend to  friends and family.
reviewList.author: Lian Eligh

reviewList.text: Such a beautiful and thorough spa! The staff are friendly and welcoming. I enjoyed the 50-minute milk and lavender body scrub, complete with a steam bath and shower.
