The facility is impeccable. I must also say the tea and snacks served after the treatment were delicious! Thank you also for my gift ☺️
reviewList.author: Tiffani Lewis

reviewList.text: The best massage I had in Vietnam! Went a bit last minute an hour or so before they closed and they were kind enough to accommodate me with the massage I wanted. The drinks and snacks after were also quite good.
reviewList.author: Stephanie Albarghouthi

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing experience at this spa and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a professional and relaxing massage.

From the moment I walked in, the service was exceptional. The receptionist was incredibly welcoming, friendly, and professional. She took the time to answer all of my questions about the spa and made me feel comfortable right away. Before the massage, I was asked to complete a short form indicating which areas of my body I wanted the therapist to focus on and whether I had any preferences for the massage. I really appreciated this thoughtful and personalised approach.

The massage therapist was outstanding. She was highly professional, clearly very experienced, and her massage techniques were excellent. She knew exactly how to work on the right pressure points and adjusted the pressure immediately whenever I requested. The entire massage was both relaxing and therapeutic, and I left feeling completely refreshed.

Another lovely touch was being served jasmine tea and delicious snacks both before and after the massage. It really added to the overall experience and made the visit feel even more special.

Overall, this was a five-star experience from beginning to end. The excellent customer service, skilled therapist, and thoughtful attention to detail made this one of the best massage experiences I've had. I'll definitely be returning the next time I'm in the area!
reviewList.author: Shashank Tamgadge

reviewList.text: If you’re visiting Da Nang, run to this place! This is hands down the #1 massage in Da Nang. We had an amazing experience from start to finish. The service is outstanding, the staff are incredibly friendly and professional, and the massage itself was absolutely incredible. 10/10 — every minute was pure relaxation. We will definitely come back. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Шакир Иминов

reviewList.text: It was one of the nicest experience I've ever had! My lovely masseuse was such a professional, the Spa personnel was very warm and welcoming 😊🙏 they even treated me a coconut pudding dessert once after the treatment, and tea with cookies twice: before and after. I will definitely come back, thank you 🩷🌸
reviewList.author: Nia Nova

reviewList.text: We came by recommendation our friend and get truly excellent experience! Manager gave perfect service in the beginning, stuff was guiding all process with steam bath carefully and master of massage was the best! I came with pain in my neck and she fixed everything! It was healing! Absolutely recomended! Masters number 18 and 20 are the amazing! And snacks in the end are very healthy and nice! Thanks all team for  everything !
reviewList.author: Анастасия Линькова

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience at Chua Spa Danang. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and cared for. The spa is beautiful, clean, and creates a very relaxing atmosphere.

The treatment was professional, and the therapists paid great attention to detail, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout the entire session. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.

If you are looking for a high-quality spa experience in Da Nang, I highly recommend Chua Spa Da Nang. I will definitely be back on my next visit!
reviewList.author: Yesica Etcheto

reviewList.text:
I saw a review from a TikToker named Ducy (“Đu Xi Ưa Đi”) who experienced services at Chua Spa, so I trusted the place and decided to come here. I called in advance to make a reservation before arriving.

When I got to Chua Spa, the receptionist recommended a 90-minute massage package for 420k. I also asked about the sauna services, both dry and steam sauna, and the receptionist told me they had everything, including a herbal foot soak service. However, the receptionists said I would do the massage first and then use the sauna afterward.

I found that a bit strange because I’ve been to many massage places before, and usually customers shower first, then use the steam sauna and herbal foot soak, followed by the dry sauna, and finally the massage. Still, I happily agreed to follow the staff’s instructions.

As for the massage therapist’s skills, I honestly was not very impressed. The staff seemed quite young and inexperienced, so their techniques were not very professional yet.

About 10 minutes into my massage, another guest entered my room with a child around 3–4 years old. The child kept screaming nonstop, so I asked the staff to move me to another room.

After the oil and hot stone massage, I was taken to the steam sauna. The sauna room was very small, nothing like what I had seen in the reviews. I waited a long time, and the steam only started coming out after around 10 minutes. There was also no foot soak basin.

After finishing the steam sauna, I wanted to use the dry sauna as well, but when I asked, the staff told me that the women’s area did not have a dry sauna or a foot soak area. Apparently, only the men’s section had the full facilities.

So why didn’t they tell me that from the beginning? When I looked at the menu, men and women were charged the same price.

I then asked where I was supposed to do the herbal foot soak. The staff awkwardly brought out a basin of water for me in the changing room, where many guests were constantly walking in and out to change clothes and store their belongings. It felt extremely inconvenient and uncomfortable.

I spent money expecting to relax, but the experience was honestly very disappointing.
reviewList.author: Tú Anh Nguyễn

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful experience at Chua Spa! The hair wash was super relaxing, and the head massage felt amazing. The staff were very friendly, gentle, and attentive throughout the whole session. My hair felt so clean, soft, and refreshed afterward. Such a lovely place to unwind after a long day. Highly recommend! 💕I’m
reviewList.author: Chenling CUI

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointed and frustrated with this place. One of the worst service experiences I have had in Da Nang.

We made an online reservation for 3 pax hair wash and 2 pax body massage before coming. When we arrived, the counter told us that the place was fully booked and asked us to wait for around 1 hour. We accepted it because we understood that they were busy, and since we had nowhere else to go, we decided to wait patiently.

However, after waiting for a long time, a large group of customers came in. They had reservations and were immediately taken in for their services.

We continued waiting and thought that our turn would be next. But when it finally came to us, the staff suddenly told us that there was no room available for 3 pax hair wash anymore and that we needed to wait another 2 hours.

This is completely unacceptable. If the shop could not accommodate our booking, they should have informed us from the beginning instead of letting us waste an hour of our time waiting there. The staff showed very poor communication and terrible management of reservations.

What is the point of making an online booking if customers still have to wait and find out later that the service is unavailable? We planned our time based on the reservation, but the shop failed to respect our time.

A good business should know how to manage customers, communicate clearly, and honor reservations. Unfortunately, this place failed in all three areas.

Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for reliable service. Think twice before coming here
reviewList.author: Henry Ngan

places.name: Jang Mi Spa Massage Da Nang - Riverside

reviewList.text:
We visited Jang Mi Spa in Da Nang today, and my friend and I tried their special hair wash package. It included a nourishing hair wash and head massage, neck and shoulder massage, Jade Radiance facial, and a facial mask.

The experience was wonderful! The neck and shoulder massage was especially good, very relaxing, and helped me feel refreshed. I also really enjoyed the facial massage, which was soothing and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. It was such a lovely way to relax and take a break from our busy day.

Overall, we had a great experience and enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and treatments. I would definitely recommend Jang Mi Spa to anyone looking for a relaxing hair wash and facial experience in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Getziyal

reviewList.text: I had a fantastic experience at Jang Mi Spa! The 90-minute massage was absolutely amazing. The therapist was professional, attentive, and really knew how to work out all the tension and sore spots. The pressure was perfect, and I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. The entire experience was wonderful, from start to finish. Highly recommend Jang Mi Spa to anyone looking for a great massage. I would definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: Ron Anastacio

reviewList.text:
​Absolute perfection! I’ve visited Jang MJ Spa twice since July 15th, and every single experience has been exceptional. The team provides incredible care, genuine warmth, and unmatched attention to detail. Every tension melts away the moment you step through the door.

​If you're in Da Nang and looking for top-tier wellness and restorative massage, this is hands-down the best place in town. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Dragon Soul

reviewList.text: We absolutely love this spa! My daughter and I have gone twice (hot stone massage for me/ kids massage for her), and I treated my mother to a massage here for her birthday. One of the highlights of our visit to Da Nang so far. The massages are wonderful and the complimentary tea and coconut crackers are also a lovely touch. The service is 10/10. Thank you all for the experience!
reviewList.author: Taylor Munroe Radford

reviewList.text: I was referred to this spa by ChatGPT after sharing the area I was in. I am so happy that I gave them a try. My masseuse , Ms Thao, was absolutely excellent. She applied just the right amount of pressure and continue to check to make sure that I was okay. I will definitely come back again
reviewList.author: Chiquita Minion

attribution.name: Jang Mi Spa Massage Da Nang - Riverside

reviewList.text:
As someone who has been to a couple massage locations , this was a perfect recommendation from Google. Despite this being my first massage spot in Da Nang specifically, I don’t believe I would want to visit another spot.

We were greeted by Vy who spoke acceptable english to help navigate their selection. We decided to do a 60 minute foot massage and 30 minute scalp massage! Tuyet was my masseuse, and as someone who likes strong massages that dive into the Knots and parts of the muscle that are tight she did just that instead of skimming over.

I am not a fan of too much elbow which some use, but Tuyet did not do that. She communicated multiple times whether or not I was comfortable. For someone of her stature her hands and ability to use her body to ensure her client gets a massage that will make them sore while being relieved do just the job!

My girlfriend got Nhung who was just as thorough as well!

We will come back :)
reviewList.author: Danh Tran

reviewList.text: We had the hot stone massage and it was so relaxing! We both fell asleep like a baby 😆 staff are very friendly and nice and we even get a mango yogurt cold drink after our session! Definitely worth a visit with such a value price!
reviewList.author: Stefunny Yeung

reviewList.text:
We just walked in randomly and honestly it’s the best massage we’ve had so far.

The hostess was super friendly, and the neck–shoulder–back massage was amazing — strong pressure just how we like it.
They even gave us free yogurt after, which was so good.

Highly recommend!!
reviewList.author: Mina

reviewList.text: Highly recommend! We search for a random massage place during our trip in Danang (we were at a matcha bar in the neighbourhood) and Bliss Spa pops up on the map. With tons of good reviews and a hint of curiosity for “Japanese style massage”, we came to Bliss and OMG they are so good! I personally love atmosphere (very quiet and no mosquito!!) the masseuse told us in advance if they could adjust the force as our preference and hit all the right sore spots. I mean, a one hour in heaven! If you walk around a lot or want to treat yourself during holiday, you should be Blissed!
reviewList.author: Hang Trinh

reviewList.text:
​I had an incredible head spa treatment at Bliss Spa! The session was deeply relaxing, and the therapist was exceptionally attentive and detailed throughout the entire process. To top it off, their complementary smoothie was absolutely delicious!
​If you are visiting Da Nang, I highly recommend stopping by Bliss Spa for an unforgettable pampering session.
reviewList.author: Cherlyn Tan

places.name: Panda Spa Body & Foot Massage Danang

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Truly First-Class Service!

Having visited Vietnam for years, I can confidently say this is one of the best service experiences I’ve had! From the receptionist to the therapists and every member of the team, everyone is incredibly friendly, thoughtful, attentive, and genuinely caring.

Their hospitality and professionalism are truly first-class, making you feel welcome and comfortable from the moment you walk in. Another big plus is that everyone speaks English very well, making communication effortless!

Definitely a place I’ll return to and highly recommend to my friends. Keep up the amazing work! 😊👏
reviewList.author: Eric Ku

reviewList.text: The spa area is quiet, elegant and spotlessly clean. The therapist was highly skilled and adjusted the massage pressure perfectly to ease my sore muscles after sightseeing. Staff were warm and thoughtful, serving lotus tea before and after the treatment. The peaceful atmosphere helped me fully unwind. It was such a lovely treat during our trip to Da Nang. I would highly recommend this spa to all visitors and will definitely come back on my next visit.
reviewList.author: 吴名仕

reviewList.text: I traveled here from the U.S. and had a 90-minute deep tissue massage today, while my girlfriend had a 90-minute relaxation massage. The therapists were incredibly dedicated. One of them (I’m sorry I didn’t catch her name) gave me the best massage I’ve ever experienced. I am a licensed massage therapist myself and run a massage practice in the U.S., so I know exactly what a professional massage should be like. If I have the chance to visit Da Nang again, I will definitely come back. Thank you to the therapists.
reviewList.author: Ethan

reviewList.text:
An absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish! ✨
The place is exceptionally clean, the massages were amazing, and the service was outstanding from the moment I arrived until the end. I tried the Hot Stone Massage and the Head & Facial Massage, and both were absolutely fantastic.
The hospitality was excellent, with refreshments offered upon arrival and again after the treatment. I also really appreciated the privacy and the availability of a private room for hijabi women, which made the experience even more comfortable and relaxing.
Everything was handled with great care and professionalism. Truly one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had.
I highly recommend this place and would definitely come back again! 🤍✨
reviewList.author: manal alqarqaz

reviewList.text:
Great place than ever!!
I go with body massage and think this is best service than ever!
Staff is extremely friendly, always checking if water is warm enough, if their force is at right level or not..
A warm green tea was served as a start, then when we finish they also serve yoghurt & banana.
Strong recommendation from me 👍🏼
reviewList.author: Toan P

places.name: Maya Spa Massage & Nail Da Nang

reviewList.text: Absolutely fantastic massage experience! The therapist was very professional, knew exactly where my tight muscles and sore spots were. They kept checking on the pressure throughout the session. The space was clean, quiet and cozy. Staff are friendly and welcoming. Great value for money after long‑day sightseeing around Da Nang / Hoi An. I feel totally refreshed and relaxed. Highly recommend for all travellers, will definitely come back next time I visit Vietnam!
reviewList.author: ChenZhe Xu

reviewList.text:
Had such a lovely and relaxing experience at Maya Spa Danang! 💆🏻‍♀️✨

Enjoyed the hair wash, facial and foot massage, and every part of it was so comfortable and soothing. The whole experience was just what I needed to unwind and recharge. Walked out feeling refreshed, relaxed and so much better!

Definitely a great place to pamper yourself. Highly recommend! 💖
reviewList.author: Siew Hui

reviewList.text: This was the most relaxing massage I've had in Da Nang. They gave me a great massage exactly as I requested. The beautiful staff were all very kind and friendly, and the massage techniques were excellent. After the session, they even served fruit and mango pudding. I'll definitely come back.
reviewList.author: yoo kiko

reviewList.text: The service itself deserves a 5-star review. However, after the treatment, the staff asked me to leave a positive review on Google Maps in order to receive a small gift. This practice made me uncomfortable. Before coming here yesterday, my wife picked another spa recommended on China’s Xiaohongshu. It also had a 4.9 rating on Google Maps, but after checking its recent reviews which were mostly negative, we decided not to go. I have travelled to around 80 countries worldwide, and this is the only business that has asked customers to write a review on-site. It goes against the principles of authenticity and fairness. I hope they will change this practice. I would like to emphasise again: your service is already excellent. Do not adopt these bad habits used by some Chinese merchants.
reviewList.author: Wai Man Kevin Kam

reviewList.text:
This was a completely spontaneous find while I was passing by, and after seeing more than 2,000 reviews on Google, I figured it was worth a try.

It was my first experience with a bamboo massage, and I really enjoyed it. The warm bamboo sticks added a different kind of comfort to the massage, and the eye mask was a nice touch that made it easier to switch off and relax. The therapist was attentive throughout, and the whole session felt calm and unhurried.

What stood out were the little details. A welcome drink and refreshing wipes before the treatment, followed by mango yogurt and fresh fruit afterwards — simple touches, but they made the experience feel extra thoughtful.

Definitely a pleasant surprise from an unplanned stop!
reviewList.author: 1. Ken Ang

attribution.name: Maya Spa Massage & Nail Da Nang
Maya Spa Massage & Nail Da Nang

places.name: 다낭 스파 - Tin Tin Spa - Spa & Massage

reviewList.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at this spa! I chose the 90-minute massage, and I genuinely enjoyed every moment of it. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional, which made the whole experience even more relaxing. 🥰

The spa is also conveniently located right next to my hotel, which was perfect for me.

They even surprised me with a delicious mango yogurt, tea and a lovely gift boxes of cookies! Such a thoughtful gesture that really made me feel appreciated.

I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a relaxing massage with kind and attentive staff. I would definitely come back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Harisonne Meert

reviewList.text: An absolute hidden gem! For just ₹2,000, we received world-class service that included a deeply relaxing body massage, a refreshing head wash, and a rejuvenating facial. To top it all off, we were treated to fresh yogurt and dragon fruit once the session was complete. Exceptional value and pure indulgence. I can't wait to return! Thank you so much for your hospitality.
reviewList.author: Arzeena Fulwadiwala

reviewList.text: Beautiful, clean, and relaxing environment! The therapists are highly skilled and provide excellent service. I especially loved the hot stone therapy on my back — it was so soothing and comfortable! Overall, a wonderful experience. Highly recommended, and I would definitely come back again! ❤️
reviewList.author: Yong En Yap

reviewList.text:
The massage was amazing.
Also, they were welcome to come here with the kids. While we are taking the message, kids were relaxing with the same room.

This was really helpful since we need to check out the hotel and the flight is 18:40PM.

Also, they gave us the free transfer to the airport.

So we enjoyed the trip of Da Nang until the last minutes :-)
reviewList.author: Tatsuya Toyama

reviewList.text:
​I used this spa on the day I flew back home.
It included transfers from my hotel to the spa, and then from the spa to the airport. Pregnancy massages can often feel a bit lacking, but they really worked out all the tension here.
I fell into a comfortable sleep and woke up feeling completely refreshed and relaxed.
There’s also a Lotte Mart right next door, which was great for some last-minute shopping.
I highly recommend visiting on the final day of your trip!
reviewList.author: Manami

places.name: Herbal Oasis Spa ( Massage - Hair wash - Nails - Waxing - Eyelashes )

reviewList.text: I had a very nice experience here😍 90 mins massage (full body massage + hair-washing service). My masseuse always adapted pressure when I asked. Super friendly staff and nice atmosphere ♥️
reviewList.author: Nastya Lilac

reviewList.text: Today's massage was absolutely wonderful. The therapist's technique was authentic and professional, with just the right pressure to melt away all my tension. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommended — I will definitely be coming back for another session!
reviewList.author: Kiehl Kiang

reviewList.text: We had our nails done at Herbal Oasis, and the designs were amazing. It's in a nice location. The nail technicians are very talented, and accommodating. They offered tea and snacks as they waited. Highly recommended and will definitely come back again
reviewList.author: Sam Alvarez

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Absolutely Amazing Experience!

After several days of traveling, long flights, and uncomfortable seats, my body was completely exhausted, and I was experiencing significant muscle pain and tightness in my back. I was looking for a proper, professional massage that would actually address my problem rather than just a typical relaxing massage. Herbal Oasis exceeded my expectations!

From the moment I arrived, the experience was excellent. The lady at reception spoke fantastic English, was incredibly welcoming, and took the time to listen as I explained exactly where I was experiencing pain and what I needed. She understood immediately and even kindly offered me a discounted price, which I really appreciated.

The massage itself was outstanding! The therapist focused on the areas I had mentioned, and within the first few minutes, I could already feel the tension being released. She clearly knew what she was doing, applying the right amount of pressure and giving extra attention to the muscles that needed it most.

By the time the massage was finished, the back pain I had been dealing with was completely gone. I returned to my accommodation feeling incredibly relaxed, fell asleep almost immediately, and enjoyed the best uninterrupted night's sleep I'd had in a long time!

As someone who travels frequently and has experienced many massage establishments, I can confidently say this was one of the most satisfying experiences I've had.

Excellent customer service, skilled massage therapy, genuine attention to individual needs, and fantastic value for money.

Thank you, Herbal Oasis, for turning an exhausting day into such a wonderful evening. I will absolutely be returning whenever I'm in Da Nang and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a genuinely excellent massage!

An easy 5 stars. Well deserved!
reviewList.author: Brian Villalobos

reviewList.text: Here is the amazing massage place you must visit in Danang. The best of everything-service,massage and vibes are perfect. I will come back here again for sure. ❤️
reviewList.author: Wanrada Sathawornsmith

reviewList.text:
> Had an amazing massage experience here! The staff were professional, friendly, and really knew what they were doing. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and perfect for unwinding after a long day.
> The service was excellent from start to finish. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a quality massage in Vietnam!
🤗🤗🤗👍👍👍
reviewList.author: saw htooaung

reviewList.text: I went here for a shampoo treatment. I was greeted at the entrance by a very nice young man who was very friendly and sweet, spoke good English, and we also had a nice chat in Chinese at the end. Before the treatment, they give you watermelon and tea. The building itself is very cozy, three floors, cozy, and I really liked the massage therapist. After the treatment, they gave me delicious mango tea. I'll be back, thank you very much. I liked it, and I recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Kseniya Kinko

reviewList.text: Ao Dai Spa’s massage was indeed true massage that took all the load off the shoulder and back. The constantly checked if  we were feeling okay and made sure the massage was at the right strength. The kept our luggage for hours so that we could go and do our final shopping and provided the final transport to the airport. This was the best ending of a family trip. We just felt lighter, relaxed and heavenly. Thank you for this truly amazing experience.
reviewList.author: Hannah Kim

reviewList.text: A calm and relaxing atmosphere, with excellent service and very professional staff. I had a 120minute aromatherapy massage, and it was perfect for completely switching off, releasing the stress, and starting the week feeling refreshed. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Fahd Younes DAGHRIR

reviewList.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (10/10 experience)

From the moment I walked in, the experience was exceptional. I was greeted with fresh slices of watermelon and hot tea, which immediately set the tone. Before the massage even started, I received a relaxing foot massage, followed by a warm compress placed on my neck and a hand massage — such a thoughtful touch.

The staff was absolutely amazing: welcoming, attentive, and very professional. Every detail felt intentional and calming. To end the experience, they brought me a mango milk smoothie, which was the perfect finish.

This was truly a top-tier experience from start to finish. I will definitely be referring this place and coming back. Highly recommend.
reviewList.author: Actress Lonnie Grant

reviewList.text:
My experience at Chill Out Spa was truly wonderful! The space is clean, fragrant, and quiet—it feels relaxing the moment you step inside. The staff are friendly, enthusiastic, and provide attentive service. The treatments are incredibly soothing, and the massage techniques are excellent, leaving my body feeling refreshed and helping to melt away the stress after long, tiring days at work.
I am very satisfied with the quality of service. I will definitely be back and will recommend Chill Out Spa to my friends and family! ❤️
reviewList.author: Xuân Hương Lê

reviewList.text: Manager Tien is a lovely lady who warmly welcomed and gave us the red carpet treatment. Her team sent us to relaxation heaven ☺️ which we didn't want to wake up from. A true relaxation paradise. A must go for a legitimate, classy and friendly massage experience. Also, the ambience, music, aroma, staff interaction, drinks and nimbles all added to this amazing experience.
reviewList.author: C 'Ryan' Cheng

reviewList.text: Probably the best foot massage I had. We were able to have a massage without prior booking. Staff was really attentive and kind. It was a 45min foot massage. The pressure was perfect, releasing many knots. And to my surprise it include many important extras: warm bags, hot stones and hot towel. Loved it and would book every day of my stay in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Patricia da Costa

reviewList.text:
Very relaxing spa with exceptional service. They welcomed me with a tea and an analysis. The lady that did my body massage and shampoo is very skilled. Just as I requested and better!!

Finished with fruits and tea. It’s a great experience 💖
reviewList.author: Marisa So

reviewList.text: Amazing spa, found it accidentally on the street of Da Nang and it was definitely worth it. The staff is really kind and the massage is so relaxing! Highly recommend ❤️
reviewList.author: Ludmila Krusteva

places.name: Maha Spa - Massage, Facial, Shampoo
places.address: 26 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
The spa is wonderful, great ambiance. The reception staff were patient and very helpful.

I tried the hair spa and massage package. The masseuse was amazing, she was attentive and periodically checked if the pressure she was using was good and I was comfortable throughout the treatment.

It was a really good, relaxing experience… highly recommend.

And… an added perk, they have a super cute (and also very tolerant) boy cat that wants to sleep and not be bothered. So, we bothered him. 🥰😂
reviewList.author: Furever Bougie

reviewList.text:
This is actually my third time visiting this spa with my wife, and we’ve had a good experience every time. The place is clean, smells nice, and has a really relaxing atmosphere. I especially enjoy the sound of rain in the background, which makes it easy to unwind after a long day.

The staff are friendly and attentive without being pushy, and the massage is consistently good. The pressure feels comfortable, and the therapist knows how to work on the areas that feel tense. It’s become one of our favorite places to relax together. We’ll definitely keep coming back whenever we need some time to recharge!✨
reviewList.author: Lene Rew

reviewList.text: I absolutely loved my 75-minute hair spa experience! The 21-step treatment was so relaxing, and the staff were warm and attentive. They even served yogurt and dried mango afterward, which was such a sweet surprise. Everything was lovely, from the treatment to the little details. I’ll definitely return! 🥭
reviewList.author: Thảo Nguyên Nguyễn Thị

reviewList.text:
Really enjoyed my experience at Maha Spa! The staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the place was clean, comfortable, and relaxing.

I tried the massage, facial treatment, and shampoo, and honestly enjoyed all of them. The massage was really relaxing and the pressure was just right. The facial treatment was also really nice and refreshing, and the shampoo was probably one of my favourite parts. Everything felt very well done and not rushed.

The whole experience was really relaxing from start to finish. Definitely worth trying if you’re in Da Nang, and I’d definitely come back again! 😊
reviewList.author: Haidir Ali

reviewList.text:
Everything was absolutely wonderful! I really enjoyed the face care treatment as well — it was relaxing and lovely.

But the massage was absolutely AMAZING! The girl knew exactly where to focus and found all the spots that needed attention. She really understood what my body needed and worked on every point perfectly.

I left feeling so much better. Definitely a 10/10 experience! Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Anna Klymchuk

places.name: Cung Spa 다낭 궁스파 Massage Body & Foot

reviewList.text: The worst massage I had in my life. Only pain I felt and the massage was really bad. I can’t imagine how the rate and review was good. Also, when I paid for the oil massage with lemon grass oil, there was no flavour of lemon grass oil on my whole body. That’s sucks. Only the shower gel could smell as I finished my shower before massage. The staff was impolite too. Can’t imagine how they would react to me like this.
reviewList.author: Yin ki Lee

reviewList.text:
I had a 120-minute aroma massage here and it was a very relaxing experience. The pressure was exactly as requested on the form, and the therapist kept checking during the session to make sure everything felt comfortable. The oil massage was very soothing, and the hot stones and eye mask made it even more relaxing.

The spa environment is clean and comfortable. After the massage they also served tea and some fruit snacks, which was a nice touch. Overall it was a wonderful experience. It’s hard to imagine getting this level of service at such a reasonable price. Thank you!
reviewList.author: chen

reviewList.text: Me and my friend had such a relaxing experience here. We’ve tried many massage places in Da Nang, but this one truly stands out as the best. Everything was perfect — from the atmosphere to the massage technique. We left feeling so light and stress-free. Definitely coming back again!
reviewList.author: S M

reviewList.text: Simply lovely place. Reception are super nice and helpful. Massage helped fixed my back issues and feels straighter than a plank of wood. Thanks to this place I no longer have scoliosis
reviewList.author: Salamander “Salamander2505” 2505

reviewList.text: I stopped by to recover from fatigue during my business trip. It was my first time getting an aroma massage, and I really liked how it relieved my tiredness and helped me feel calm. I’ll definitely be coming back often while I’m here for work. and The fruit and juice you served after the massage were also really delicious. Thank you so much!
reviewList.author: 고영진

reviewList.text: Don't have enough photos because I fell asleep as soon as it started😆 My mom and I chose the VIP combo, 1 day before we leave Da Nang. It was just beside the Avora Hotel where we stayed, And it was worth it! The massage was so great, I really fell asleep😆 the price was also great, because you get to have facial, body massage, and hair washed in one session. Even though we picked the 90 mins, it felt like my body pain from the whole 5 day trip was instantly gone. And My hair was so soft and smells good as well. The one who assisted me also checked on me from time to time which I find nice, especially as a tourist. All in all, this one is great! With free snacks as well They have card payment as an option.
reviewList.author: Leigh Evangelista

reviewList.text: Surprisingly quiet even if it is  along the highway across the Han River. I asked for strong pressure and use of stick for foot massage and my therapist did not disappoint! Great value for money 💕
reviewList.author: Eddieventures

reviewList.text: Ohhh my gooood!!! What an amazing foot/leg/shoulder massage I had. Super friendly staff. Lyn is trully experienced & she has strong hands with a beautiful smile. If I was rich I would hire her as my personal masseuse & pay her 10x what she earns here... 😛😛😊🤗
reviewList.author: Vusumzi Mbuthuma

reviewList.text: Not a great massage. Not even a good one. In fairness, my wife reported a really good massage. The therapist I had did not have any talent whatsoever. It was pretty much moving oil around with her hands. The pressure at the beginning before the actual rub began was incredibly intense. My therapist was a bigger woman. I'm a muscular man and I don't know if they assigned me the larger, stronger therapist because of that, but my point is, although I very sturdy, it was a crushing experience. There was no payoff with the rubbing portion of the massage as it was fairly random rubbing around. At one point the therapist moved the massage table with her hands to push it away from the wall and I bit my tongue. I was not expecting a violent travel movement. The chit chat between the therapists was distracting. A random grab of my calf followed by a giggle was plain odd. A third person entered the narrow curtain area at one point and joined in the giggle filled discussion. My wife was also bothered by the conversation and a third person entering the massage area. All in all, I had a bad experience. My wife, much smaller, and less of a massage customer back at home did report liking the experience for the most part. Then again, her expectations may have been a bit lower. I may also add that the experience at a massage facility needs to be a calm entry. There was much chaos and it was loud. We were rushed, or herded, to charis to have our feet washed. So, it did not start off well. There are better places to go.
reviewList.author: gary smothers

reviewList.text: An absolute lifesaver after a long day of walking! The therapist was skilled and professional, focusing precisely on my tight shoulders and back. The pressure was just right, and the rhythm was so relaxing that I almost fell asleep. Great value for money and exceptional service.
reviewList.author: 張恩睿

places.name: Han River Spa
places.address: Lầu 5 Khách sạn Sông Hàn, 14 Lý Tự Trọng, Hải Châu

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful experience at this spa! The staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive. The massage was amazing and very relaxing. The spa was clean, comfortable, and had a great atmosphere. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a good massage in Da Nang! ❤️
reviewList.author: Hà Nguyễn

reviewList.text:
I’m not quite sure why the reviews are that good here, it was definitely a negative experience!

First, I walked into the hotel to look for the spa and the hotel receptionist at the lobby gave me a menu. I was surprised as the menu prices were definitely higher than listed on the website. A little shady for me from the beginning. The only told me to go upstairs to lvl 5 when I showed her the website menu prices, and she realized I had a reservation.

Second, the interior of the spa place looks quite old and a little run down. Still we had a booking and there were good reviews so we went ahead.

The bed was a little stiff and I had a backache after 1 hour. Foot massage I received (90mins) was not the best, lower than average, didn’t really feel rejuvenated after. My husband’s therapist strength was weak, but when he asked for more strength, the therapist’s nails were digging painfully into his skin so he had to request again for less strength. Not acceptable really.

Would not return. They provide return voucher in exchange for google review btw.
reviewList.author: Rennie Lee

reviewList.text: Love Han River Spa! The place is clean, smells amazing, and has such a relaxing atmosphere. The staff are really nice and welcoming, and the massage is absolutely incredible. Anh, my masseuse is fantastic! I left feeling so relaxed and refreshed. Definitely recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Goldie Castil

reviewList.text:
By far, the best massage experience in Danang. I am visiting again with my picky girlfriend.
Friendly and polite staffs, the owner maintain the masseuses skill level very high.
Strongly recommended.
reviewList.author: Brian K. Song

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Such an amazing experience at Han River Spa. I booked in because I’ve been dealing with a lot of tension in my face and pain through my neck, and Quinn was absolutely incredible. She was so skilled, attentive, and knew exactly where the tightness was. I walked out feeling so much lighter and more relaxed.

The spa itself is beautiful, peaceful, and really well looked after, and every member of staff was so warm and welcoming from the moment I arrived. The whole experience felt calm, professional, and genuinely relaxing.

I’d absolutely recommend Han River Spa to anyone looking for a great massage. Five stars from me, and I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Betty Andrews

attribution.name: Han River Spa (Song Han Spa) 송한스파 | ハンリバースパ | 韩江水疗中心 | منتجع صحي

places.name: KiaSu Spa Da Nang
places.address: 433/1 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text: It was a pleasure to visit KiaSu Spa! The therapist was very professional and provided a high-quality massage in a private room, ensuring complete privacy and a relaxing experience without any disturbances. I would definitely rate it 10/10 and would love to come back again!
reviewList.author: Mr. John Ursu

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful hair massage experience! The service was relaxing, comfortable, and enjoyable. The staff was friendly and attentive. Definitely worth trying, and I would come back again! Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: MICHELLE TING

reviewList.text: My friend and I had the all in one body massage –from head to toe and it’s very satisfying. Our therapists are so well trained and great. This experience in this spa is the best one! Gonna recommend it and we’ll be back soon. Btw, I love the scent of the agarwood, the interior vibes, and the complimentary tea and fruits. 👌💗
reviewList.author: Darryl Juanito

reviewList.text: My friend and I went here for a night massage. We tried the traditional kiasu massage (90 minutes). It was really great and relaxing. I dozed off to sleep towards the end of the session.haha I love their customer service too. Kudos! Before I went to the spa, I sent them a message via  Whatsapp. And they replied right away. I would recommend this place to my friends. 😊
reviewList.author: elarny acorda

reviewList.text: Excellent experience. My technician, Ang was just superb and fantastic. It is very clean and tje sandal wood oil massage combined with Thai massage was just perfect. Highly recommend and will come back again
reviewList.author: S D

places.name: Maha Spa Signature - Massage, Facial, Shampoo

reviewList.text:
1st time visiting Vietnam I was looking for a great massage place for my Mom's Birthday. Book thru KLOOK the 1st visit, HairSpa with foot rub it was so gooooood. Then added back and shoulder massage, I was shocked that it includes HOT STONE for the price. I feel like I blacked out most of the time. THE MASSAGE AND SHAMPOO WAS SOOO GOOD.

Came back after 2 days to get the combo FULL BODY + FACIAL w/ FREE SHAMPOO.
For me, my brother and my Mom.
Booked on watsapp, I told them the massage was for my Mom's birthday 🎂.
After the massage we were shocked they started singing, and they gave my Mom a birthday cake 🥹
The staff are so nice specially the girls at the reception. They also remembered us from the 1st visit. Definitely made my Mom's day and our vacation memorable.

Maha Spa now has 2 branches in Da Nang, so double check the location before u book.
Highly suggest booking the combo.
Booking thru watsapp is faster, specially for reserving time slots as this is a famous spa place. Although I saw some do walk in.

The after massage snacks are the best 🤍💕

Will definitely come back 🤍
reviewList.author: Marie Erika Grajo

reviewList.text: Absolute bliss! I found this little gem on Google for a spa near our hotel and wanted to give this a try. We had to change our appointment the day earlier due to change of plans and had to reschedule which they accommodated. We then had to change again to an earlier session, and yet again they accommodated us. The place has a relaxing  ambience and very natural vibe. I had the hair spa which I fell asleep within minutes while my husband and the kids had the body massage. I wish it lasted longer! The dessert at the end was a nice touch. We will definitely return the next time we’re in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Jessica Pan

reviewList.text:
👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻If you're visiting Da Nang, Maha Spa is definitely a place you shouldn't miss! I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a truly relaxing experience. Every time I come to Da Nang, I always make sure to visit Maha, and I've never been disappointed.

The staff are incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional. Their massage techniques are excellent, and they always check on me throughout the session to make sure I'm comfortable and enjoying the experience. That level of care really makes me feel valued.

I also love the yogurt and light snacks they serve after the massage - they're absolutely delicious and the perfect way to end such a relaxing treatment.

Thank you for another wonderful experience. I'll definitely be coming back again on my next trip to Da Nang!😚😚
reviewList.author: Mai Thị Thùy Dung

reviewList.text:
I have been here twice already (its my 3rd day in Da Nang) and am so happy with the service. I can recommend every combo! I had the shampoo and massage (110‘) and the thai massage (120‘) and both didnt disappoint at all. You also get snacks after your treatment and you feel very welcomed here!

Thank you @maha spa team! ☺️👍🏼
reviewList.author: Taetaetae

reviewList.text:
100 out of 10!!! Exceptional service and friendly staff. Worth every penny and the best way to end the trip. Did a 90 minute massage (aroma therapy and hot stone) and wow, my whole body pain from this whole trip went away.

I will definitely come back to this spa if I go back to Da Nang and recommend this spa for friends who are planning to visit Da Nang!!! 😌🩷
reviewList.author: Mia Yatco

attribution.name: Maha Spa Signature - Massage, Facial, Shampoo

reviewList.text:
The pressure was good. A nice warm eye pillow. 2 things that could have been better:
1. The lady that massaged me, it felt like she kind of rushed through the massage. 2. I did miss a bit of experience. This can personally be different per masseuse

But overall, beautiful salon, clean and tidy. Customer service was excellent
reviewList.author: Thirza Smolders

reviewList.text: A very nice place: beautiful, clean, and smells good. The staff is friendly. Before the massage, they gave me a questionnaire about what type of weight to choose. The massage was very good and pleasant. At the end, they treated me to ice cream and gave me a voucher. Thank you!
reviewList.author: Ая

reviewList.text:
Got the full body Thai massage with my wife and had a great experience. Was not the best looking place but the massage was conducted was very professionally. I’m a big guy and apt strength was used which provided me a lot of relief as well. Would recommend!

Price was very reasonable as well.
reviewList.author: Loh Kok Wee

reviewList.text: The best service and level of massage here. I lived in Thailand for 3 years, but for somehow they did it better here! Thin (10) made it for me, strongly recommended 🙏
reviewList.author: Maxim Vishnevsky (FATE)

reviewList.text: Very good massage and aftercare. Ate delicious mango yogurt and drank tea after. perfect way to relax after really busy day
reviewList.author: Vince Eslopor

places.name: Florin K Spa & Beauty Care - 플로린 K 스파 & 마사지
places.address: Tầng 2 Khách sạn WINK, 351 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text: Hands down one of the best massage experiences we’ve had. The attention is the best, from welcome drinks to post-massage drinks. We had a 90 minute aromatherapy massage and went back the next day for a 60 minute herbal ball massage where Summer and Sol took excellent care of us, and we couldn’t have asked for a better service. We highly recommend this place to anyone looking to relax during their trip!
reviewList.author: Hector Sierra

reviewList.text: Had an absolutely amazing time here! The massage was incredibly relaxing – I actually fell right asleep while getting worked on. To top it all off, we were treated to some really fresh, delicious juice. I've uploaded a picture from our visit, so be sure to check it out! Highly recommend giving this place a try if you're looking for a top-notch experience in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Parul Sharma

reviewList.text:
Update 9/25/26 : it’s been a couple of weeks now, and my nails look great still. The gel has not peeled at all!

I got cat eye nails done here it was super quick and they looked amazing. Everyone was so nice I walked right in and immediately got my nails done. I stayed at the hotel thst is connected and got 20% off and a free foot massage which was also lovely. Clean space with nice view and great employees! Highly recommend.
reviewList.author: D K

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful time at Florin K Spa & Beauty Care.

I had K Florin Massage. It hit all the right spots. It included stretching and acupuncture. I left feeling relieved and renewed.

The ladies were welcoming and very helpful.

Juices were fresh and delicious. I would absolutely come back to visit again.
reviewList.author: CTemp

reviewList.text:
Amazing experience. Everything from beginning to the end, services and atmosphere here was just too good.
My technician SUN was incredible, she took good care of me. we had a couples massage and the entire team was kind, professional and great at their service. All of them took amazing care of us!!
It totally worth it.
reviewList.author: Stephanie Barragan

attribution.name: Florin K Spa & Beauty Care - 플로린 K 스파 & 마사지

places.name: Caro Premium DaNang Hotel
places.address: Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo/499 ward, Street, An Hải

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Caro Premium Da Nang Hotel! The location is fantastic, with the hotel directly overlooking the Dragon Bridge. We stayed on a Saturday, so we had a perfect view of the spectacular fire and water show at 9 PM from rooftop pool and restaurant.

The hotel is new, with beautifully designed rooms, modern interiors and stunning river views. Everything felt fresh and well maintained. Check-in was smooth and hassle-free, and all the hotel staff were exceptionally kind, welcoming and helpful throughout our stay.

A special mention to the team for arranging a lovely birthday setup at the rooftop restaurant. It was a thoughtful gesture that made our celebration even more special.
reviewList.author: Bhanu Pratap Chauhan

reviewList.text: Intresting place and lovely to stay.. Doris and Joey have pleasant attitude and helpful.. We are Malay that looking for Halal Food, fortunately the hotel provide Vegen Food and it is delicious. Not so far is the Halal Malay Restaurant named Abdul Karim Halal Food.. The intresting part during our stay is to have Dragon Room which we could  see the firework from the Dragon Bridge all night during our stay without having to go out, This hotel facing Han river and it is great to have that view. Plus it is situated near to many attractive place like My Khe Beach and Cho Han Market. Very Satisfied.
reviewList.author: Mohd Syaiful Azrein Husin

reviewList.text:
Beautiful hotel with an amazing view of the river and Dragon bridge. Came for an anniversary trip and they were extremely accommodating and welcoming. Our room had all the basic amenities you’d need. Took advantage of their super fast laundry service because the humidity had us blowing through clothes. Breakfast buffet had a good selection. Rooftop pool and bar was one of our favorite places to relax.

If you’re looking for a premium hotel with excellent staff to match in the center of Da Nang, look no further!
reviewList.author: Orlando Dao

reviewList.text:
We travelled all the way from Tonga 🇹🇴
We absolutely love Caro Hotel, the rooms, staff and breakfast is amazing. Location was great, and is in a lively area which we wanted. Different for everyone but we didn’t think the outside noise wasn’t too loud. Lots of spas around and places to eat if you want to eat out. We moved to a hotel closer to beach for 3 nights and we couldn’t wait to come back to Caro to end our stay in Da Nang. Definitely recommend Caro Premium Da Nang Hotel and will stay here again when we return 🇹🇴 Thank you Caro…

The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, with everything I needed to make my stay enjoyable. Kaylin was particularly attentive and proactive in checking whether everything was okay during my stay.
The location was convenient, the view from the room 1108 was amazing.

Overall, I had a great experience at Caro Hotel. Good service, a comfortable stay, and a welcoming atmosphere. I would happily stay here again on my next visit!

reviewList.text:
This spa is beautiful with zen vibes and lemon grass aroma therapy. The staffs are professional especially Lisa the front desk staff. It is clean and I throughly enjoy my massage. You do have to tell them where you want to concentrate on the areas you want a stronger pressure. Lisa is super professional. My brother on the other hand said his masseuse didn’t massage his shoulders where he needed the most. He did ask to concentrate on his shoulders but the masseuse said ok ok but never massage his shoulders. He was disappointed for the price he paid. Same with my mom.
But I do recommend this location because it is clean and if you get a good masseuse it’s a worth the high price.
reviewList.author: H Pham

reviewList.text:
Calm and relaxing place, very clean and the massuese was very firm and pleasant. I got the 90 minute massage and 30 minute hair treatment. The price was very reasonable.

I would highly recommend this spa and would consider coming back when I return to Da Nang
reviewList.author: Antonio Villarojo

reviewList.text: My family have been traveling through Vietnam the last few weeks. This is our third massage and definitely our favorite thus far. The staff was friendly and courteous. reviewList.text: Loved our visit to Honey Head Spa! Such a relaxing experience and the staff were lovely and very attentive. They took extra care with my mum after recent dental work, which we really appreciated. We both left feeling so relaxed. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Eliza-Jane Young

reviewList.text:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Total bliss and SO close!**
If you're staying at the Four Points by Sheraton, you have to hit up Honey Spa. It’s literally just two blocks away, which was perfect because we didn't want to deal with driving or Ubers after winding down.
We got a massage and it was incredibly relaxing—exactly what we needed to melt away the stress. The therapists were amazing and the whole vibe was just super peaceful.
10/10 recommend if you need a quick, convenient escape. We left feeling like jelly in the best way possible!

reviewList.text:
We recently had the pleasure of visiting Zenith Spa during my trip to Vietnam, and i must say it was an incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating experience. From the moment we stepped in, the ambiance was serene and welcoming — soft music, calming aromas, and a clean, beautifully decorated space.

The staff were very professional, friendly, and attentive to my preferences. Me and my husband chose an aromatic full-body massage, and it was both therapeutic and deeply relaxing. The therapist had excellent technique, applying just the right amount of pressure and focusing on tension areas with great skill.

One thing I appreciated was their attention to detail — from the warm herbal tea served at the beginning and end, to the clean facilities and comfortable massage beds.

Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day of travel or treat yourself to a bit of self-care, Zenith Spa is highly recommended. Great value for money, top-notch service, and a truly tranquil atmosphere.

I also loved the little touches after the treatment. Definitely one of the best spa experiences I had in Da Nang. Highly recommend and will come back again! 🙏✨

Also, the combo didn't quite feel like a full 60 minutes. While I felt good afterward, the staff seemed a bit on a rush. Overall, still a good experience! 👍🏽

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience at Len Spa in Da Nang. The staff were extremely attentive, friendly, and professional from start to finish, which immediately made me feel comfortable and relaxed.

The environment is very clean, calm, and well maintained, with a soothing atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. I especially enjoyed the hair treatment and shampooing — it was incredibly relaxing, thoughtfully done, and not rushed at all. You can tell the staff really care about the quality of the experience.

Another big plus is the pricing. The services are very reasonably priced for the level of care and attention you receive, making it excellent value compared to similar spas.

Overall, Len Spa is a wonderful place to relax and recharge. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Da Nang and looking for a clean, comfortable spa with genuinely kind service.

reviewList.text: I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa and cannot recommend it highly enough. From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted with warm smiles and thoughtful service. The entire space features soft lighting, gentle background music and a pleasant natural aroma, creating an incredibly peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. I booked a full-body aromatherapy massage, and my therapist was extremely professional and skilled. They carefully asked about my physical conditions and pressure preferences, adjusting techniques perfectly to ease all my muscle tension and daily stress. The facilities are spotlessly clean, and every detail is well-arranged to make guests feel comfortable. After the treatment, I felt totally refreshed, light and energized. This is truly a hidden gem for relaxation. I will definitely come back regularly and suggest it to all my friends.

reviewList.text:
We had the most amazing experience getting foot massages as a family of 5! Everyone was so friendly, welcoming and accommodating, and the massages were absolutely fantastic.

They made the whole experience so relaxing and enjoyable, even with our three kids. The staff were lovely, professional and really looked after us from start to finish.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a great massage and wonderful service. We’ll definitely be back! 💆‍♀️💆‍♂️❤️
reviewList.author: Renee Pearce

reviewList.text:
I discovered the Nesta Celia Hotel during my trip to Da Nang. It is a newly opened, 5-star hotel that boasts excellent beach access and stunning room views. You simply step out of the hotel, cross one road, and you are right on Mykhe Beach.
The hotel features two swimming pools—one on the ground floor and another on the 16th floor. The 16th-floor pool is an infinity pool overlooking the ocean, offering an absolutely spectacular view.
The breakfast is among the best in Da Nang, with a wide variety of options that won’t disappoint; the Vietnamese pho, in particular, is quite delicious.
The staff are very kind and always check to see if there is anything they can do to assist or resolve any issues. In particular, a staff member named Mr. Henry(Le Van Thuong) was exceptionally helpful—when I asked to switch to a corner room with a more fantastic view, he promptly made it happen.
Thanks to Henry, I was able to enjoy a relaxing stay and create wonderful memories. I will definitely make the Nesta Celia Hotel my top choice for accommodation on my next visit to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Joohyun Han

reviewList.text:
My stay at this hotel was a very satisfying experience. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the clean, tidy, and tastefully arranged space. The common areas are well-maintained, creating a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere—an ideal setting for resting and relaxing after a long day of exploring or working.

The guest rooms are organized and uncluttered, offering an airy and comfortable feel. Essential amenities are thoughtfully placed, making daily routines convenient. I particularly appreciated the sense of privacy and comfort, which allowed me to rest well and truly enjoy my stay.

Furthermore, the service contributed significantly to a positive experience. The staff were friendly, enthusiastic, and always ready to assist. Their pleasant approach made me feel genuinely welcomed and at ease throughout my time there.

Overall, the hotel offers a memorable experience, characterized by a pleasant environment, well-organized rooms, and friendly service. It is a great option for anyone seeking a comfortable place to stay during their travels. I would certainly recommend this hotel to friends and family looking for a suitable spot to rest and enjoy their vacation.
reviewList.author: Nguyễn Đặng Thuỳ Trinh

reviewList.text:
Best hotel ever!! Location, room condition and especially swimming pool are all goood!! I also enjoyed the afternoon tea, and breakfast. Great food!!! Loved the seaweed soup with rice noodle. lol Thank you, Henry and all other staffs for the best and kind service. Wont forget!! :)

One suggestion, if there is a mirror in the gym it would be way much better!!
reviewList.author: Sebin

reviewList.text:
This is my second stay here after trying several other hotels in the area over the last two years, and I can confidently say this will be my permanent choice for all future visits to beautiful Da Nang.
The hotel is brand new, exceptionally clean, and highly organized, but what truly sets it apart is the outstanding service. I stayed on a high floor—the 11th floor, to be exact—which offered a spectacular, 180-degree view of the gorgeous coastline.
I highly recommend this hotel, especially their fantastic buffet breakfast. The entire breakfast team is wonderful, and while it is difficult to single out just one person because everyone is incredibly kind, I want to give a special shout-out to a young waiter named Van Thuong. He took care of my table over the last couple of days and truly deserves special recognition for his excellent service!
reviewList.author: Robert Tullberg

reviewList.text: The room was really spacious and the staff were very attentive and efficient. The room key electrifies the rooms so if you want to leave charging electronics when you go out, you must request for another key to leave in the room. Their breakfast buffet was widespread, with options of Korean, Japanese and local Vietnamese. The staff took their time to ask for your opinions on the food, the rooms and if there was anything you needed help with. The rooms were typical and normal for the price range, it was nothing exceptional. but what made the hotel great was the service and the staff attentiveness. We would stay again if we go back to Da Nang.

reviewList.text:

Interesting technic and different from Thai style.
You first get a herbal foot bathe for a few minutes, they dry your feet and you lie on the chair, with a warm herbal bag nicely placed at the back of your neck. And the staff will asks whether you would like to have a cucumber face mask (we didn’t go for the face mask)
The foot massage begins.
Towards the end of the foot massage, they use hot stones to massage your leg, and hot-pressed with a warm herbal bag and ends of using a warm towel to wipe off any massage oils.
Thereafter, you get a bit of shoulder massage.

reviewList.author: Yiqiu Shao

reviewList.text: I got a 120min hot stone massage and a 30 min shampoo. The massage felt great and the therapist made sure to check that the pressure was good. Although, toward the end of the massage when I had turned face-up, the therapist had her phone next to my head and I could hear it buzzing. The shampoo was great and included hair oil and a blow dry. With both services, I should have been in there for an hour and a half, but I was only in there for an hour and fifteen minutes. This all being said, the prices are very fair for the service.
reviewList.author: Fiona Collier

reviewList.text: Quite the nice place. They are really respectful. The massage was good and cheap. The menthol full body 1h costs 270k-290k ish. You get to choose the strength and areas to focus on beforehand as well as write what can be improved on the same form.
reviewList.author: Elias Al Alam

reviewList.text: Without reservation, they took is in within 20min. They also greeted us with great green tea. The massage itself was quite nice, yet to my personal preferance it was sometimes rough and unpleasent. The personale kept asking if everything is okay just in case. I enjoyed the treatment, will return and will maybe change my rating. Hard to tell from one expirience.
reviewList.author: Milan Toth

reviewList.text:
This was my first time visiting MEW SPA, and I had such a wonderful experience! I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The place was very clean, relaxing, and welcoming. All the staff were lovely, friendly, and polite.

A special thank you to My for taking such great care of me and making the experience so comfortable and enjoyable. I truly appreciate the excellent service.

Definitely a lovely experience, and I would highly recommend this spa. I’ll definitely be coming back! ❤️
reviewList.author: EVE FY

reviewList.text: The place is clean and comfortable, and the staff are professional, friendly, and welcoming. The massage was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep! 🥰 I’m really happy I came here and had such a wonderful experience. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Bee Hui Lew

reviewList.text:
Was exploring the area after the market, and chanced upon Mew Spa.
Went for the 90-minute relaxer package, it was good! Good midday freshening up and the massage (especially the shoulder & foot) was really great to relax the tense muscles from walking all day.
Would add Mew Spa to my list of places to return when I visit Da Nang again!
reviewList.author: Stan

reviewList.text: Really enjoyed our visit to MEW Spa. The staff were warm and friendly, and both the shampoo and massage were incredibly relaxing. We felt comfortable from the moment we arrived. They also let us leave our luggage there, which was a huge help and made the rest of our day much easier. We really appreciated their kindness and would happily come back next time we’re in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Benjamin

reviewList.text:
It was wonderful experiencing a foot massage after long hours of city exploration and shopping. Totally worth the value of money.
The masseuses were awesome at their job. Will visit again.
reviewList.author: Utsav Shrestha

places.name: Thera Healing Spa
places.address: St 83D, 83 Phan Thúc Duyện, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
We visited Thera Spa as a group of four adults and a 3-year-old, and all of us got foot massages. The technique was different from what we experienced in Bangkok and really good—finishing with hot stones was fantastic!
They were so welcoming with our little one, and she had a blast being accompanied by three super cute puppies during her massage. Highly recommend for families visiting Da Nang
reviewList.author: Karamveer Singh

reviewList.text: I just had the best service and massage I’ve had in months… they deserve 6 Stars. My Masseur Son Khuong was amazing.i will definitely be back.
reviewList.author: Rex Ellison

reviewList.text: Lovely staff, a pleasant and comfortable environment, and a great atmosphere. Low prices, and everyone is kind and sweet. An absolute gem of a salon!
reviewList.author: Настя Берест

reviewList.text: Very high-quality massage. The masseur is a professional. It's quiet, cozy and there are cute dogs
reviewList.author: Карина Заремба

reviewList.text: Excellent massage technics and skills. Awesome welcoming by the friendly staffs. Overall it was a great experience. Will comeback again.
reviewList.author: Kanniasilan Gopal

reviewList.text: Very honest business. 800k VND rate. The lady will come into the room one by one and you can change the lady 3 times before you make your choice. You've the option to start the service with a steam sauna. Then you'll be showered. For some reason, couldn't finish the job and was given 300k refund. The door man and reception staff are friendly and can speak simple Chinese and English. Definitely will come back to support again with such business integrity. Only cash payment.
reviewList.author: av wolf

reviewList.text: Compared to the shop next door, the therapists’ level is slightly lower(maybe little older), but skills mkre harder and the place has been newly renovated and offers some of the best facilities in Da Nang. It’s one of the top massage shops in the city.
reviewList.author: Yuru KIM

reviewList.text: It’s a great place. The design of the room is superb. I liked sauna. But massage and service is also on a high level. I was surprised to see masseur, full of energy, elegance and delight.
reviewList.author: Roman Kaito

reviewList.text: Amazing place !!! Don’t go anywhere else !!! 800k for the best girls and great relaxing place
reviewList.author: Armedguard

reviewList.text: Quality of girls isn't that good, but the service is very good and the staff are friendly. They smoke too much though. 800k VND
