places.address: XN. 387, 124 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: Had a combo which cost 700,000 dong (facial, hair washing, and full body massage) and got my nails done for 300,000 dong. Was incredibly relaxing and my hair felt amazing after! I also loved my cateye nails. Prices were reasonable, especially the combos. Very friendly service! Would recommend.
reviewList.author: Serena

reviewList.text: These nails are stunning and they capture the reference photo exactly! I totally recommend as this place is affordable and organized.
reviewList.author: Hanna

reviewList.text: Wanted something simple and she got exactly what I wanted.  very lively and clean place. The owner and staff are very attentive and bubbly. Can’t ask for more cuticles care are amazing.
reviewList.author: Ztin Bande (Tintin)

reviewList.text: Excellent spot and really good value. I had the hair wash with facial and it was excellent. They also did nail art for my 11 year old daughter based on  a picture that she picked off the internet. It was perfect and she had a lovely time. Highly recommend 🤩
reviewList.author: Margaret Heffernan

reviewList.text: Excellent massage! Very relaxing, good service and friendly staff. We really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommended! ❤️
reviewList.author: Vinishaa Sriram

reviewList.text:
An unforgettable, deeply relaxing experience!
I had such a lovely time at Herbal Spa Branch 2. From the moment I walked in, the staff was so attentive and genuinely concerned about every little detail to ensure I was completely comfortable. A huge shout-out and high recommendation to Q7 and Eira for their truly excellent service—they were professional, caring, and made the whole session feel effortless. To top it all off, they even gifted a thoughtful little token of appreciation with a delicious coconut snack and a lovely candle. I left feeling completely refreshed and cared for. Will definitely be back!
reviewList.author: Simone Phong

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My wife and I had an amazing experience at Herbal Spa during our visit to Da Nang. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm smiles and exceptional hospitality. The spa is beautiful, spotless, and incredibly peaceful—it immediately helped us relax.

We both chose the Herbal Fusion Oil Journey (Aromatic Anti-Stress Massage), and it was hands down the best massage we’ve ever had. I asked for deep pressure to work on the knots in my back and my extremely tight shoulders, and my therapist was absolutely incredible. She found every area of tension and applied just the right amount of pressure to release years of tightness without ever being uncomfortable. I walked out feeling lighter, looser, and completely pain-free.

My wife also loved her massage and said it was one of the most relaxing treatments she’s ever experienced. The therapists were highly skilled, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire session.

The service from start to finish was outstanding, and every detail made us feel like valued guests. If you’re looking for an authentic, professional, and unforgettable spa experience in Da Nang, Herbal Spa is a must-visit. We highly recommend it and will definitely return the next time we’re in Vietnam!
reviewList.author: Keng Ly

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing Dry Deep Bodywork Massage yesterday at Herbal Spa. Honestly, it was the best massage I have ever had.

I was so happy with the entire 90-minute session. Thuan was exceptional. She quickly understood my body aches, muscle tension, and problem areas, then adjusted the pressure perfectly to suit my comfort level. She truly has gifted hands.

The receptionist was also incredibly welcoming and helpful, and the thoughtful treat after the massage was a lovely touch.

I will definitely be coming back during my stay in Vietnam. I’m so glad I discovered this place. Thank you once again for such a wonderful experience. My body feels alive again. All the stiffness and tension are gone, and I feel completely refreshed. ❤️🙂
reviewList.author: Shivika Sharma

reviewList.text:
It’s our sixth visit to Da Nang and every time we searched for good massage, but none was good. Given our previous horrible experience with a lot of massage and spa place, we spent hours looking at reviews of each place hope to find a more reliable one as most of the reviews on google map are not genuine. We were also quite skeptical with this one at first as it also has a huge amount of 5 stars plus many one star reviews.

When we first entered the herbal spa, the receptionist was very polite and friendly, but the 3 out of 4 bottle of sample oil put at the reception lost their flavour. So we could only pick the one we can smell clearly. (Only negative thing I can comment on!)

Afterward we were asked to go to their store across the road which is the boutique one and we were quite worried at first. The boutique one is newer and cleaner. The therapists brought us up and they were very clear about the procedure and checked on us regularly to ensure the massage was comfortable.

The best I want to highlight is their pressure and the accuracy of the places they massage. They really know what they are doing and maintain good suitable pressure throughout without just rubbing your skin which happened in many many spa / massage place in Da Nang.

Both therapists are very professional and give very relaxing massage. That was the first time I have such a good massage in the past few years as well as all my visits to Da Nang.

Highly recommend the Herbal massage boutique.

Lastly the snacks at the end are bonus. The price is exactly the same as what they said during our booking online which I really have to clarify. No additional fee (at least for us). Hope that helps !
reviewList.author: Ric F

reviewList.text:
An amazing spa experience! Highly recommend the "Personalized Journey" ✨

I recently tried two massages at Herbal Boutique Spa, and both were fantastic!

The first one was "Shao Hua," using aromatic essential oils with hot herbal stones. It was wonderfully warm and relaxing.

However, the biggest highlight for me was the second one—"Personalized Journey"! The therapist customizes the session based on your daily bodily needs, blending various techniques. I've been to many massage places, but the care and gentleness here are truly unmatched. Their technique is so unique that it completely melts away all your fatigue from the inside out.

In particular, their acupoint precision is unlike ordinary tuina. It feels genuinely comfortable—not from brute force or painful pressure, but from being spot-on and perfectly balanced.

I strongly recommend trying this project. It tailors to your exact needs and helps you unwind completely. I will definitely be back! 💯
reviewList.author: Family Wong

places.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

reviewList.text:
Spa xinh, nv lễ tân và ktv 5/5.
This was all i ever needed after a sun bathing day.
Coconut body scrub, my skin felt so smooth and soothing after, facility here is clean and nice. Quiet atmosphere, definitely return monthly for this treatment. Bonus, they were so nice to my puppy, I was afraid that no dogs allowed, but my dog is well behaved and well groomed, we got the whole room for ourselves. Not saying that this is applicable for all kinds of dogs. Overall experience, I was supper happy and relaxed 😌
reviewList.author: Chelsea Truong (ADIDAS DANANG)

reviewList.text: Oh my goodness was this the best experience ever!! We were there for 4 hours. It was the perfect way to spend our day as we waited to check into our hotel. The staff were super lovely and incredibly skilled. It was so good - my partner fell asleep on 3 different occasions. We went for the gentle option and it was perfect for a relaxing time.
reviewList.author: Sophie White

reviewList.text:
Non Spa in the An Thuong area of Da Nang was an excellent experience. The location is perfect—right in the heart of the tourist area, making it easy to visit after dinner or a long day at the beach.

The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing. The massage was top-quality, with skilled therapists who knew exactly how to relieve tension and fatigue. I left feeling completely refreshed.

What I really liked was the balance between professionalism and comfort. It felt well-managed and consistent, which is not always easy to find in busy tourist areas.

If you’re staying around An Thuong and looking for a reliable and high-quality massage, this place is definitely worth it. Highly recommended.

Check my profile for Agoda & Klook discount links.
reviewList.author: Travel Maker

reviewList.text:
Absolutely incredible experience at Nong Spa! I did the three-hour spa package and genuinely loved every minute of it. The value for money was insane for the quality and amount of treatments included.

David at reception was extremely attentive, warm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived and really made the whole experience feel special. My masseuse, Phuong, was wonderful — so kind, professional, and SO, SO strong! The massage was amazing and exactly the kind of pressure I love.

I left feeling completely relaxed and incredibly well looked after. One of the best-value spa experiences I’ve had. Would absolutely recommend Nong Spa and especially Phuong!
reviewList.author: Ashlee Hurry

reviewList.text: One of best mistakes I have made in Da nang making a booking at the wrong place and found heaven instead. Did the body scrub which is a experience in its self. For a guy who has very oily skin it was great, skin the following days is still feeling good. The second part of the experience was 90 minutes Traditional Thai massage with no oil. I have been having massages for nearly 40 years due to professional sport, working  on the tools and my trade is one of the back breaking type I have had lower  back issues all that time. This is the second time in all those  year's  a masseuse has actually been able to adjust my lower back. I'm a heavy muscle person who has done  more damage to my body then the average person. This lady masseuse was so amazing with exceptional techniques that words dont do justice to. If you can handle the pain highly recommended this place. They are so good  I would  travel here every 3 months for adjustments way cheaper than Australia thats including flights and accommodation I spend over $600 a month on my back to still putup with pain. Best mistake I have ever made
reviewList.author: Murray Curti

attribution.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care
Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

reviewList.text: I came here for a body massage and got mani and pedi done! Staff are extremely friendly and they seamlessly guide you through the entire process. Wait time is minimal.
reviewList.author: Sylvia Huh

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience with the nail service at Sun Spa. The nail area was clean, comfortable, and all the tools were properly sanitized, which made me feel very safe and relaxed. The staff were incredibly friendly and took the time to recommend colors and designs that suited my style without ever being pushy.

The nail technician was very skilled and paid close attention to every detail, from cuticle care and nail shaping to applying the gel polish. My nails turned out exactly the way I wanted—beautiful, neat, and natural. Throughout the appointment, the technician kept checking that I was happy with the length, shape, and color, making the whole experience very enjoyable.

What impressed me the most was how gentle and professional the technician was. The entire process was comfortable, and the finished nails looked smooth, glossy, and high-quality. The prices were also very reasonable considering the excellent service.

If I visit Da Nang again, I will definitely come back to Sun Spa for my nails and recommend it to my friends and family. It’s the perfect place for anyone looking for professional nail services, a relaxing atmosphere, and outstanding customer care.

Thank you, Sun Spa, for such a wonderful experience.
reviewList.author: 도티짱

reviewList.text: I will definitely visit this place again. The staffs here are very friendly. I took thai massage and my therapist was super professional. Deserves more than five stars.
reviewList.author: Jun-Hyeong Kim

reviewList.text: Nhi is pretty and gets me great nail art!! I love her sophiticated art design. Next time, I will ask for her again . Thank you for your hard work!!!!
reviewList.author: ** Shin

reviewList.text:
Very nice , very professional
I like them so much . Thank you , Ms Nhi
reviewList.author: May Myat Noe Kyin

reviewList.text: I happened to be eating at Moc Seafood restaurant and then went to this massage parlor. There were four of us, and we chose the 90-minute full-body massage for only 380,000 VND per person. Because there were four of us, the parlor gave us a 10% discount and free drinks 🍹. I was very satisfied with the massage, and so was my whole family 😍. Everyone should try it out and experience the service here! 🤩🤩
reviewList.author: Как Тран

reviewList.text: Great service, the masseuse was so accommodating and the service was top notch! Would definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Koleen Juguilon

reviewList.text: The masseuses are in an expert level. They are so good!!! They give an extra effort in their work
reviewList.author: Mark Joseph Romero

reviewList.text: They were really kind and nice to us. I got a foot massage but they also did my neck and shoulder.
reviewList.author: 임혜지

reviewList.text:
3 stars for nail stylist and foot massage therapist. Not for the SPA.

I have requested 3 services.
Pedicure basic, shape care and cat eye gel pedicure and foot massage.

There are a lot of miscom.
Staff explained that pedicure basic is just cutting skin at cuticle and shape care is cutting toe nail.
Thats not my understanding.

Anyways, better ask everything beforehand. They charged me 470K VND for pedicure alone
reviewList.author: Khin Myat Noe

reviewList.text:
Amazing Foot Massage Experience at Feeling Spa

I had such a wonderful experience at Feeling Spa! 🌿 The foot massage was absolutely relaxing and exactly what I needed after a long day of exploring. The therapist was professional, attentive, and knew exactly how to relieve the tension and tiredness in my feet.

The atmosphere was clean, peaceful, and comfortable, making it easy to completely relax. The massage was the perfect balance of gentle and firm pressure, and I felt refreshed and energized afterward.

If you’re looking for a great place to relax and treat yourself, I highly recommend Feeling Spa. The service was excellent, the experience was relaxing, and I would definitely come back again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: Nie Ny

reviewList.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Feeling Spa!

After trying other massage salons in Da Nang, I was still looking for a truly professional deep massage that could relieve the tension in my back, neck, and shoulders. I'm so happy I finally found this place!

The massage therapist was incredibly skilled, attentive, and dedicated to her work. She used excellent deep tissue techniques, including firm pressure with her elbows, and really focused on the tense muscles in my back and shoulders. It was exactly the kind of massage I had been looking for!

After the session, I felt so much better, with significant relief from the muscle tension that had been bothering me for several days.

This place deserves much more attention! If you're looking for a high-quality, professional massage in Da Nang, I highly recommend Feeling Spa. I'll definitely be coming back!

Thank you so much for the wonderful experience!
reviewList.author: Nikita Romanov

reviewList.text: The best massage I’ve ever had
reviewList.author: starsandcenturies

reviewList.text: The spa is designed with warm tones, looking very luxurious and clean. What I like the most is that the beds here are comfortable, and the bed sheets and towels smell nice, not musty like other places I've been. Big plus for the cleanliness. ...
reviewList.author: Minh Phan

reviewList.text: A wonderful experience! The spa ambiance was incredibly elegant, filled with the scent of herbs, and deeply relaxing. The staff were enthusiastic, the technicians were highly skilled, and I felt completely at ease after the treatment.
reviewList.author: Dung Thuỳ

places.name: Rosa Spa & Massage Da Nang
places.address: 16 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
Our family of four had a wonderful experience today at Rosa Spa Da Nang! We all got the full body treatment, including the head, legs, feet, and shoulder massage, and every single one of us left feeling completely relaxed.
​What really stood out to us was how incredibly accommodating and helpful the staff were with our son, who is in a wheelchair. They made sure he was perfectly comfortable and went above and beyond to ensure he had a great experience.
​A special shoutout to Lant, who gave me my massage she was so nice, professional, and provided excellent service!
​If you are looking for a high-quality massage with fantastic, caring service in Da Nang, this is the place to go. We will definitely be back!
reviewList.author: HolidayVybz

reviewList.text:
My friends and I are visitors from Thailand, and we were very impressed with the service! The staff were so lovely, friendly, and attentive. The service was excellent, and we truly enjoyed our experience.

If we have the chance to visit Vietnam again, we will definitely come back!

Thank you so much for the wonderful experience. Highly recommended! ❤️🇹🇭🇻🇳
reviewList.author: Cat Zaza

reviewList.text: The staff provided excellent service, and the spa was very relaxing. I really enjoyed it and loved the experience. I will definitely come back again!🌷🩷
reviewList.author: aonzaja krataithong

reviewList.text: Honestly surprised this place has such a high rating, was expecting it to at least come close to a 4 star but wasn’t even close to this. Front reception was nice enough, had some tea but from there it seemed to have all gone downhill .. we were brought into the massage room and told to change into the gown together in that room. The lights stayed on throughout the treatment and all I could hear was noise from outside. All I kept thinking about was how we made a mistake coming here. The treatment itself was below average , not a good massage, not a good wash, felt my hair being pulled the entire time and you can tell the girls just did not want to be there. All that for 500,000. Had much better services at other places for a better price , save yourself the money and time !!
reviewList.author: Leda Kasas

reviewList.text: Very good massage. Tring gave very good massage. Ginger sweet snacks was meh but tea is good. Head massage by Tring is very good. Hot towel rub, massage, hot stone massage.
reviewList.author: jamie chua

reviewList.text: We went to this spa multiple times during our stay in Da Nang. They were able to cater our family size of 8 with elderly and kids. The kids also love the kids massage and shampoo. The place is clean and neat. Nga (the manager) is friendly. We needed a bit of Google Translate, but everything is very dry good. Except the first visit, we always WhatsApp and pre booked the services and responses are quick.
reviewList.author: homa cheng

reviewList.text:
Xuan, Nga are very fun to be around. They welcomed me entusiastically and friendly. nguyen the massagist is good too and has a good personality. Though she was called from.outside and is not a regular employee

The prices are about average, the spa is super clean and has good snacks.
reviewList.author: M Gottardo

reviewList.text: It was an excellent spa experience! I chose head spa which includes facial care. My partner got body treatment. We are very satisfied with the very professional masseures! The staff member at the counter is super kind and warmly welcomed us. Thank you so much!
reviewList.author: leejiweon

reviewList.text: Had a 30min hair wash and it was incredible, can’t wait to come back!
reviewList.author: Aimee Short

reviewList.text:
If there were a 0-star option, I would have chosen it.

The entire experience felt disorganized and unprofessional. My partner and I had booked different treatments, yet the therapists seemed confused about our appointments. There was also no clear direction for the foot-washing process, and the setup felt awkward and poorly managed.

The massage itself was disappointing. My partner felt there was no proper flow or synchronization, while my foot massage was simply average and nowhere near what the excellent reviews led us to expect.

Communication was difficult as the receptionist spoke very little English, and we eventually had to use Google Translate. The treatment room was also uncomfortably warm, with a fan running because the air-conditioning appeared ineffective.

After 30 minutes, we decided to stop the treatment. Although the staff offered to change therapists or rooms, the experience had already fallen far below expectations. We paid for half the session and left.

Unfortunately, we won't be returning. There are many better spas in the area that are more deserving of your time and money.
reviewList.author: Jessrei

places.name: SUNBABY Luxury Spa & Massage in Da Nang
places.address: 222 Trần Bạch Đằng, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: My sacred place, the best spa ever. Good stuff and service. I am their regular visitor. And i love their cute little puppy 💔
reviewList.author: Altynay Aidynkyzy

reviewList.text: they are the best  massage i have ever experience in Danang, better to check them as they are Pro!
reviewList.author: Sofia Igmedio

reviewList.text: The full body massage was exactly what I needed. They really do the full body (feet, legs, back, neck, hands, arms, and scalp/face). Hot stones and everything!
reviewList.author: Aaren Szabo

reviewList.text: Staff attitude not bad, however skill is not good. Went for wash hair but never will go there again because after done and comb my hair still stuck very bad.
reviewList.author: Jeannie Goh

reviewList.text: Having the hair massage here. The staff really professional. Feel relaxed till I fall sleep. Recommend!
reviewList.author: jenny

reviewList.text: Today I just completed having had a hot stone massage from "Ni"  who freelances with Yuni spa and it was one of the best I've had since I've been in Da Nang for the past week! She wasn't too firm or rough and wasn't just "going through the motions" even though it seemed as if she was a last min call to assist myself and my wife who showed up without a reservation. My wife had the 4-hands hot stone massage which is why we needed an additional masseuse and "enter Ni." The prices are very reasonable already and Yuni spa will sometimes give discounts to drive in business. It's so much competition out the but Yuni spa clearly has separated itself as a reputable and quality massage parlor. Don't miss out on getting a great massage if you come to Da Nang! It's located right beside our Stella Maris hotel, not 100 yards, or 300 feet, or about 91.44 meters away. It's so convenient and affordable that I've already made arrangements to come back again tomorrow!
reviewList.author: James Salter

reviewList.text:
Meh don’t expect too much, got my nails done here with a slight design. It felt quite rushed even though I was there for a bit over an hour. Nail tech kept going on her phone throughout.

Asked for thin silver lines which was done however didn’t bother to clean silver sparkles from the rest of my nails which looks quite messy. Also didn’t bring the polish down to my cuticles which is kind of disappointing.

Anyways not terrible for the price, lady at the front was sweet.
reviewList.author: Kathryn Farah

reviewList.text: had a wonderful experience at Yuni Spa! The service was excellent, the staff were very kind and professional, and the atmosphere was super relaxing. Prices are very affordable compared to many other places, which makes it easy to come back often. I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for quality treatments at a great value!
reviewList.author: Nikola Djukic

reviewList.text: My công chúa and I had an amazing time at Yuni Spa!!! Both of us were pampered very nicely. We will definitely will be back! Cam On!!!

reviewList.text: I had a really great time here. The staff were really friendly. The shampoo and massage was wonderful and my manicure came out great.
reviewList.author: Riza M

reviewList.text: This is a new establishment that took over the old spa in a very local estate.  Its called A.Trynh now. Very friendly and enthusiastic staff who are willing to accommodate to your nail requirements. Reasonably priced and clean environment.
reviewList.author: Lay Si Chew

reviewList.text: They did such an amazing job on my nails! 💅 The technicians are super skilled, the service is excellent, and the prices are really affordable. I absolutely love my nails! 💕 Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Ye Ye

reviewList.text:
At first, this spa looks very clean, and I had an enjoyable 60-minute session here. The masseuse was excellent, she understood exactly how much pressure my body could handle and adjusted her technique perfectly.

Although it’s a new spa, the service is incredible. They even served me a lovely tea after the massage.

This place will definitely be on my favorite spa list when I return to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Snow Dau

reviewList.text: It's a small shop, but it offers great service. I had a 60-minute foot massage, and it came with a hot stone massage, too! It was very relaxing, and I was falling asleep! I will definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Moé Okada

reviewList.text:
Super chill vibes full body massage, enjoyed every minute of the massage. The massage therapist knows every of my 'knots' and 'untangled' them. Super skilful massager
Privacy was definitely there for couples.
Recommend for any one looking for massage and spa at Danang area.
reviewList.author: Pauline

reviewList.text:
I have used the whole body massage package and facial treatment at this spa. I am totally happy with the services.

The sisters have taken care of me really really well ☺️☺️ Definitely get back to this spa.

Highly recommend 💕💕

reviewList.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A WONDERFUL FAMILY SPA EXPERIENCE ❤️

Our family of 10 visited this spa together, and everyone had a wonderful experience! 🥰 We each enjoyed different treatments, and we were all very happy with the services.

💆‍♂️ Some of us enjoyed relaxing full-body massages and foot massages.

🧖‍♀️ Others experienced relaxing head spa treatments and professional facials.

💅 Three of us got our fingernails and toenails done, and they turned out beautiful!

🦶 Two others enjoyed heel scrubbing and full-body exfoliation, leaving their skin feeling softer, smoother, and refreshed.

What we loved most was how attentive and friendly the staff were, even with a group of 10 people. Everyone received treatments suited to their needs, and the relaxing atmosphere made the whole experience even more enjoyable. ❤️

It was the perfect way for our family to unwind, pamper ourselves, and spend quality time together.

✨ Highly recommended for families, friends, and large groups looking for a relaxing spa day! We would definitely love to come back again soon ! 💕

reviewList.text: I had an absolutely wonderful experience here. The staff are very skilled and friendly. As for the space, don’t hesitate—it’s very clean and beautiful. I will definitely be back.

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience here! They very kindly accommodated my last-minute reservation and, since I booked a two-hour session, even arranged round-trip pickup and drop-off, which was such a thoughtful touch.

After 11 PM, the menu is more limited and the full head spa treatment wasn’t available, but I was still able to choose the shampoo service. The massage was very refreshing and relaxing.

One of the loveliest surprises was all the friendly cats and two dogs at the shop — they made the experience even more enjoyable! 🐱🐶

They accepted credit cards with a 4% processing fee.

Overall, everyone was so kind and welcoming, and I really appreciated how accommodating they were. I’d definitely come back!

reviewList.text: Came back again, and it didn’t disappoint! One of the reasons we came back to Da Nang was to visit May Healing Spa again. ❤️ The foot massage was so relaxing, and the whole experience was peaceful from start to finish. Always a great place to unwind. Still highly recommended! Special thanks to therapists #3 and #5 for taking such good care of us—they were amazing. And to the lovely owner, thank you again for your warm hospitality. We’ll definitely be back! 😊💆‍♀️✨
reviewList.author: JL

reviewList.text:
Fantastic Experience!
My time at May Healing Spa was such a lovely, calming escape, and their Nourishing Hair Wash 2 treatment absolutely blew me away. Right when I walked in, the staff greeted me with cold herbal tea and cool damp towels to freshen up, such a simple but thoughtful touch that instantly eased any stress I’d brought in with me. The space also has adorable resident cats wandering around, which adds such a warm, cozy vibe you don’t get at regular salons.

Before heading upstairs for my service, they handed me a custom preference sheet to fill out, which I really appreciated. I got to pick exactly how firm I wanted my massage, plus opt into extras like a facial cleanse and gentle ear massage—no awkward mid-treatment adjustments needed, every part of the session tailored to my comfort.

The treatment itself flowed beautifully. It started with a focused neck and shoulder massage that worked out all my built-up upper body tension, following the pressure I’d selected perfectly. After releasing all that tightness, I settled into a cushioned, comfortable recliner for the scalp wash. The therapist took their time massaging and cleansing my scalp thoroughly, with perfectly tempered water and zero rushed movements. The optional face and ear touches made it feel like a full-body relaxation ritual, not just a hair service.

By the end, my scalp felt deeply detoxified and my hair incredibly clean, light and soft from the nourishing products they used. The relaxed, floaty feeling lingered long after I left the spa too. Every detail here feels intentional, from the welcoming refreshments to the personalized consultation and attentive therapists. Between the soothing treatments, sweet kitties and thoughtful guest care, this is easily one of the best head spa experiences I’ve had, and I’ll definitely be coming back again.
reviewList.author: Tim Wong

reviewList.text: Tucked away in a side street is this cosy oasis away from the chaos of Da Nang. I had a healing shampoo treatment which was blissful and my hair feels amazing. The therapists provide a pre consultation checklist which allows for choices such as massage pressure etc. I would of come here for the shop cats and dog alone :) It was a wonderful experience.
reviewList.author: Paulii

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Amazing Vietnamese Head Spa & Foot Massage Experience! Highly Recommended!

We had a wonderful and relaxing experience at May Healing Spa during our trip to Da Nang!

We decided to visit for a traditional Vietnamese nourishing hair wash and foot massage, and it turned out to be a lovely way to unwind after several busy days exploring Da Nang and Hoi An.

The Vietnamese head spa was a particularly enjoyable experience. It was refreshing to have our hair washed while enjoying a relaxing treatment, and the whole experience felt like a little escape from the heat and busy streets outside. The combination of hair washing and head relaxation made it a great way to recharge.

The foot massage was another highlight. After spending the past few days walking around tourist attractions, exploring the ancient town and enjoying various activities, it was exactly the kind of relaxation we needed. Having both treatments together made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also appreciated the peaceful and comfortable atmosphere of the spa. It was a nice place to slow down, take a break from sightseeing and simply enjoy some time relaxing together.

One thing we especially liked was being able to experience a more traditional Vietnamese style of wellness treatment rather than just another ordinary massage. It added something different and memorable to our holiday.

Overall, May Healing Spa was a lovely addition to our Da Nang trip. The combination of a nourishing hair wash, relaxing foot massage and comfortable environment made it a very pleasant experience.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and looking for somewhere to relax after a long day of sightseeing, I would definitely recommend giving this place a try, especially the Vietnamese head spa experience!

Thank you, May Healing Spa, for a wonderful experience. We really enjoyed our visit and would happily come back again on our next trip to Da Nang! ❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
My girlfriend and I just finished a massage here, and it was a really nice experience. We went at night right before sleep, and even at nighttime the views and scenery were beautiful. Honestly, I can’t imagine how good it must feel during the daytime, it’s the kind of place that looks like it would be even more amazing with sunlight.

The environment is relaxing, clean, and well set up, and the overall atmosphere feels premium and calm. I chose an aroma massage in medium strength. It was relaxing, but for me it was a bit too light, next time I’ll definitely choose a stronger pressure and stronger aroma. Still, the therapist did a great job and we left feeling refreshed.

Overall, great setting, great vibe, and a very enjoyable massage. We’ll come back again and I highly recommend it if you want to relax with a nice view.

reviewList.text:

reviewList.text:
Words cannot describe how much we loved our experience at Reborn 🙌! We booked a foot spa along with a manicure and pedicure, and we could not be anymore satisfied with the experience. The foot massage is very relaxing and we loved the yummy tea, juicy watermelon and delicious coconut that came with it 😋. On top of that, everyone is extremely professional and provides top-tier services 💅.

My nail tech, Cam, was fabulous and I’m so glad that she was able to copy the inspo picture the exact same way it looked on my phone 🙈. Not only do I lovelovelove my nails, but I also appreciate the efforts that the workers went through to ensure we had a great trip 🥹! We had planned to watch the Dragon Bridge show at 9:00 PM right after our appointment the same day. However, I was still getting my nails painted at around 8:30 PM and we weren’t sure if we were going to make it because it was so late and my nails weren’t done. Yet, Cam sped through finishing my nails like a professional, so my nails were tea AND we were able to make it to the show 🙌.

The entire treatment was amazing and I absolutely recommend coming to this spa if you’re in Da Nang! Suong, the owner, is a wonderful woman and we had the best time talking to (and laughing with 🥹) her while we were there. It was such a pleasure to come to Reborn and I can’t wait to visit again in the future 💕.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting this beautiful new spa, and I can honestly say it was an amazing experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing the moment you walk in — soft lighting, calming scents, and a very clean, well-designed space that immediately makes you feel at ease.
The staff are extremely professional, friendly, and attentive. They really take the time to understand what you need and make sure you are comfortable throughout the entire session. You can tell they genuinely care about their clients and the quality of their service.
The treatments themselves were excellent. Everything was done with great care and precision, and I left feeling completely refreshed and renewed. It’s not just a service, it’s a full experience that helps you disconnect from stress and recharge both physically and mentally.
What I appreciate most is the attention to detail — from the hygiene standards to the small touches that make you feel special and valued. It’s clear that a lot of passion and effort has gone into creating this place.
I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for quality, relaxation, and a truly enjoyable experience. Wishing you great success — this is just the beginning of something amazing!

reviewList.text:

Their foot massage is so good that I literally go every day now. Super relaxing, perfect pressure, and the staff are always friendly.

Tried the full body massage too — amazing! I walked out feeling lighter and totally refreshed.

If you’re in Da Nang and want a great massage spot, definitely check this place out!
reviewList.author: Maneesh Sharma

reviewList.text:
A family-run massage parlor.
A very traditional local Vietnamese massage parlor.
You start by lying down, and the massage begins from the head.
They provide hot stones, aromatherapy eye masks, and a stomach warmer.
My husband and I both thought the massage was good. However, because it's a family-run place, we had a little girl with us.

The mother is the masseuse, so she often had to go find or scold the child halfway through the massage, making it difficult to rest properly and feeling disturbed.
The price is quite reasonable. If you don't mind your massage being interrupted, you might consider it.
reviewList.author: LI YING LIN

reviewList.text: The staff are enthusiastic, strong, and professional.
reviewList.author: Trang Le

reviewList.text: That time I visited the hair salon, I was very satisfied with the massage and neck and shoulder scrubbing, and since then I've become a regular customer! 🤩❤️‍🔥 The staff are incredibly lovely and always welcoming, and the owners are very hospitable. reviewList.text:
Absolutely incredible experience from start to finish. I had the full Signature Babylon package, and everything was perfect — from the beautiful and relaxing atmosphere to the professionalism and quality of the treatment.

The combination of traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy, hot stones, stretching, and acupressure was exactly what I needed. The therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and made me feel completely relaxed throughout the entire session.

The spa itself is beautifully designed, clean, peaceful, and has a very welcoming atmosphere. The little details, presentation, flowers, refreshments, and overall service really made the experience feel special.

I’ve had massages in many different places, but this was genuinely one of the best experiences I’ve had. Highly recommended if you’re in Da Nang and looking for a high-quality spa experience. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: can Keskin

reviewList.text: Had an amazing experience here! I went for the 90-minute Shampooing + Facial package, and it was pure relaxation from start to finish. The therapist was incredibly attentive and gentle with my skin, and the scalp massage completely melted away all my stress. The head, foot, and arm massages included in the session were a wonderful bonus. The place is spotless, peaceful, and professional. The complimentary dessert at the end was the cherry on top. Definitely a 5-star experience and worth every penny. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Daniel Dai

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After a long flight from the USA, my wife and I treated ourselves to the Babylon Premium Package, and it was hands down the best spa experience we’ve ever had.

From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality. The spa is beautifully designed and incredibly peaceful—exactly what we needed to recover from jet lag and start our vacation in Da Nang.

Our therapists were outstanding. They checked in throughout the massage to make sure the pressure was perfect and provided one of the most relaxing and therapeutic massages we’ve ever experienced. Every part of the four-hour premium package was thoughtfully planned, unhurried, and delivered with incredible attention to detail.

What truly sets Babylon Spa apart is the outstanding customer service. Every member of the team went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and cared for. You can tell they genuinely take pride in creating a world-class experience.

If you’re visiting Da Nang—especially after a long international flight—do yourself a favor and book the Babylon Premium Package. It was worth every penny, one of the highlights of our trip, and an experience we’ll absolutely return for on our next visit to Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Keng Ly

reviewList.text: This was the most satisfying massage parlor I visited in Da Nang this time! 👍🏼 I was so satisfied that I went for two consecutive nights. From the shampoo to the massage, everything was professional and incredibly comfortable. From the staff at the counter to the facial, shampoo, and massage, everyone was fantastic. I highly recommend it to everyone visiting Da Nang! 😌
reviewList.author: 周淳

reviewList.text:
It was so easy to book an appointment with them—very efficient and hassle-free! I had the Aroma + Hot Stone massage, and it was absolutely divine. 🥰 The masseuse was so polite and incredibly skilled. I had such a wonderful spa experience at Babylon’s 30 Ha Bong branch. ✨

The place is so aesthetic, clean and receptionist are very welcoming.

reviewList.text: The service was good. The therapist was smooth in their pressure and care. I'm so happy with their service provided. I had 2 hrs head spa with foot massage that run concurrently which means 2 masseur massage at the same time. Will definitely recommending others if they visit to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Norma Ishak

reviewList.text:
This is definitely the best massage experience I've had in Da Nang! Highly recommend! 👍
The environment is clean and relaxing, and the therapists are extremely professional and skilled. They hit all the right pressure points and completely melted away my fatigue. Great value for money and service beyond expectations. Will definitely come back again next time in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Victor Leung

reviewList.text: Absolutely loved the massages here. We got the organic shampoo and foot massage. The masseuse were simply out of this world. Perfect intensity and they are patient. Everything from start to finish was perfect. The  place was very clean, private and perfect ambience to wind down after a long day at the beach. Do give this a try if you are here. They even offer free grab pick up or drop off if your hotel is within 5km vicinity. Truly stellar.

reviewList.text:
I came here on the hotel's recommendation, and I'm so glad I did! They offer a wide variety of treatments at very reasonable prices, and the massage was absolutely wonderful. It was so relaxing and refreshing!

reviewList.text: My experience was so wonderful! Came here with my husband and we both got pedicures. While I was getting a manicure, he went to get a massage and it was amazing! The staff is so nice and the location is very clean! I highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Ellie Bongato

reviewList.text:
I had one of the best massages I've ever experienced at Regal Healthy Spa in Da Nang! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and professional. The spa was spotless, peaceful, and beautifully maintained.
My therapist was incredibly skilled, applying just the right amount of pressure to relieve all my muscle tension. I left feeling completely relaxed, refreshed, and rejuvenated. The service exceeded my expectations, and the value for the quality was outstanding.
reviewList.author: WanderWithSpoon

reviewList.text: Have a great experience with my family. My wife having hair spa + foot massage, daughter having manicure, me aromatherapy massage. reviewList.author: Royston Chua

reviewList.text: Very nice establishment and high level of professionalism. My masseuse knew exactly how much pressure to apply and periodically checked to make sure I was okay. The massage itself was exactly what I was needing and left the room fully relaxed. Tea was provided prior and afterwards including a cup of yogurt as a refreshment. I would definitely recommend this if you’re looking for the perfect wind down to a long day.
reviewList.author: Danton Wong

reviewList.text:
We had such a lovely couples massage today! I had a 60-minute traditional Thai massage, while my boyfriend enjoyed a relaxing aromatherapy massage. We both absolutely loved it!

The massage therapists were amazing — so sweet, gentle, and professional. They made us feel really comfortable and relaxed. The receptionist was also super friendly and welcoming, showed us around, and explained everything. We were even treated to some delicious tea and little snacks, which was such a nice touch.

Everything was wonderful from start to finish. We left feeling completely relaxed and happy. We’ll definitely be coming back! Highly recommend this place! ❤️

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful stay at Golden Lotus Hotel, Da Nang! The hotel was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The staff were friendly, accommodating, and always ready to assist. Special thanks to Cindy for her excellent service, kindness, and attentiveness. She made our stay even more pleasant and memorable. We truly appreciate the warm hospitality and would definitely recommend this hotel. We would love to stay here again on our next visit to Da Nang! ❤️
reviewList.author: Liezl Dela Cruz

reviewList.text:
We spent 2 weeks in Vietnam and this was one of our favorite spots to stay. First and foremost, the staff is an absolute delight. From the door hops (Tony and Long), the receptionists (Rora, Lena, and honestly all the girls here), restaurant and bar staff, and the spa were all incredible. I wish I remembered everyone’s name to list because they all deserve their flowers.

The hotel is right by a beautiful beach that’s an easy walk over. Best to go at dusk!

You have to do the free cooking class when you come. Michael and everyone in the restaurant helped us make Bahn Xiao and spring rolls which was one of my highlights of the trip.

reviewList.text:
My stay at Golden Lotus Hotel Da Nang was fantastic, but what truly turned a great vacation into an unforgettable experience was the phenomenal service provided by Helen.
​From the very beginning, Helen set a gold standard for hospitality. Her dedication, warmth, and proactive care were evident in every interaction. She went completely above and beyond anticipating our needs, offering brilliant local recommendations, and handling every request with effortless grace and a genuine smile. Her attention to detail and ability to make guests feel uniquely valued truly set her apart.
​While the hotel itself is wonderful, clean, and in a great location, it is staff members like Helen who deliver world class service and make you want to return. If you are staying here, make sure to say hello to Hele, she is an absolute asset to the team and the heart of the exceptional service at Golden Lotus!

reviewList.text:
The Golden Lotus Hotel - I recommend it to anyone coming to Da Nang.  The staff are not only very friendly, but they are also so helpful and informative.

The breakfast is so unexpected....a huge variety of both Western and Eastern cuisine...the variety of fruits, homemade yoghurt, various juices, the Vietnamese coffee....all absolutely delicious!

Then the afternoon snacks...an additional plus.

The service you get from the moment your ride arrives at the hotel...the friendly porter to the helpful people at reception.  The great service of the personnel working in the restaurant..
All of them so friendly and helpful.

I will definitely recommend this hotel to all my family and friends.

reviewList.text:

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Fusion Resort Da Nang! The location is perfect, conveniently situated between Da Nang and Hoi An.

The rooms were spacious, clean, and well-equipped, with stunning views of the golf course and the ocean. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel at home throughout our stay.

The resort offers a great variety of facilities and activities. We especially loved the entertainment area, which has plenty of fun games for both adults and kids. The breakfast was delicious, with a wide selection of fresh, high-quality food. The spa experience was absolutely amazing as well!

Overall, everything exceeded our expectations. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Nguyễn Mai Anh

reviewList.text:
A lovely resort, but not quite a five-star experience

Fusion is a lovely resort with spacious, spotlessly clean rooms, beautiful grounds and a wonderful large swimming pool. The staff were friendly and the service was good throughout our stay.

Having stayed in a number of five-star resorts, however, I felt that Fusion fell a little short of what I have come to expect from a property in this category. Admittedly, my expectations may be higher than most, but while everything was perfectly adequate, the overall experience didn’t quite have that five-star feel.

The rooms, although generous in size and impeccably maintained, felt rather bare and lacked warmth, character and personality. The amenities were also quite basic, and there was something missing from the overall experience that I find difficult to put my finger on. Perhaps it was the lack of those thoughtful little touches that distinguish a truly memorable luxury resort from a simply nice one.

That said, the pool is absolutely lovely, and I can imagine this being a fantastic resort for a family holiday, particularly with children.

I certainly wasn’t disappointed with my stay, but I wasn’t blown away either. In fairness, I didn’t pay an exorbitant rate, so I feel the experience was reasonable for what I spent.

Overall, a pleasant and comfortable resort with plenty to offer, particularly for families, but for those accustomed to more refined five-star properties, it may not quite meet expectations.
reviewList.author: Kiana

reviewList.text:
We had another wonderful stay at Fusion! This was our second time visiting, and once again, the experience did not disappoint.

I personally love their bedding — it’s honestly one of the most comfortable I’ve experienced among all the hotels and resorts I’ve stayed at. I always sleep so well here!

One of the highlights of this visit was being warmly welcomed by Lisa. She truly made our stay extra special. She is always so lovely to chat with, takes the time to understand our needs, and goes out of her way to accommodate our requests. Her beautiful smile and genuine enthusiasm for making guests feel comfortable really make a difference.

A big thank you to Lisa (with a lot of love 💕 ) and the entire team for making our stay so memorable once again. We absolutely love coming back to Fusion and will definitely be returning!

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful stay at Fusion Resort Danang. The resort was beautiful, clean, and peaceful. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and the service was excellent. The salon has a clean and modern interior, creating a relaxing atmosphere. They offer a wide range of colors and designs, and the quality of their work is excellent—long-lasting and beautifully done. The prices are reasonable for the level of service provided. Whether you want a simple manicure or intricate nail art, this is a great place to visit. Highly recommended!

places.address: 286 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
We just concluded our 4 nights stay at M Hotel Da Nang and it has been a wonderful experience . The location was central and convenient, across the road from the beach. Shame that the hotel couldn’t have provided its own beach chairs and services as we had to hire them independently at a cost. Our room was modern, spacious, clean and full view of the glorious My Khe beach! 🏝️ The 2 rooftop pools had immaculate views - photo worthy at every angle.
Special mention to the manager on duty who greeted us on arrival - Donald . He is an absolute gem !!💎 he has been so helpful with navigating the hotel services, organising transport for our day trips and many more.
Nhi assisted us with check out and was also very efficient despite the high volume guests during the time. The drivers who drove us to Hue and Bana Hill were also very friendly and professional. Outstanding services from the bellman, waitresses, receptionist, drivers and laundry.
Small suggestions for improvement includes:
Please change reusable hard thongs to soft slippers as most other luxury hotel would provide. It’s more comfortable to wear inside.
Hair dryer too flimsy and did not dry effectively.
reviewList.author: Justin Cong

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel in Da Nang! From the moment we arrived, the experience was fantastic. All the staff were incredibly welcoming, friendly and accommodating, always going above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable and well looked after.

A special mention to Nhi, who was an absolute pleasure to deal with throughout our stay. She was so lovely, attentive and helpful, always greeting us with a warm smile and making sure everything was taken care of. Her kindness and genuine hospitality really made our experience extra special.
reviewList.author: Nikki Le

reviewList.text:
Location: Great location, within walking distance of plenty of cool spots.

Value for money: Unfortunately, I wouldn’t stay here again. It felt overpriced for what you get, and I’m confident you could find something just as good elsewhere for less.

Noise: We understood before booking that there would be some noise due to the hotel being opposite Maia and other bars. However, on rainy and windy days, there was a constant whistling noise coming through the windows, which clearly aren’t soundproof. It was particularly bad at night and made it difficult to sleep. We could also hear the neighbouring room every time they used the shower or bathroom.

Breakfast: The breakfast buffet was excellent, with plenty of options to choose from.

Staff: Unfortunately, this was another letdown. We encountered a handful of rude and disrespectful staff members. My partner and I are from New Zealand, and on several occasions, when entering the afternoon tea area or waiting in the lobby for the elevator, staff in these specific areas would talk amongst themselves or make coughing noises as we walked in. Whether this was intentional or not, it came across as extremely disrespectful and made us feel unwelcome.

Customer service goes a long way, and guests should always feel valued and respected. At the end of the day, without your customers, you wouldn’t have a business.

Overall, a great location and breakfast, but the noise, value for money and staff experience mean I wouldn’t return.
reviewList.author: Gaz T

reviewList.text: A huge thank you to Hoa and Chen for their exceptional service! Hoa went above and beyond to assist us with the shuttle transfers, making everything so easy and seamless. Chen was equally wonderful, incredibly kind, attentive and helpful throughout our day at Ba Na Hills. Both are a true credit to the team, and their genuine hospitality made our experience even more memorable. It’s staff like Hoa and Chen who make all the difference. Thank you both for your outstanding service. Highly recommend!

reviewList.text:
Absolutely beautiful hotel, we had an amazing 5-night stay in the Ocean Front Family Suite. The room was spacious, modern, and incredibly comfortable, with stunning views and everything we needed for a relaxing holiday.

The buffet breakfast was fantastic, the daily mini bar top-ups were a lovely touch, and the afternoon tea was a great addition. The rooftop pool was a highlight, and the staff were genuinely friendly, helpful, and attentive throughout our stay. The location is perfect, with the beach directly across the road and everything conveniently positioned nearby.

Before our visit, I had read some reviews mentioning construction and street noise, which had me a little concerned. However, we honestly found neither to be an issue. Yes, you may occasionally hear some noise, but it did not impact our experience or enjoyment of the holiday at all.

We absolutely loved our stay and will definitely be returning. Highly recommend no this hotel for anyone looking for a beautiful, comfortable, and relaxing getaway.

reviewList.text: Excellent experience. Everything beyond my expectations. The staff are very nice and friendly. Reasonable price. The drink and fruits after massage add a credit on the overall experience. Will come back to try another type of massage next time. Well done.

reviewList.text:
Just had an excellent **90-minute Bamboo Massage at Charm Spa Da Nang**. Easily one of the best massages I’ve had in Da Nang.

The therapist was very skilled and professional, with **exactly the right amount of pressure** throughout the session — strong enough to properly release the tension, but never uncomfortable. The technique was consistent from start to finish and the whole experience felt very relaxing.

The spa itself was clean, comfortable and well managed, and the staff were friendly and attentive.

I would definitely come back again. **Highly recommended if you’re looking for a quality massage in Da Nang. 5 stars!**

reviewList.text: I wish I could give them 10 stars. Every thing about my Vietnamese massage was top tier. I felt so relaxed during and after my massage. Highly recommend you stop in and take in some of the amenities and massages.

reviewList.text:
Did a Google search and found this place rather quickly. Three of us came for a 90 min herbal massage.

You are welcomed with a drink and fresh mango.

My masseuse Thuy was awesome. The pressure was a little strong at the beginning, but was quickly adjusted after I mentioned it.

I did not realize I had a lot of tightness in my shoulders but it was quickly rectified by Thuy's firm movements.

I am definitely a lot looser, less tense, and much more relaxed.

This is the best massage I've had in Danang so far. I've been to other "fancier" places, but the bells and whistles do not mean you get a good massage.

Before you leave your are graced with a parting gift of coconut crackers.

I've booked myself another appointment with Thuy. Very much looking forward to it.

reviewList.text:

Most of all, massage and facial treatment skills are much more than I paid ever.

I'm not sure how difficult it would be to make a reservation if you don't speak Korean as my wife (Korean) and I (not Korean) came here together for massages. Pick up/drop off (even to Hoi An) provided as a free service, and they helped to entertain our kids, tea, and other small snacks too. All for a very reasonable price, truly incredible value. We were very impressed.
reviewList.author: Devon Farmer

reviewList.text: I go a lot of places. To relax massage and beautify nails . I am very pleased both of these services.👍👍👍
reviewList.author: Ngân Nguyễn

reviewList.text:
Amazing from start to finish. We were welcomed with tea and nice smiles and then guided up a candlelit staircase to the massage room. There is a basket waiting for you with slippers and the nicest robe I have ever felt. Actually wanted one to take home. They wash your feel with lime slices and mint leaves prior to your massage
90 minutes of heaven and some hot stones that really help an aching back. She hit all the aches and pains not only with her hands but arms, elbows and knees. Very classy place and highly recommend
reviewList.author: Monica Garcia

reviewList.text:
A great place to do your nails or get a massage in Da Nang. They were very attentive and overall everything was well done and taken care of.
A little on the expensive side, we did face a few communication barriers.
reviewList.author: aswathy jacob

reviewList.text: Excellent service! I had the full body, shampoo and facial massage and it was fantastic! My masseuse was gentle and checked on me every few minutes to see if I was okay. The facility is clean and calming. For the value of the price, I highly recommend coming here.
reviewList.author: Mel

reviewList.text: I visited this massage place. After climbing the Marble Mountains and walking all the way back to the city, the 90-minute aroma massage was exactly what I needed. I feel completely refreshed. Thank you!
reviewList.author: 냐옹럽럽

reviewList.text:
We had a really lovely experience here from start to finish.

As soon as you arrive, you’re given spa slippers and welcomed by one or two very friendly staff members who bring you the treatment menu. There’s no pressure at all, so you can take your time choosing what you would like. It’s also worth checking for their Happy Hour offers, as they sometimes have 20% discount.

While you’re deciding, you receive a refreshing flavored water. Before the treatment, you fill in a short form where you can mention any pain, sensitive areas, or parts of the body you would prefer them not to massage. You can also choose between three different massage oils.

After that, you’re taken to the treatment room and given special satin underwear to change into. Women also receive a top. The treatment starts with a relaxing warm foot bath before the actual massage begins.

The massage itself was excellent professional, relaxing and very well done. The massage therapists don’t speak much English, but this wasn’t a problem at all. A member of the reception staff regularly checks in during the treatment to make sure everything is comfortable, so you can easily ask for more or less pressure if needed.

Payment is made before the treatment, which makes everything very easy afterwards. When you come back downstairs, you’re served another drink together with watermelon and a small biscuit, which is a really nice finishing touch.

Overall, the whole experience feels organised, clean, thoughtful and welcoming. The staff are extremely friendly and they clearly pay attention to the little details. We would definitely recommend this spa if you’re looking for a good massage in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: L VB

reviewList.text:
I had the 60mins hot stone massage with 20% discount as I came before 7pm. The massage is amazing and the price is really value for money for the service. Their communication on Whatsapp is also very responsive and clear.

However minus 2 stars as the masseuse kept leaving my room’s door ajar when I was half naked, exposed. There was also another masseuse who came into the room to take hair dryer, again when I was half naked. The lack of privacy made me feel uncomfortable.
reviewList.author: Diana R

reviewList.text:
Le Venin Spa was a disappointing experience overall, with an acceptable but flawed body massage followed by a genuinely uncomfortable and unprofessional hair spa.
Overall rating
•	was 3 star after the body massage, 1 star after the hair spa
•	Programme tried: 90‑minute body massage + 40‑minute shampooing hair spa.
Body massage
•	The spa asked me to fill in a preference sheet, but key requests were ignored: I selected lavender oil yet smelled strongly of coconut oil, and I ticked “no neck massage” but still received neck work.
•	Pressure was far below medium, many areas were missed (arms and thighs were barely touched), and the therapist often failed to locate or work on actual tension points, which suggests poor training and low effort.
Strange massage techniques
•	The therapist repeatedly tapped and rubbed my toes in a way that felt more like someone trying to start a fire with a stick than a relaxing treatment, and this happened three times despite my growing discomfort—comfort for her as she could use the least amount of effort to pass the time.
•	Having visited many massage places, this was an unprecedented and unpleasant technique that pulled me out of any chance of relaxation.
Hair spa and scalp treatment
•	The hair spa was the worst part: my scalp was scratched with nails continuously for about 15 minutes as if that was the main “massage,” leaving my scalp feeling hurt rather than relaxed.
•	Conditioner was then used as the main lubricant to massage the scalp, which felt odd, unprofessional, and not at all like a proper head massage.
Environment and professionalism
•	During the shampooing, another staff member opened the treatment room door and started chatting with my therapist while noises from outside kept coming in, breaking any sense of privacy or calm.
•	With so many more professional, and truly relaxing massage places in Da Nang, this visit gave no reason to choose Le Venin Spa again.
(VND 500K for 90-minute body massage; VND150K for 40-minute shampooing w/massage)
reviewList.author: marth

attribution.name: Levenin Spa & Massage Danang - 다낭 마사지

reviewList.text: New favorite spa, absolutely incredible! My partner has never been more relieved to find a masseuse that is experienced and can actually provide a deep massage to his standard. We both had very professional and experienced masseuses. I had the combo service with the facial, hair wash and body massage and it was heavenly. The service is exceptional, the spa cleanliness is the best we have found and the place is beautiful. Treatment rooms are comfortable and they have nice spa robes (underwear) for both men and women. We will be returning every week to make appointments with the same masseuses. 5 star places deserve 5 star reviews ⭐️
reviewList.author: Sierra Brown

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely worth it!

After trying several massages since arriving in Vietnam, I can honestly say Oani Spa is probably the best and most professional massage I’ve had so far. 💆🏽‍♀️

What impressed me most was how detailed the massage was. The therapist didn’t just go through the motions — she really took her time and worked on every knot and tense spot in my body. It felt like she knew exactly where I needed attention. I walked out feeling so much lighter and relaxed.

The massage bed was spotlessly clean, and the ambience in the room was calm, quiet and very relaxing. Everything felt professional and well thought out.

I’ve had some really good massages during my Vietnam trip, but Oani Spa has definitely set the bar very high. If you’re in Da Nang and looking for a professional, thorough massage, I highly recommend giving this place a try.

I’ll definitely be back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Paula W

reviewList.text: The staff was so welcoming, very easy to communicate with. The ambience was soothing and relaxing, which was so fantastic since there’s multiple spas on every street that are brightly lit and just don’t give a zen vibe. Very clean and aesthetic. But THE TREATMENTS, (I got the shampoo, body scrub, Aroma massage, and facial) were the best I’ve ever had, and I visit spas monthly at the least. I came back the very next day. The ginger tea at the end was so good too. Thank you so much ladies! I will be sending my friends I’m traveling with later tonight! I intend on trying out the nail services while I wait for them.
reviewList.author: Leah Alexander

reviewList.text: My husband and I got some pampering massages here.  The staff were nice and our technicians both had firm touches which was what we wanted. Place is relaxing and all is good except that I have to remind the technicians to keep the blankets on our backs if they are working on our legs.  Especially since we were right below the AC blowing at us at full blast.  So overall we both had a relaxing massage except for the cold air and my husband and I both ended up catching a cold.
reviewList.author: Dr. Mia Hanh Nguyen

reviewList.text:
Our experience at Oani Spa was absolutely outstanding. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality.
The spa is beautifully designed, spotless, and provides a peaceful atmosphere that immediately helps you relax. The therapists were highly professional, skilled, and attentive to every detail, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the entire treatment.
The massage and foot treatment exceeded our expectations, leaving us feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated. The level of service and care was truly first-class.
We highly recommend Oani Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang who is looking for a luxurious and relaxing spa experience. We will definitely be back on our next trip!
reviewList.author: Keyvan Keshtkar

reviewList.text:
The ambiance is alright. They provide iced tea before the massage, and afterwards, they serve iced tea, a bowl of porridge, coconut crackers & a cold towel. But even with 20% off, the price still isn't competitive, the massage technique has a lot of room for improvement, though I get that it depends heavily on the therapist. The poor therapist was nodding off multiple times during my session, I didn't want to be too harsh on her, considering it was quite late n she had probably been working a very long shift.
It's an okay option if u’r already in the area n desperate for a massage, but definitely not worth going out of your way for.
reviewList.author: Gerald

reviewList.text:
Excellent leg and foot massage with professional staff. Very clean premises.
Would highly recommend.
Thank you Mina for great communication and the cold towels, water and chicken soup.
reviewList.author: Fiona Clarke

reviewList.text:
Came here with the 4 of us and had a great time. I got the foot massage with hot stones. The therapist would press her hands onto the hot stones and massage my legs and feet with her warm hands. It felt incredibly soothing and the pressure points were just right. My legs and feet were exhausted going in but I walked out feeling totally refreshed.

The place was clean, the staff were friendly, and the congee afterwards was delicious.
reviewList.author: Liza Wong

reviewList.text:
We had an incredible experience here! After a grueling hike up Marble Mountain, my wife and I both opted for the leg and foot massage, and it was exactly what we needed. The facility was spotless, and the staff were exceptionally polite and welcoming.
Communication was a breeze—even though my Vietnamese is limited, they provided a clear English menu that made selecting services easy. The pricing is very reasonable for the quality of care you receive. To top it off, once the massage was over, they served us refreshing tea, delicious rice porridge, and coconut crackers. We enjoyed it so much that we came back a second time for a full body massage before flying back to the States. It was the perfect ending to our vacation!
reviewList.author: Trung Huynh

reviewList.text:
Walked in, appointment was available immediately. My massage was professional, and according to the fill-out form i got in advance. Got Drinks before and after, and a tasty porridge and refreshment towels after the massage, i booked the shiatsu for 90min.

Very good experience, can recommend. Mina Lyn is very welcoming and gives the Place a wonderful vibe.

reviewList.author: Samantha Lycklama

reviewList.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
If I could give more than five stars, I would.

From the moment I walked into Koi Spa and Coffee, I was greeted with the warmest, kindest staff. The energy was calm, welcoming, and peaceful you immediately feel taken care of.

I came during happy hour and received 10% off. I booked a 60-minute foot massage for 230,000 VND, and let me tell you I’ve been in Da Nang about a week and a half and have already had several foot massages. This one was hands down the best. The therapist was excellent, attentive, and truly skilled. A full 10 out of 10.

The massage also included hot stones on the feet, which took the experience to another level. And to top it all off, at the end I was treated to an iced salted coffee such a thoughtful and perfect way to finish.

All of this for under $11 USD. Affordable, high quality, and unforgettable.

This is officially my permanent spot while I’m in Da Nang. Highly recommend.
reviewList.author: Actress Lonnie Grant

reviewList.text:
