My 3rd time was a disaster! The masseuse was sick so i felt bad for her but she had no experience and was checking her mobile phone while doing the so called massage. I stopped after 20min and left. They want returning customers then they should pay attention to their therapist's training if new ones!
reviewList.author: D NV

reviewList.text:
Horrific Service, and this is coming from someone who is very tolerant, They only want one time tourist money, and do not really care about the experience.

I went for 4 hand massage, and the masseurs were unprofessional, slacked off and did not follow the requirements i mentioned on the form. Went full throttle hard mode on my body instead of clearly mentioned soft on the form.

To top that off the ground floor had noise coming in from the cafe and street the whole time, taking away whatever relaxation you could find with the already horrible massage.

Even after sharing the feedback all they could do is say “ so sorry”.

Unless you want to play dice with your money, you are better off going other places.
reviewList.author: Ashish Bishnoi

reviewList.text: Best massage shop nearby considering skill, strength control, sincerity of the massageist and price.
reviewList.author: 김태훈

reviewList.text: I’m a fan of Sen Tai Thu in Hanoi, so when they opened a branch in Da Nang I visited a few times and have been very satisfied each time. The quality has stayed at the same level as in Hanoi, and even the food tastes exactly like it does at the original location there. I’ll definitely keep coming back regularly.
reviewList.author: Khue Ho

reviewList.text:
Sen Tài Thu Đà Nẵng offers a truly rejuvenating massage experience, combining professional service with genuine care. From the moment you arrive, the staff greets you with kindness and friendliness, making you feel comfortable and at ease. Their attentiveness throughout the session ensures that you are well taken care of, whether it’s adjusting pressure, offering guidance, or simply creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere.

The massage itself is deeply relaxing, melting away tension and leaving both body and mind refreshed. What sets this place apart, however, is the thoughtful touch of serving food after the massage. The dishes are tasty and hearty—nourishing in a way that perfectly complements the wellness experience. It feels less like a spa visit and more like a holistic retreat where relaxation and nourishment go hand in hand.

If you are in Đà Nẵng and looking for a massage that combines skilled techniques, genuine hospitality, and a hearty meal, Sen Tài Thu is a wonderful choice.
reviewList.author: Min Min

reviewList.text: High price but no good service
reviewList.author: Kim Lam

reviewList.text:
As someone who’s pretty picky and a huge fan of therapeutic massage, I have to say this place was worth the experience. The therapists here are highly skilled, well-trained, and you can really tell they know what they’re doing—not just going through the motions.

What I liked most is that the experience feels complete. Besides the massage itself, the package also included body scrubbing, exfoliation, herbal soaking, and cupping therapy, which made it feel more like recovery than just relaxation.

It’s definitely not cheap, but personally I think it’s worth the price for what you get. Compared to massage experiences around Vietnam, I still think Da Nang isn’t quite at the level of Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi in terms of technique and variety, but it’s still pretty solid compared to many other places.

If you’re a hardcore massage fan and enjoy massages that leave you feeling like your body got a full reset, this place is worth trying 👍
reviewList.author: Tiffany Ly

reviewList.text: This massage is a scam. The massage was average. The price is higher than the neighbourhood massage. We bought a 60 minute massage and ended up with only 45 minutes massage as they included the shower time, changing time and stream time all together for one hour. This store is not honest.
reviewList.author: Ellen Chau

reviewList.text: Oh, it was the second wonderful massage in Danang after 2 weeks searching. The place is nice, clean, smells awesome. Oil+hot stone massage was 300k, and it totally worth it! It was gentle (as I asked), without awful poking and painful hitting like in so many other places. No one asked for tips (what happened yesterday next door in blue ari - can’t recommend that place absolutely). The oil here was fragrant and gave awesome feeling. Also they gave me a present bag of cookies, mango and tea, what was absolutely heartwarming 💐😍🔥
reviewList.author: YOURhimera

reviewList.text: An excellent place located close to the coastline, offering great value for money and high-quality service. A full-body massage cost 300,000 VND—a good price, especially considering it was the night rate. Furthermore, the interior and the level of service are far superior to other similar establishments. The interior is very beautiful, and the massage room is truly conducive to relaxation.
reviewList.author: Фёдор Ска

reviewList.text: Highly recommend! Such a good experience. I got cupping + body oil massage. Both felt really good, perfect amount of pressure. Literally did my entire body head to toe! Plus I got a gift at the end, along with fruit and tea. Overall a really good comfortable experience, I plan to come back 🤩
reviewList.author: Gabriel Garcia

reviewList.text: Had a whole-body massage and hair shampoo. It was great! The massage was my favorite. It relaxed my body, and since I had a backache, it gave me great relief. The staff are accommodating, the place is clean, the prices are affordable, and the ambiance is calm. The fruit and drinks after the massage was also good. I would definitely come back and recommend this place. 😊
reviewList.author: Eriza Mariz

reviewList.text: Had a lovely experience here! The owner was very friendly and welcoming, the place was clean and comfortable, and the massage was really good. A thoughtful touch was the complimentary tea, water, and fresh mango slices served after the massage. Such a nice way to relax and unwind. Great service and a lovely little place I would happily recommend when visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Thewanderingislandgirl

reviewList.text:
We’ve been coming to this massage salon regularly, and every visit has been a wonderful experience. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, the staff are friendly and professional, and the massages are always amazing. I leave every session feeling completely relaxed, refreshed, and recharged.

One thing we especially love is that they’re pet-friendly, so we can come with our dog, which means a lot to us. We always enjoy our time here and will definitely keep coming back. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage and a truly relaxing experience!
reviewList.author: Настя Заяць

reviewList.text:
I had a 30-minute hair wash here and it was such a nice experience.

My hair was washed really well and I got a lovely head massage at the same time. The head scratches were probably my favourite part, they felt so good. The whole 30 minutes was really relaxing and I left feeling completely refreshed.

Pam was the one who did my treatment and she was so lovely. She was sweet, attentive and just made the whole experience really enjoyable.

Such a good experience from start to finish. Definitely one of the best hair washes I’ve had, and I’ll be coming back for sure.
reviewList.author: Rosi

reviewList.text:
We booked EMI spa the package, for a full-body massage. It was a great experience overall! My massage therapist( Mue)was very skilled-full while the massage wasn’t exactly relaxing (more of a deep, targeted treatment to fix stiff areas), it felt really good and effective.

Came with was perfect for soaking for the foot.

All in all, it was a pleasant and rejuvenating visit. I’d definitely consider returning, especially introducing for my friends from Singapore visiting to Danang. Considering to go EMI spa.
Therapist are very friendly and attractive. Who look for clean spa then should come to EMI spa. Highly recommended. I have been visited so many countries’ Spa but some spa not really nice. EMI spa is clean and nice massage. Price also reasonable price at Danang. Opposite of Han River. Nearby Dragon Bridge.
reviewList.author: August Zin

reviewList.text: My girlfriend and I had an amazing massage here today, surely the best we've ever had. The massage room was incredibly comfortable, and the air with inceresed oxygen felt so good that we feelt relaxed from the first minutes. The therapists were kind, attentive, and skillfull. We walked out feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and already looking forward to our next visit.
reviewList.author: Marek Olszak

reviewList.text: I got 30 minutes foot massage. Very good. The staff might not understand english well, but there is nothing google translate can’t do.
reviewList.author: Jovita Calista Romauli

reviewList.text:
Had a wonderful experience at this spa! The massage was excellent – very relaxing and professional. I really appreciated the small touches, like the warm pillows they place on your stomach and face during the session. They also offer a refreshing mango and delicious tea afterwards, which was a lovely way to end the treatment.

One thing I really liked was the questionnaire they give you before the massage, where you can mark the areas you’d like them to focus on and which ones to avoid – super thoughtful and personalized. Highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Диана

reviewList.text:
I tried a 60-minute body massage at this salon, and everything was handled with great care. They offered me mango and tea before the massage, as well as a form where I could fill out my preferences for massage areas.

The clothes provided for changing were very comfortable, and the private room was cozy. They even placed warm packs on my eyes, stomach, and under my neck, which added to the overall relaxation.

All of this for just 250k dong. I will definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Анна Якушко

reviewList.text:
Dropped in on a whim and loved our oil massages. I asked for soft pressure and the massage woman was perfect. I was so relaxed and ready for a nap afterwards. My husband also enjoyed his massage. Would highly recommend.

The price is very good and we felt like the facilities were also very clean.

They look like that have multiple store fronts on the street. I believe we went to the northern most one.
reviewList.author: Carolyn Kimery

reviewList.text: Came at 10:20am, there are colourful flower pots and garden greeting you plus light music and birds chirping. Massage room is clean, smells good. Front area has a few large sofa chairs. Some artsy decor. Had the one hour body massage. Very attentive, focusing on shoulders and back. Towards the end there was hot stone for the stomach area. It's new to me yet liked it very much. Recommended by Yulri.
reviewList.author: Dennis Ng (DFN)

reviewList.text:
Just finished 90 minute hot stone massage. I’m the biggest fan of massage in general, but it felt like the best massage in my whole life.
This place is so different than most popular spas around here - you get privacy, whereas in most places you may be put next to someone which doesn’t feel comfortable.
Lá Sen has such a relaxing atmosphere even before you enter the place - just when you step on the street. Quiet and calm, cozy lanterns all around, birds singing.

I made an appointment for 10am, Wednesday and there was no one else except me.

I was served tea and a sweet portion of mango. Then - filled in a little questionnaire on pressure&preferences. This usually means that the place cares about each customer’s needs. Also, chose strong pressure, I like my massages deep.

I got a warm foot bath in lime and lemongrass water, so it felt even more relaxing, I was already in love with the place.

My massage therapist, Tý (I hope I’m spelling it right), was amazing. Very gentle but strong at the same time.

Massage was deep and thoughtful, even with manual therapy which I love but can rarely find. Tý cracked my back in just the right spots.

Hot stone massage itself was great, too. It’s actually the first place where they also had a pillow of small warm pebbles for your head. Very pleasant feeling.

By the end, I was deeply relaxed and very grateful. A great way to start a day!
reviewList.author: Anastasia Kozii

reviewList.text: Had a great experience at Charm Spa! I availed their combo package with a full body massage and hair wash, and both were excellent. The massage was relaxing, the hair wash was so refreshing, and the staff were friendly and professional throughout. The spa was clean, peaceful, and a perfect place to unwind after exploring the city. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Cathy Rine

reviewList.text: I love this place! The staff, the service, the atmosphere, and prices for the packages are impeccable. If you get a therapist that you enjoy, ask for their name. By far my favorite is Ly (Lee) she focused on all that I asked. She worked out my lower back like I asked and fixed my ankle that was messed up from a trampoline accident. She noticed that on her own. Afterwards, they served watermelon, tea, and yogurt. That was delicious. All around 10/10
reviewList.author: Ken Pham

reviewList.text:
I had a deep tissue massage with V. She was amazing, very strong hands, just what I needed to get rid off some tension.
The place is very calm and make you feel relaxed from the time you step in. After your massage is finished, they will give you some tea, fruit and amazing home made yoghurt.
reviewList.author: Jerson Vargas

reviewList.text: Hi 👋, today I went to this massage center and had the 1 hour stone massage. Let's start with the environment, I must say that as soon as you enter you feel the relaxing, positive, silent atmosphere and the thoughtful girls immediately bring you tea ☕️, then the interior is set up very wooden so it also gives you the feeling of nature and Even the lamps have a great design and the lighting is adequate for a massage center. Let's move on to the massage 💆 which lasted 1 hour in a quiet room with two other beds but at that moment it was just me and my friend, it was the first time I tried the stone massage and I must say that I liked it and it was so relaxing and well executed that I fell asleep, only woke up when the girl asked to turn me over. The good, silent and professional masseuse. At the end of the massage the girls took us to a relaxation room where they offered us tea and fruit. Essential question in this massage center would I go back again or would I recommend it to some of my friends...certainly YES, I would recommend it and I'm sure that whoever goes there will thank me! See you soon 👋
reviewList.author: Roby Rosso

reviewList.text:
The massage was so professional! Nothing compared to the ones you find everywhere.
Might be more expensive but you get so much. From tea , to hot water for the feet, very nice massage (I chose the deep tissue one) and nice music and yogurt in the end.
Worth the price!! And the place is also so cosy , clean and nice.
reviewList.author: Elettra Arnell

reviewList.text: Such a wonderful spa experience! The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and relaxing. The staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional. Everything was handled with care and attention to detail. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely satisfied. Highly recommended! I’ll definitely be coming back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Meryem Zhari

reviewList.text:
The staff speak English very well and are incredibly friendly and welcoming. The massage therapists were also very kind and attentive, checking in with me throughout the treatment to make sure I was comfortable.

The facilities are beautiful, spotlessly clean, and offer a relaxing, private atmosphere.

Even though I walked in without a reservation, the staff welcomed me warmly and took great care of me.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend this place! 😊
reviewList.author: 박주희

reviewList.text:
My son and I each had a head spa treatment with Tam and Quan, and we both absolutely loved it! The spa is beautiful, and they picked us up exactly on time in a lovely van with the spa’s branding.

I especially appreciated that my son received the same quality of care and attention as I did, even though he is a child. Thank you, Tam and Quan, for taking such wonderful care of us!

The treatments felt amazing, particularly the upper back massage. My son also mentioned how lovely the products smelled and how perfect the temperature was throughout the treatment. The little massage after the hair drying was a lovely finishing touch, I would have happily enjoyed a few extra minutes of it!

There are a few things that could be improved. The offers of additional treatments felt a little persistent, both on WhatsApp and upon arrival. Also, while pickup was provided, there was no return transportation, which is helpful to know when planning your visit.

Finally, although I booked online, the 10% discount was not applied. I was told it was only valid for massages, rather than head spa treatments. Making this restriction clearer when booking would help avoid disappointment.

Overall, we really enjoyed the treatments and the care provided by Tam and Quan, but clearer communication about the discount and transportation would have made the experience even better.
reviewList.author: Carline Boisvert

reviewList.text:
Absolutely amazing!
Loved my head spa, massage & facial.
Service is top notch & they also included pick up & drop off.
I was in heaven the whole time. 😄
Would return in a heartbeat. 🤍
reviewList.author: Indy Hodgson

reviewList.text: I had an amazing 60-minute Organic Shampoo and Foot Massage session here! The organic shampoo smelled lovely and felt very soothing on the scalp. reviewList.text:
Overall Experience: 9/10 ⭐
The session at WELL HEALTHY SPA was incredibly satisfying – a perfect mix of relaxation and therapeutic relief. It definitely met my expectations, especially in terms of tension release in the upper body. I’d absolutely go again – the whole experience felt thoughtful and well-rounded.

Massage Quality: 9/10 ⭐
The massage was spot on – strong and targeted. They paid close attention to every knot in my back, and the head, neck, and back portion felt divine. The therapist checked in frequently to make sure the pressure was right. It's powerful if you want it to be, but always within your comfort zone.

Therapist Professionalism: 9/10 ⭐
The therapist was very respectful and skilled. They communicated clearly and often, especially about pressure preferences, and made sure I felt safe and comfortable throughout. You can tell they care about giving a good experience.

Cleanliness & Hygiene: 9/10 ⭐
Everything was very clean – from the massage room to the towels and equipment. The foot bath before the massage added an extra layer of hygiene, and the general standard was clearly high.

Atmosphere: 8/10 ⭐
The room was cozy and had a very relaxing vibe. Background music helped set the mood without being distracting. Lighting and scent were well-balanced. If you’re quite tall (over 1.90m), the table might be slightly less comfy, but otherwise, it was peaceful and well set up.

Prices & Value: 8/10 ⭐
For the level of service and overall experience, the price was fair. The whole thing felt like good value, especially considering the extras offered. Duration wasn’t specified here, but assuming it's a standard 60 or 90-minute session, it's well worth it.

Extras / Notes:
Nice touches all around – free tea before the massage, a relaxing foot bath, and even fresh mango and another tea afterward. That kind of care really enhances the experience. They also offer other treatments like foot massage, facials, and more.

Would I recommend it?
Yes – the massage technique is excellent, the experience is relaxing, and all the thoughtful extras make it stand out.

An unforgettable wellness experience with my boyfriend 🤍

We visited Renora Wellness Spa together, and honestly, it turned out to be one of the most beautiful and relaxing experiences we’ve had in Da Nang.

From the moment we arrived, we immediately felt that this was much more than an ordinary massage salon. The atmosphere is incredibly peaceful, beautiful and intimate — exactly what you need when you want to escape from the busy city and spend some quality time together.

Going there with my boyfriend made the experience even more special. It was so nice to put our phones away, slow down, relax and simply enjoy being together. Sometimes you don’t need anything complicated — just a beautiful place, a calm atmosphere and someone you love. 🤍

We especially loved the combination of the Onsen, sauna and ice bath. Moving between the warm water, relaxing sauna and refreshing ice bath was such an incredible feeling. It really makes you feel completely refreshed and recharged.

The massage was also wonderful. Everything was very professional, from the beginning until the end. The therapist was attentive and made sure the pressure was comfortable. After the massage, I felt like all the tension had completely disappeared from my body.

I also really appreciated the attention to detail. The place is beautiful, clean and very thoughtfully designed. The staff are kind, welcoming and genuinely attentive, which makes the whole experience feel even more special.

I think Renora is especially perfect for couples. You can come here together, relax, have a wellness day, enjoy the Onsen and sauna, try the ice bath and then simply spend time together without any rush.

For us, it was not just a massage — it was a little escape from everyday life and a beautiful opportunity to reconnect with each other. ❤️

If you are visiting Da Nang with your partner, I would absolutely recommend putting Renora Wellness Spa on your list. It’s the kind of place where you leave feeling relaxed physically, refreshed mentally and simply happy that you came.

Thank you to the whole Renora team for such a wonderful experience. We absolutely loved it and would be very happy to come back again together! ✨🤍 ❤️

reviewList.text:
I have received many different types of massages over the years, both in Korea and abroad. In Korea, I regularly purchase packages of 20–30 sessions because I genuinely enjoy massage and know what a good massage should feel like.

Earlier today, I had a foot massage in Hoi An that was absolutely excellent. Because of that experience, I decided to visit this spa even though it was more expensive, expecting an even higher standard of service.

I am currently staying at Wyndham Danang Golden Bay, and I chose this spa because it was conveniently located nearby. I have also attached a photo of the night view from my hotel, as this spa unfortunately became one of the most memorable parts of my trip to Da Nang—for all the wrong reasons.

When I first saw my therapist, I was a little concerned because she was very petite. However, I reminded myself that a great massage depends on skill, not body size, so I trusted the spa's standards and didn't think much of it.

Unfortunately, my initial concern turned out to be justified.

I paid for a 90-minute massage, but the therapist barely applied any pressure throughout the entire session. What made it even worse was that whenever I seemed to fall asleep, the massage would stop completely. As soon as I woke up, it started again as if nothing had happened. I paid for 90 minutes of massage, not 90 minutes of pretending to receive one.

I left feeling exactly the same as when I arrived. The entire experience felt unprofessional and completely unacceptable, especially considering the price.

Throughout my trip today, I happily tipped every staff member who provided good service because I truly appreciate people who take pride in their work. In Vietnam, I understand that tipping after a massage is common, and everyone in my group was about to leave a tip without hesitation. However, after this experience, I told them not to tip at all. None of us believed this level of service deserved any extra money. Tips should be earned through good service, not given automatically because it's the norm.

I chose this spa because I expected a premium experience. Instead, it was one of the worst massages I've ever had. I sincerely hope the management takes this feedback seriously because this is not the level of service customers should be paying for.

I cannot recommend this place to anyone looking for a genuine massage. There are many better spas in Da Nang that actually respect their customers' time and money.

reviewList.text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience – Unprofessional Service and Complete Disregard for Customer Requests

This was one of the worst salon experiences my wife has ever had.

My wife clearly explained that she wanted a light brown hair colour and showed the stylist a reference picture on her phone to make sure he understood exactly what she wanted. However, instead of applying the requested hair colour, the stylist proceeded with a bleaching process, which lasted approximately 30–35 minutes in total, leaving her hair with a bright ginger/orange tone that was completely different from the reference picture.

Throughout the process, my wife repeatedly told the stylist that she was unhappy with the result and asked him to stop bleaching. Unfortunately, he did not respect her wishes and continued despite her clear objections. Eventually, we had to stop the process halfway through because she was extremely uncomfortable and unhappy with what was being done to her hair.

What made the situation even more frustrating was the staff's attitude afterwards. Rather than acknowledging the problem, they repeatedly insisted that the colour was exactly 80-90% matching what we had requested, despite us showing them the reference picture again. They even tried to convince us that the colour only looked different because of the lighting.

To make matters worse, we were still required to pay the full amount, despite the fact that the service was not completed as expected, the result was completely different from what had been requested, and we were deeply dissatisfied with the experience. The amount charged was also higher than the price displayed on their price list.

We paid the full amount, not because we were satisfied with the service, but because the salon insisted on full payment.

A professional salon should listen to its customers, respect their decisions, and take responsibility when things go wrong. Ignoring a customer's repeated requests to stop a chemical treatment is particularly unacceptable.

We are extremely disappointed with the service, the lack of professionalism, and the way our concerns were handled. We would strongly advise others to think twice before choosing this salon.

reviewList.text: Trieu was wonderful at the front desk helpful right from the time we checked in making sure we had every facility available and known to us. The buffet breakfast is honestly one of the best  spreads that I have had in variety as well as quality. The location of the hotel is convenient as well. A couple of minutes walk to My khe beach and all the local convenience stores are at walking distance and one is just across the street. The amenities of the pools at the roof top and 3rd floor as well as the gym for the fitness freaks are well maintained. The roof top pool has an absurdly good view that will make you feel like you did something right in your life. We will definitely be coming back to this hotel
reviewList.author: Gaurav Mahajan

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Minn Spa! I tried the herbal hair wash and facial cleansing, and both were excellent. The service was outstanding, and the staff were very kind and welcoming. Special thanks to Le Thuy for her care and lovely attitude. Thank you for such a relaxing experience. I highly
recommend Minn Spa!

I would also like to give a special thank you to Cindy at reception for her kindness, professionalism, and wonderful service. She made our stay even more comfortable and enjoyable.
reviewList.author: Dr.Sheikha Aljuaidi

reviewList.text:
Great location, comfortable stay

We had a lovely stay at Cicilia Hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and helpful throughout. The location is the real highlight: the beach is just a short walk away, and there are plenty of local restaurants, street food spots and shops right around the hotel, so everything you need is within easy reach.

The only area that could use improvement is the breakfast. The variety and quality didn't quite match the rest of the experience, and a few more options would make a big difference.

Overall, a great place to stay if you want convenience and easy access to the sea and local life. Would happily recommend it.

reviewList.text: Had an amazing stay, perfect location, breakfast options were fantastic. Staff went above and beyond for us. Even celebrated my partners birthday with a surprise cake! Thank you so much to all the staff especially Vincent & Hong. We will definitely be back again.

reviewList.text: We had a fantastic stay! The room was incredibly comfortable and provided the perfect environment to relax. places.name: Da Nang Mikazuki Japanese Resorts & Spa
places.summary: Relaxed quarters, some with sea views, in a choice resort offering water parks, a spa & a bathhouse.

reviewList.text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at Mikazuki, The staff were incredible, so friendly, kind, and accommodating. They even tailored seafood and salmon options specifically for our tea ceremony, and went out of their way to do something extra special for our anniversary!
​The matcha class and yoga sessions were great, but the water parks were the absolute highlight! So much water everywhere, with fast, thrilling, yet completely family-friendly slides and rides. Our son also had so much fun playing in the kids' play area and loved the balloon animals, lion/dragon dances, and the ninja fire show!
​The attention to detail in the Japanese theme, decorations, and live shows is incredible, having ninjas around made it so much fun. The Fuji Mountain view and private wave pools felt like pure luxury. We also loved the authentic Japanese Onsen experience; they preserve traditional culture and rules so well.
​The resort makes everything effortless: the all-in-one wristbands for room entry and water park access were super convenient. Buggy rides, private beach access, boat rides, and kayaking made us feel truly pampered. Food-wise, the buffet was great, and on-site dining caters to all budgets. Plus, the rooms were huge!
​Highly recommended for families, you definitely won't regret booking here
reviewList.author: Furqan Mohammed

reviewList.text:
A great hotel and resort for families
Buffet breakfast had an abundance variety. Rooms were very neat, clean and new with great view of the ocean.
Kids will love the outdoor free pool, pirate ship waterpark and onsen
The indoor waterpark is lots of fun especially for kids aged 10 and above to enjoy all the rides.
Japanese indoor Onsen is very nice and beautiful.
Infinity pool on top floor has full view of entire peninsula of da nang with background misty mountain view (picture perfect).
Because it is a Japanese owned hotel, you can expect there will be no cutting corners or cheap amenities. Staff are fully trained to be very helpful, respectful and courteous at all times and facility is spotless clean.
Some downfalls for those travelling to da nang first time is that it is away from the main city centre (25mins) and not many restaurants outside the hotel in the area (more of a secluded resort for relaxation) but closer to ba na hills and closer to ancient imperial city of hue if thinking of travelling there compared to staying at the main city centre. Restaurants in the hotels are exclusive Japanese only and can be a bit pricier than eating outside.
While it is a bit more expensive than other hotels, you get what you pay for, and I would not hesitate to come back with the family (good for 2-4 day stay).
Overall it is a very impressive hotel.
reviewList.author: Vu Nguyen

reviewList.text: My husband and I stayed here for our honeymoon! It was one of the best resort we went in Vietnam :) so clean and everyone is so friendly! We also ate at the restaurant called Teppan KAEN! I highly recommend coming here for dinner! The teppan fire show and amazing food will blow your mind like it did to ours❣️ Loan was our lovely waitress and she explained and helped us make the perfect decisions for our menu! Tu and Truong was our chef and they had amazing showmanship and served us the best food 👌

reviewList.text:
Had a wonderful weekend stay at Mikazuki! The room was great, with a stunning ocean view.
The balcony even came with a lounge chair and a private pool overlooking the sea, perfect for relaxing.

Staff were polite and attentive throughout our stay.
Special shoutout to Nga, who served us during meals with such a warm and cheerful attitude. The food itself was delicious too.

We also loved that there were plenty of indoor games/activities available, which came in handy when the weather turned rainy. Overall a fantastic experience, highly recommend!

reviewList.text:

Everyone was incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming. In particular, the manager of the Hotpot Restaurant, Karen, was exceptionally friendly and attentive. We truly appreciated her warm hospitality.

Our room was clean, comfortable, and in excellent condition. The staff at the water park were also very kind and helpful, which made our family’s experience even more enjoyable.

We had such a wonderful time at Mikazuki Resort, and we would definitely love to visit again. Thank you to everyone for making our stay so memorable!

reviewList.text:
I visited this place today for both a massage and a nail service, and honestly, I had a really good experience! 💯💯💯

The massage was so relaxing. The therapist was incredibly thorough, focusing on every sore spot and working deeply into the tense muscles. You could really feel the care and attention in every movement. The pressure was just right, and she even checked with me to make sure I was comfortable and adjusted it when needed.

I also got my nails done here, and I’m really happy with how they turned out. The nail technician took her time tidying up my cuticles, shaping my nails evenly, and applying the polish neatly. She paid attention to every little detail, making sure there were no uneven edges or messy spots. I also appreciated how gentle she was throughout the process. My nails look so clean, and the design turned out really pretty! ❤️

What I liked most was how genuinely friendly and welcoming everyone was. The receptionist was especially sweet and welcoming, and the whole check-in check-out process was so pleasant. I also loved the welcome tea and the after tea, both were delicious and such a lovely little touch!

No pressure, no hard selling, just good service and people who genuinely care about their customers.

Definitely worth visiting. I’ll definitely be back!!!!!

reviewList.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at The Blossom Resort!

The resort is peaceful and quiet, which made it the perfect place to relax and unwind. The hot spring was especially wonderful, and we also really enjoyed the small swimming pool. It was cozy, clean, and just the right size for our family to enjoy some relaxing time together.

Most of all, the staff were incredibly kind, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay.
Especially sales manager Hai Dinh, Restaurant staff Tra My. Their warm hospitality made our experience even more enjoyable.

We had such a wonderful and relaxing time here and would definitely love to come back again. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Judy L

reviewList.text:
We had quite a few rainy days during our stay, but thanks to the wonderful staff, we were still able to have a very comfortable and relaxing time.

A special thank you to Tram and Huny at the reception for their kind hospitality!

We were also very happy to have our room upgraded to a villa. It was peaceful and quiet, and we were able to relax and enjoy our stay at our own pace. The hot spring was especially wonderful and helped us unwind after a long trip.

I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a peaceful and relaxing getaway in Da Nang. Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable!
reviewList.author: ちゃんりり

reviewList.text:
I really enjoyed my stay here! I love this place, the staff were very friendly and welcoming, and the room had everything I needed.

The only small suggestion I’d make is about sanitary pads. I’m sure they were probably available somewhere, as there were lots of thoughtful little amenities in the room, like a shower cap and other essentials, but I couldn’t find the pads. It would be really helpful to keep them somewhere visible and easy to find, since periods don’t always follow a perfect schedule and can sometimes start unexpectedly.

Other than that, everything was great. Thank you for a lovely stay!
reviewList.author: Анна Красненко

reviewList.text:
I stayed at this hotel during my trip to Da Nang.

One of the best things about this hotel is that it has hot spring baths ♨️
There are an outdoor bath, sauna, steam sauna, and cold plunge, which made it a great place to relax and recover after a long day of sightseeing.

For Japanese travelers and people living overseas, having a hot spring available during a trip is a really nice bonus.

The resort is surrounded by greenery and has a peaceful atmosphere, even though it is conveniently located in Da Nang. It is also a great place to simply relax and spend some time at the hotel.

The location is convenient not only for exploring Da Nang but also for visiting nearby destinations such as Hoi An and Ba Na Hills, so I would also recommend it to anyone planning to explore areas outside Da Nang.

The staff were very friendly and helpful. I would especially like to thank Quynh and Huong at the reception for their kind and attentive service during our stay.

I also had a spa treatment with Thuy and Duong — a 20-minute foot massage followed by a 5-minute shoulder massage. It was very relaxing and a great way to relieve some of the tiredness from sightseeing. ✨

I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to enjoy sightseeing while also having time to relax in a hot spring and enjoy a spa treatment.

Thank you to all the staff for making our stay so enjoyable! ♨️
reviewList.author: Sweetrip

reviewList.text:
The resort is nothing you could easily describe. First, you see friendliness at every step. The staff is trying their best to make you feel comfortable and at ease. The second, food is great. We focused on breakfast, which was included in our deal, but it left us stuffed for almost the whole day. The selection might not be as extensive as at a huge 5-star hotel, but it was so well-balanced that everyone would be satisfied.
The third, onsen, is small but cosy. As the Japanese tradition rules, you enter naked and leave cleansed both in body and soul.
As for the room, it couldn't be better. We got upgraded to a villa with a private steam sauna. We fell in love at first sight.
Last, but not least, every morning we were greeted by the amazing staff at the dining hall. I want to thank you personally, Tra My and Hue, for making every day with you perfect.

places.name: Red House Spa Massage & Spa - Da Nang

reviewList.text:
I really wanted to give this place 0 stars, but I’m trying to be fair, so I’m giving it 2.

First, the hygiene. The towels had an unpleasant smell. I also noticed used towels being put back into circulation immediately, with the next customer lying on them. This raised serious hygiene concerns.

Second, my therapist was changed three times during one session. Two different employees independently told me the therapist had a stomachache, but nobody could explain why there were two additional changes. Each new therapist had no idea what the previous one had been doing, so the massage felt completely disjointed.

The first therapist was looking at her phone. The other two were not much better. All three used very repetitive, jerky and rough movements. The last therapist kept asking “Okay? Okay?” every few minutes. The pressure was fine, but the massage itself was poor. At the end, she even asked me to leave a tip if the massage was “okay”.

I understand this is a very budget salon, around 500,000 VND for two hours. But there are several salons nearby offering much better hygiene, fresh towels, disposable underwear and better massages for only a little more.

The interior is also very tired and basic. The reception staff are friendly, but after a bad experience there was no compensation or real attempt to solve the problem. I was simply charged the full price and then asked for a tip.

My rating:
Hygiene: 1/10
Massage: 2/10
Interior: 2/10
Management: 0/10

You might get lucky with a good therapist, but based on my experience, I wouldn’t count on it.

If you want a cheap massage and accept the risk, try it. If you want consistent quality, I’d spend more elsewhere.

Not recommended.
reviewList.author: Christian

reviewList.text: My visit to Red House Spa Massage & Spa was truly wonderful! I've been visiting it for couple of months. The staff provided a top-notch experience, making me feel completely relaxed and refreshed, especially the masseuses Ting and Cham. Helped me to relieve my back pain. I highly recommend their services. 💆‍♀️✨😊

reviewList.text: My boyfriend and I had an amazing and relaxing experience with their four-hands massage, aroma oil massage, and shampoo service. They even gave us a 20% discount, a 30% voucher for our next visit, and a complimentary taxi ride back home, which was such a thoughtful touch! Definitely one of the best massage experiences we've had, and we would happily come back again!
reviewList.author: Hannah Rose dela Cruz

reviewList.text:
I honestly don’t understand the high rating of this spa.

I’ve visited many spas in Da Nang, including budget-friendly ones, and most of them provided a much better experience than Bana Spa. The place looks good online and in photos, but the actual service was disappointing.

The restroom was poorly maintained and did not match the image the spa tries to present. During the hair washing service, the staff seemed rushed and unwilling to properly dry my hair. They even accidentally scratched my face, which was uncomfortable and unprofessional.

What shocked me the most was that after the service, I was given a bottle of water that appeared to have already been opened and partially consumed by someone else. This is completely unacceptable from a hygiene and customer service standpoint.

Another concern was that after the treatment, we were encouraged to leave a Google review in exchange for a 20% refund. This made me question how genuine some of the reviews are.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I don’t want other tourists to spend their money here based on potentially misleading ratings. There are many better spas in Da Nang that offer better service, better hygiene, and a much better overall experience for the same price or less.

A lot of the reviews for this place are reviewers with only 1 or 2 reviews leading me to believe they’re fake.

It’s cheap, but you get what you pay for. It started out with a foot soak, where we pretty much had to stand in a little bowl of water. They were expecting us to sit on the massage tables but they were too high up so we were leaning against them. The shampoo I got smelled like chemicals and I could barely breathe. My masseuse did her job like she was upset at me. Like she came home after a long day of work and saw a sink full of dirty dishes she had to do as quickly as possible. I began to dread the massage that was next. To my surprise, the massage was slightly better than the shampoo. However, we asked (and paid for) an “aroma massage” but we only got a foot massage. My fiancé was left on the shampoo table and had to rest her head on the hard sink during her massage. At least I got a pillow. We left feeling sad and defeated. We usually tip at least 200.000 dong each to reward for their hard work and for the first time we left 50.000 each. Almost wanted to not tip at all.

reviewList.text:

The massage itself was also below expectations. The session appeared to finish before the advertised time, and the therapist seemed uninterested throughout. There was no greeting, no friendly interaction, and no thank you at the end.

Poor service and unfair pricing. I would not recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Chuan Lik Ng

reviewList.text:
I would like to share some professional feedback regarding my recent experience. I hope the owner can take this seriously and improve the service quality and overall environment for customers.

Firstly, I strongly suggest providing masks for staff to wear while serving customers. During hair washing and body massage services, the staff’s breath blowing directly onto customers’ faces is very uncomfortable. In addition, one staff member appeared to have a flu, cough, and runny nose while serving customers, and unfortunateIly i became sick afterwards as well. For hygiene and customer comfort, staff who are unwell should rest at home or all staffs wear masks while working or consultaion

Secondly, the ventilation and air-conditioning conditions need improvement. The fan was not functioning properly and was blowing directly onto my face, which felt unpleasant. However, when the fan was turned off, the hair washing room became extremely hot because the air conditioner was not working. It would be good for the owner to repair the air conditioner as soon as possible to provide a more comfortable environment for customers.

The hair wash area is quite messy, I also feel the cleanliness and organization of the shop should be improved. Towels were placed on the bedside table without proper arrangement, making it unclear whether they were for hair washing, body massage, hand massage, or foot massage. This creates an unhygienic impression.

In addition, the customer toilet was also being used as a shower area, and the floor inside toilet was constantly wet. This did not feel comfortable or private for customers. I would suggest having a separate shower/toilet area for family use and a separate toilet for customers to maintain professionalism and hygiene standards.

Another important point is the shop’s professional image. There is no proper reception counter, and family members were lying on the leg massage chairs near the main entrance during working hours. Customers can immediately see this when opening the main door, and it gives an unprofessional impression. It would be more appropriate for owners and staff to sit properly at a reception counter during business hours. If anyone wishes to rest, it would be better to do so inside a private room where customers cannot see.

Lastly, there was no drinking water offered to customers before or after the services. This small gesture is part of basic customer hospitality and professionalism.

I hope the owner can consider these suggestions seriously to improve customer experience and maintain better professional standards for the business.

P/s:

I purchased the Intensive Hair Wash service _ duration of 60 minutes.
I noted that face massage was not included, so I requested for face massage.
The staff informed me that there would be an additional charge of 25,000 VND.

I then asked how long the face massage would be. One staff member seemed ready to answer honestly, but another staff member stopped her and quickly replied that it would be 10 minutes.

Based on this information, the total service duration should have been 70 minutes (60 minutes hair wash + 10 minutes face massage). However, the overall service time was still only 60 minutes in total.

I hope the owner can clarify the service timing and ensure transparency with customers regarding additional services and duration. Professional communication and honesty are very important for customer trust and satisfaction.

📌The woman owner *kept pushing additional services* to my mother even after we clearly declined. We had to say “no” many times, which made us feel uncomfortable.

I understand recommending services is part of business, but customers’ decisions should be respected without repeated pressure.

P/s: khi khách nằm xuống là kim dài chỉ số 2,  nhân viên chạm vào mặt là kim dài nhích qua số 2 ít.

reviewList.text:
Walking past what feels like millions of shops that offer massages in Da Nang, Yuri spa truly stands apart amongst the small massage shops. The downstairs area is spotless and calming, immediately putting you at ease. The staff are warm and friendly, greeting you with welcome drinks that make you feel valued right away. Most importantly, the masseuse is highly professional — not like the substandard experiences you often find elsewhere making this spa a rare gem among so many lookalike options.

Highly recommend for
Shampoo and dry 30 mins - after a few days in the beach it’s good to have a thorough wash - you lie down to get your scalp thoroughly rejuvenated with a comb / nails feeling, I think it was shampooed twice and conditioner once then just a short pressure massage with fingers on top and sides and hair washed with the spa ring - this was upstairs followed by simple hair drying (don’t expect a blow out) at a dressing table - not lying down as in most spas and normally downstairs in the main area with a curtain drawn!

Foot massage 30 mins - this was downstairs in the main area - sat in a massage chair which many do not offer with reasonable air conditioning - a must in August! Feet were soaked briefly and massage with oil foot and up to the knees. Followed by hot towel to clean off the oil.

Body massage 60 mins - upstairs area - great pressure by the masseuse - starting from chest, arms and then legs and back.

Honestly, her smile is worth more than any massage. It’s the kind of warm, genuine smile that can make you forget all your stress, worries, sadness, and tiredness, even if just for a moment.

Sometimes, you meet people who remind you that happiness doesn’t always come from big things. Sometimes, a simple smile is enough to make someone’s entire day beautiful.

So, I have one humble request to everyone: if you ever visit this area, please visit this massage centre at least once. Not just for the service, but also to experience the warmth and positivity of a genuinely wonderful person.

Because sometimes, a beautiful smile can give you more peace than anything money can buy.

I have visited this salon for two services and spent about three hours there. It was absolutely wonderful! First, I had a hot stone massage. The therapist applied strong, even pressure, covering all areas properly and following the technique correctly. I really enjoyed the massage — therapist Nhung is a true professional. After that, I went to get a scalp treatment and hair wash with therapist Nuong — you should definitely go to her. I highly recommend the scalp spa — what I especially loved was that they use different stone massage tools on the scalp during the treatment. The therapist did an amazing job — I felt so relaxed! I would have liked to spend a little more time under the hydro-jet system where the thin streams of water pour down at the same time. Overall, the entire staff was very friendly, and they all took great care of my comfort. Thank you very much!

One small note: I noticed that the salon has many empty rooms, but for some reason my scalp spa was done right by the entrance. Next time, I would prefer to be in a private room for better relaxation. Also, it would be perfect if you could add a good comprehensive hair repair treatment, such as Kerastase, Davines, or Moroccan Oil.

My husband and I got a basic full body 60 min. massage. The staff were very welcoming and friendly, they asked us if we wanted to be treated in the same room or separate rooms which we thought was very considerate.
The massage itself was great, the masseurs were well trained,  and although the massage was thorough, sensual and relaxing, they were super professional.

We really didn’t know what to expect when we booked this place and were very pleasantly surprised and glad that we did.

Thank you!
reviewList.author: Goran (Globeflyer)

reviewList.text:
i visited last week, and the staff member who welcomed me was very nice and friendly. however, unfortunately, i didn’t have a great experience with the massage itself

i was assigned to tommy, and most of the massage felt rough and dry. he often used a towel on my back while applying pressure, punching, or stomping on it, with very little oil used throughout the session. i would estimate that oil was only used for about 20% of the massage. the overall experience felt uncomfortable, and it seemed like he wasn’t very comfortable or confident with the massage technique either

the following day, my back was sore, which i believe was a result of the rough, dry massage

i’ve tried several other spas in da nang because i enjoy exploring different places and experiencing their treatments, and unfortunately, this was probably the worst massage experience i’ve had so far. that said, i don’t think this single experience necessarily reflects the quality of the entire spa

i hope the management takes this feedback into consideration and improves the massage experience for future customers. the welcoming staff made a good first impression, so i hope the quality of the treatments can match that same level of service in the future :(
reviewList.author: jeps

reviewList.text: Massage was great and customer service was on point! The masseuse was amazing and made me feel very comfortable! A must visit!
reviewList.author: Hafeez Ahmed

reviewList.text: Very kind, attentive and professional staff. One of the most relaxing massages I've ever had. I would definitely recommend it.

places.name: LE SANDS OCEANFRONT DANANG HOTEL
places.summary: Contemporary rooms & apartments in a premium hotel featuring a restaurant, a spa & a rooftop pool.

reviewList.text:
Our 5 night stay at Le Sands was perfect.  Upon arrival from the Da Nang airport, Judy took care of getting us checked in and situated.  We booked a two-bedroom oceanfront room to accommodate traveling with my mother in law and the rooms were stunning.  The staff provided us with welcome drinks, a cake, and a fruit basket our first day.  The suite had two balcony areas overlooking the ocean, a washer/dryer, and a functional kitchen.  We didn’t need or want to cook, but it was nice to have all of the space and options.

My wife and mother in law really enjoyed the breakfast buffet, which was one of the nicest that we have seen.  In short, it was a great stay and all of the staff members could not be friendlier.  Judy especially went above and beyond to make sure we had what we needed for our stay.  The only consideration some travelers need to take into account is that Le Sands is located in the far north of Son Tra, which is a little far from the tourist center.  Good for us because we prefer quieter and more local action, but maybe less ideal if you are looking to be in the middle of the action.
reviewList.author: Justin Walker

reviewList.text: Le Sands Oceanfront Da Nang Hotel was an absolute delight for our 4-day stay. From the moment we arrived, the warm and attentive service made us feel completely cared for. Our room featured a spacious private balcony with breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the ocean and the Son Tra Peninsula, offering a peaceful and luxurious retreat away from the heavier tourist crowds. We thoroughly enjoyed relaxing at the stunning rooftop infinity pool and sky bar, and starting each morning with a rich, delicious breakfast buffet. Every member of the staff went above and beyond to ensure our stay was seamless and memorable—truly a wonderful choice for anyone visiting Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Meljim Reyes

reviewList.text: Wow! Great oceanfront views. Comfortable bed, excellent staff, the breakfast is varied and delicious. Location is a way from Da Nang city center, but close enough to be accessible via 10min ride share. I came in at 6am and they let me check in earlier (12:30p vs 2p) I'm very thankful for their concern for guests. I would stay here again next time I'm in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Sundy Macalinao

reviewList.text: Le Sands Oceanfront Danang Hotel is a true beachfront gem in Da Nang, offering serene luxury, excellent service, and top amenities. Located directly on My Khe Beach with uninterrupted ocean views and easy sand access, it’s perfect for sunrise moments and quiet evening walks. Rooms are spacious, modern, and very clean, with comfortable beds, quality linens, designer toiletries, minibar, safe, and reliable Wi‑Fi. The breakfast buffet is delicious, with both Western and Asian options, while the restaurant, coffee shop, and poolside bar serve great food and drinks with attentive service. Guests can enjoy a beautiful outdoor pool with ocean views, a tranquil on‑site spa, and a compact but well‑equipped fitness center. Friendly, professional, and genuinely helpful staff across all departments make the stay feel personalized and seamless. With its prime beachfront location, excellent facilities, and top‑tier service, this is an ideal 5‑star choice for a relaxing, high‑quality stay in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Yeung Beasley

reviewList.text:
We stayed at Le Sands Oceanfront Hotel from 28 August to 1 September as a family of three and had a wonderful stay.

The staff are what truly make this hotel special, particularly the gentlemen at the main entrance. They greeted us warmly every single time we came in or went out, always opened the doors and helped with our luggage. Their genuine smiles, kindness and attentiveness made us feel incredibly welcome. They are a real credit to Le Sands and deserve special recognition!

Everyone else we met (reception, housekeeping, restaurant and pool staff) was equally friendly, helpful and always smiling.

Our room was spacious and spotless, and the breakfast was 10/10.

Honestly, we have nothing to complain about. A lovely hotel made even better by exceptional people. Thank you, Le Sands! ❤️
reviewList.author: Mirabela Astefanoaie

reviewList.author: Felix M

reviewList.text:
This is based on my real experience.

First of all, it was really hard for me to choose a place to stay when I traveled to Da Nang. I chose this place randomly, but it turned out to be an amazing choice.

The staff were very helpful and friendly. They always said hi whenever they saw the guests, which made me feel very welcome.

The room was clean, cozy, and had a small kitchen. Everything in the room worked well.

As for breakfast, there wasn't a huge variety of food, but everything was delicious. And especially, I really loved the lovely smell throughout the place.

The only thing I wasn't really satisfied with was the lighting. The warm-toned lighting creates a very cozy and relaxing atmosphere, which I really enjoyed. However, it can be a little too dim if you want to do your makeup or take photos of yourself. The lighting around the mirror is the same. There is no separate light around the mirror, so it can be a bit difficult to do makeup.

I guess this is part of the hotel's style, as the overall atmosphere has a warm, dark, and cozy color tone.

- Location: Only a 7-minute walk to My Khe Beach.
reviewList.author: Thủy Ng

reviewList.text: It was an amazing stay!  From the moment you walk in, the hotel feels welcoming, with modern, clean facilities and a great atmosphere. The breakfast was absolutely amazing, with a fantastic variety of options and fresh fruit. The rooftop swimming pool was another highlight, perfect for relaxing, and the beach is just a 10-minute walk away. I would definitely recommend this hotel and happily stay here again on my next visit to Da Nang!

reviewList.text:
We stayed at The HEM 3 separate times as it is a great hotel not far from the beach. We have had our rooms upgraded several times, which is always lovely 😍
The rooms are well layed out and spacious, the beds are comfy. There are free laundry facilities there, you just need to buy detergent. There is also an onsite cafe which makes a great coffee.

Breakfast is great, there is lots of choice, egg station, pastries, hot food etc.

I had a serious medical emergency and had to organise an ambulance, the staff were great and helped as much as they could, I can't fault them.

All the staff have been great, they cannot help enough, especially Quynh and Minh, as well as the other women who's names I didn't get 😀

reviewList.text: Spent 6 nights in this hotel and we didnt have a bad thing to say. Was greeted beautifully along with a free upgrade to a big apartment. Clean, new and the most comfortable bed yet and we've been in vietnam for nearly 2 months. Service was on point and went far and beyond to satisfy us. I also ledt my real new rayban sunglasses on the bed when I left and then organised a grab to deliver them to my next hotel. Awsome place.

reviewList.text:
A Terrible Hygiene Nightmare: My 60-Minute Vietnamese Shampoo and Shoulder Massage Experience Note: (Unfortunately, because the lighting inside was extremely dim, it was completely impossible to take any photos as evidence.)
To be honest, the moment I walked up the stairs, I already felt very uneasy—the walls around the staircase were covered in mold.
Once inside, I was asked to lie down on a bed and told to take off my upper body clothes and put on their "beauty vest." I asked where it was, and they pointed to a basket. To be frank, the lighting was extremely dim. There were only two vests in the basket, and I had no idea whether they were clean or dirty. When I asked, the staff just said, "Yes, just put it on." So I put it on and laid down.
The service itself was subpar: they only washed my hair (and since I have long hair, it wasn't a pleasant experience) and briefly touched my neck—it definitely wasn't good. Plus, every time I breathed, I could smell a heavy odor of mold. Afterward, they blow-dried and combed my hair. Honestly, I have curly hair, but they used a large brush to comb it completely straight—which is pretty ridiculous.
Of course, I was extremely unsatisfied. I felt their hygiene environment was deeply problematic. The realization hit me when I took off the vest afterward and was told to "throw it back into that same basket." It hit me like a ton of bricks: Are you kidding me? This meant the vests weren't even being washed—they were just taken off by one customer, placed right back in the basket, and handed directly to the next person. That is completely unacceptable and crossing the line!
I told my husband we must never go back there again—it was just too terrifying. The entire place was kept so dim that you couldn't see anything clearly, but the mold on the walls by the stairwell was undeniable.

reviewList.text:

Combined with the soothing lavender oil, the treatment left my body feeling light, refreshed, and completely rejuvenated. The therapist was professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire session.

The spa itself is beautiful, clean, and peaceful, creating the perfect atmosphere for relaxation. This was truly one of the best spa experiences I’ve had during my trip to Da Nang.

I highly recommend Lee Spa to anyone looking for a premium massage experience. I will definitely return on my next visit! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviewList.text:
I rarely give any business a 1 star, but there will be always be the first for everything. I also understand how reviews matter to business here in Vietnam. The stars there would be for the staffs for being so friendly and nice. For the quality, if i could do -20 i would.

I dont get it why they proceed to hire a person that doesn’t know what they’re doing. My nails is completely crooked. Completely. Some of the nails wasn’t properly covered with the gel. Its bumpy after a top coat. The french is super crooked.

Dont go after me because ive already told her first time, i want a fat french. Said it in an easy understandable english as possible yet, she’s doing it as she knows best. Second, the french is crooked, i was looking at it and she goes to me like “Lady in” (to cure it). I was trying my best to see each work so that she doesn’t have to do that all over again, but she stops me. Anyway, shes super super nice but its just her work isnt the best or just to meet a minimum result. Not to mention aswell about the hygiene.

Also for the salon, bring the light. You need it if you offer some nails treatment. You need a bright light, not just a room with a massage chair and you make it for every treatment you got.

I paid 700k for this crazy little things, when i paid they asked  wether im happy or not i said im not but its ok. I need to eat and have a schedule to catch. It is what it is, bills paid for a complete crooked nails. Everything i said is true, and im trying to be as fair as i can to everyone.

Just go to a proper nail salon.

I left feeling so much looser and had less tension and more movement in my neck afterwards.

reviewList.text:
I went in for a 250d for 60-minute full body massage and specifically requested a female therapist. The room was very crowded with only curtain partitions. Unfortunately, I didn’t realize the curtain next to my bed had been left open until the session was finished, and a male therapist had been working right beside us. Knowing that I had been lying there uncovered with a male present made me very uncomfortable and was very disappointing.

During the session, the therapist was laughing and chatting with colleagues and left the room multiple times, which felt unprofessional. At the end when I was paying, she also laughed and gestured toward my bum . It came across as body-shaming and made me feel very uncomfortable. I’ve never felt this uncomfortable and I’ve been getting massages done for a long time.

The only positive was that the massage pressure itself was good.

reviewList.text: I wanted to experience a new spa and this one had good reviews,good prices and was right next to my favorite juice place. I was immediately greeted upon entry and seated with a menu. They also served me hot tea and yogurt before the massage.they wash your feet before your massage 👍👍. The place was climate controlled and there was soft ambient music playing. They also put a warm cloth over your eyes and behind your neck. The used hot stones on my back which was a first for me and I loved it. The massage was good along with some light stretching. reviewList.text: I had the pleasure of being a speaker at the Da Nang Global Business Summit in November 2026, held at the beautiful Furama Resort Danang.
