The meeting facilities are also outstanding, providing a wonderful setting for a successful business event. A truly memorable experience combining Vietnamese charm, luxury, and world-class hospitality. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Bao Tran

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Furama Resort Da Nang, thanks to Minh Nguyen, the Front Desk Supervisor. Minh was the first to welcome us upon arrival and immediately made us feel comfortable and welcome.
He took the time to explain the hotel’s services and facilities in detail and selected a beautiful oceanfront room for us. The room is amazing, and we truly appreciate his thoughtful attention to making our stay special. Minh was friendly, professional, and attentive throughout our arrival experience.
His warm welcome and outstanding customer service made a great first impression. Minh is truly an asset to Furama Resort in Da Nang, and we sincerely appreciate his hospitality.
Five stars for Minh! We highly recommend him and look forward to staying at Furama Resort Da Nang again.
reviewList.author: elena nguyen

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful stay at Furama Resort Danang! The resort is beautiful, with lush tropical gardens, a lovely private beach, and stunning ocean views. I especially enjoyed the infinity pool and the peaceful atmosphere throughout the resort. The breakfast was great, with plenty of options to choose from, and the staff were friendly and attentive. I also loved the resort’s mix of traditional Vietnamese charm and luxury. It’s the perfect place to relax and unwind in Da Nang. I would definitely come back again!
reviewList.author: Foodie Anna Let's the Flavors Speak

reviewList.text: The Furama resort in Vietnam Da Nang is perhaps the most incredible hospitality we have ever received anywhere in the world! The staff goes way, way, way above and beyond to make sure that your stay is impeccable. The food and comfort is second to none. After staying in resorts all over the world, I can honestly say this was our favorite! I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Da Nang to experience the charm of this beautiful property and the incredible hospitality. You will not be disappointed at all in any possible way. In fact, you will only wish you could stay longer! Love love loved it 🥰
reviewList.author: Jeffry Angelo

reviewList.text: Really interesting, impressive design with a lovely room I got to stay in! While the food is not the best and the resort is very quiet with not many activities going on (which can sometimes feel a little too dull), it is a highly recommended choice for anyone looking for a truly slow-paced, relaxing getaway.
reviewList.author: Lan Anh Vũ

places.name: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa
places.address: 5 Truong Sa Street, Ngu Hanh Son Ward
places.summary: Premium quarters in a refined beachside resort, plus pools, formal & casual dining, & a spa.

reviewList.text:
Pros:
Solid amenities- fitness center and restaurant options are great.
Breakfast is a sprawling feast
Staff are exceptionally friendly and helpful.

Cons:
The room is quite noisy with little sound protection - you can hear nearly everything that happens outside the room.
Woken up by our neighbors 3:45am alarm every morning :/
AC was underpowered.
Ceiling stains from prior water leaks.
Curtains let in a lot of light when closed.

Overall, it's a nice resort and compound. Safe, with good food and friendly staff. It's not however what you'd expect for 5 star (or really even 4 star) rooms.
reviewList.author: Nathan Barr

reviewList.text:
We stayed in a 3-bedroom apartment in Residence Block A and had a wonderful stay overall. The apartment was very clean, spacious and comfortable, with an amazing view of the sea.

The resort is especially great for families with young children. There’s plenty to keep the kids entertained — kids club, swimming pools, a sand play area next to kids pool, direct access to the beach, and even a mini zoo, which was surprisingly well maintained. Breakfast was also enjoyable with a good selection.

The only downside for me was the location of the gym. It was quite far from our residence block, and the route there was very dark at night, which made it a little difficult to navigate.

Overall, a very comfortable and family-friendly stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily return, especially for another family trip.
reviewList.author: J C

reviewList.text: Hyatt Regency  Danang was home for 5 Day holiday in Danang, Vietnam.  Large resort , very nice and had an ocean view suite, the suite was well appointed and very convenient, the one knock is the TVs are old and no casting or HDMI connections available, there was also no outlet on one side of the bed.  Other than that the room was good.  Staff were excellent and very friendly.  Food was good for breakfast and the restaurants we ate in were good.  The spa has a very nice villa setup and I highly recommend it.  From what I saw, it is the nicest hotel in the area, if I return in the future, it will most likely be my home on Danang once again.
reviewList.author: ManilaRich

reviewList.text: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa is an extraordinary beachfront retreat that delivers supreme five-star luxury from start to finish. Set along the pristine sands of Non Nuoc Beach against the dramatic backdrop of the Marble Mountains, the resort is a masterclass in modern tropical architecture, featuring expansive infinity pools, lush manicured grounds, and stunning ocean views. The rooms and suites are beautifully designed with contemporary elegance, offering spacious balconies, ultra-comfortable bedding, and opulent bathrooms complete with deep soaking tubs. Culinary offerings are outstanding across the board, from fresh seafood by the shore to a top-tier breakfast buffet, while the VIE Spa and family-friendly amenities elevate the stay even further. The service is impeccably warm and attentive, ensuring every guest feels truly pampered. The absolute only minor detail missing from an otherwise flawless stay is the inclusion of a bidet or handheld spray gun in the bathroom fixtures. Despite that single oversight, it remains a premier luxury haven in Central Vietnam that easily earns a full five stars.
reviewList.author: mahad

reviewList.text: Great resort with a beautiful ocean view! I originally booked a room with two twin beds, but they upgraded me to a room with two queen beds and an ocean view. What a pleasant surprise! Definitely a nice way to start a vacation. Sometimes you get more than you bargained for — in the best possible way!
reviewList.author: Carpe Diem Pirate

attribution.name: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa

places.name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa
places.address: No 07 Trường Sa, Street, Ngũ Hành Sơn
places.summary: Polished beachfront resort with warm rooms & villas, plus a spa, outdoor pools & 2 restaurants.

reviewList.text: What a beautiful resort! Our villa was perfect. So much space and our private pool was amazing. The service we received was exceptional. I would like to especially mention Tuan, who made our stay so much more enjoyable. He went out of his way to seamlessly arrange tours and transport for us. Very special holiday
reviewList.author: Jonas Le Souef

reviewList.text:
A Truly Beautiful and Welcoming Sanctuary!
We had a wonderful stay at this resort! The grounds and our room were beautiful and meticulously cared for. While the furniture felt a bit dated, it had the charm and character of lovely antique pieces.
From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding. We were greeted with such a warm welcome, along with thoughtful treats and fresh coconut water waiting in our room. The staff throughout the entire resort were consistently warm, attentive, and helpful.
The morning buffet was delicious, offering a great variety of selections that changed daily. We especially loved the fresh-pressed juices, like the ginger blend! The pool bar and restaurant also served fantastic food with excellent service.
Another highlight was the spa—it was absolutely beautiful, and the staff there were top-notch. We received wonderful massages and thoroughly enjoyed taking time to relax in the sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi.
The location was ideal: tucked away for a peaceful atmosphere, but just a short drive to the main beach strip (which reminded us a bit of Waikiki)
reviewList.author: Lynette ONeill

reviewList.text:
The stay at Danang Marriott Resort & Spa In Danang, Vietnam was indeed a memorable one.
The rooms were exceptional, offering a perfect blend of Luxury, Comfort and expansiveness.
One of the highlights was the massive bed Room with balcony & pool view,
which felt indulgent and beautifully designed.

The attention to detail in the room amenities added to the overall premium experience.

The breakfast spread was absolutely amazing, with a wide variety of delicious options to choose from.
For Pure veg also they had good options & f&b Team was humble enough to take your request if anything is Required,
The morning started on a high note thanks to the beautiful spread.

On a positive note, the swimming pool & access to Beach, were very well-maintained and relaxing.

There's also an Kids club zone that house all Kids game ,
Kids and grown ups would definitely like this place.

Overall, it was a great stay with a few areas that could be enhanced further.

I'd definitely visit again and hope things get better. Thanks & Best wishes team.

special Thanks to Nikita Ji for warm welcome & Taking such good care of us.

Definitely worth the visit.

Thank You.
reviewList.author: Ankit Choudhary

reviewList.text:
We had a pleasant stay at Danang Marriott Resort & Spa. The hotel has a beautiful private beach, and the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful.

The hotel itself feels a little dated in some areas, but the overall atmosphere is still enjoyable. The breakfast was excellent, with a great variety of food and very good quality.

One thing we found inconvenient was the breakfast policy for families with children. Unlike some similar hotels, they did not allow us to take breakfast to our room when our child was still sleeping. The staff insisted that the child had to be physically present in the restaurant. For families traveling with young children, this can be somewhat inconvenient.

Overall, a nice resort with a beautiful beach, friendly staff, and an excellent breakfast, although some areas of the hotel could benefit from updating.
reviewList.author: Mohsen

reviewList.text: Fabulous stay at Marriott Da Nang. The staff are all welcoming and friendly. Stand outs in the team were An on reception who did a great check-in and he asked frequently if we were enjoying our stay. Tracy on the concierge desk for helping us to organise a brilliant day trip. Brian Tung on coffee at breakfast - he makes the best coffees in Vietnam! Katy & Linn in the breakfast team for always remembering our morning drinks and making us feel welcome. The spa team are wonderful. We have been to many resorts and this is a stand out. Great food, great service and fantastic facilities. The negative reviews are not justified. You won’t be disappointed staying here .
reviewList.author: David Cooper

places.name: Risemount Premier Resort Danang
places.address: XN. 387, 120 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn
places.summary: Posh, Greek-inspired resort with airy rooms & suites, plus a country-chic restaurant & 2 pools.

reviewList.text:
We stayed at this resort for 5 nights as part of our honeymoon. We were welcomed with a nice cake congratulating us on our marriage.
The resort was great, it was sparkling clean and had a decent size gym, a pool on the lower level and a roof top pool.
The room was a good size with a massive comfortable bed.
The breakfast was excellent.
The staff in the resort made our stay even better. Staff member Uyan and Kenny were fantastic and a big mention to Vi who went out of her way to make our room was what we wanted, she checked in regularly making sure we were comfortable and offered advice on the best places to visit. Vi is an absolute asset to the resort and one of the reasons we had such a memorable stay. We can not wait to come back and stay again.
reviewList.author: Matthew Stephens

reviewList.text:
Booked Rise Mount Resort at the last minute, and it completely exceeded my expectations. The property itself is stunning—the rooms are immaculate, the pool area is gorgeous, and the food is consistently delicious, all just a short walk from the beach.
What truly made my stay unforgettable, though, was the incredible hospitality. When I fell a bit sick during my trip, Miss Uyen took amazing care of me. She went above and beyond, assisting me 24/7 with genuine warmth and professionalism. I loved my experience so much that I actually booked a second stay before leaving the city. An easy 10/10 recommendation!
reviewList.author: Adithya RK

reviewList.text:
Risemount Premier was our first hotel in Da Nang, and it absolutely did not disappoint! From the warm welcome and complimentary drinks at check-in to the spacious, clean room with a balcony overlooking the pool, everything was great.

Breakfast had plenty of Western, Korean, and Vietnamese options, and the pool was clean and climatized. All the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, especially Uyen and Vi at reception, who were always attentive and made sure we were happy with everything.

Location was also great, only about 3 blocks from My Khe beach!

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely come back! ❤️
reviewList.author: Vitória Kuo

reviewList.text: Absolutely phenomenal stay, with an amazing location, delicious breakfast, and everything you could hope for. The pool was convenient (as was the bar). Our front desk check in lady, Vy? Or Vi was an incredible host. Gracious, genuine, and made us feel right at home. I came with my elderly father who has a bad leg and all of the staff were so accommodating and helpful. Just a quick walk to the beach. Everything you could think of the staff was immediately ready to accommodate. I can not say enough good things about our stay. Highly, highly reccomend
reviewList.author: Ryan Hopkins

reviewList.text:
Our stay at the Risemount was amazing. The hotel itself is fitted out very nicely and the rooms are clean. The bed is much softer than usual in Vietnam (about a medium in western style mattresses) which really helps with comfort.

The buffet breakfast is fabulous, with plenty of local, Asian and western options.

The service of the staff is outstanding. At check in and check out we were served by Uyen, who was lovely. Kenny helped us at the door every day with a big smile (Kenny is exceptional and a really welcoming gentleman). The kitchen staff were professional and the wait staff were always elegant and helpful. All of the staff were extremely friendly, and English was widely spoken. The service at the Risemount was what stood out the most - exceptional, equal to the best anywhere in the world while being genuine rather than fawning.

The hotel itself is relatively quiet given how much construction is occurring in Vietnam. Ask for a high room overlooking the pool if you would like the most quiet rooms.

The Risemount is my new favourite hotel in Da Nang and we will be back. If I could give it more than  5 stars I would!
reviewList.author: Shane Costello

places.name: Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang
places.address: Hà My Đông A, Dien Ban Dong

reviewList.text:
Outstanding Stay and Exceptional Service!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel incredibly welcome, and the hospitality throughout our stay was fantastic.

A very special mention has to go to Thiwh, the Bell Captain, who truly went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. His friendly personality, professionalism, and genuine willingness to help really stood out. Nothing was ever too much trouble, and he always greeted us with a warm smile and made sure we were well looked after.

It’s people like Thiwh who make a great hotel experience truly exceptional. He is an absolute credit to the hotel and a perfect example of outstanding customer service.

The hotel itself was fantastic, but it’s the wonderful staff and their attention to detail that really made our stay special.

A massive thank you to Thiwh and the entire team for making our family holiday such an enjoyable and memorable experience. We would happily recommend this hotel to anyone visiting and would love to return in the future!

Five stars all the way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: Andrew Cochrane

reviewList.text:
We had a truly wonderful stay at this hotel and couldn’t be happier with our experience\! From the spacious, comfortable rooms to the fantastic breakfast buffet and the incredibly warm hospitality, everything made our stay memorable.

A special shout-out to Mr. Thinh, the Bell Captain, and Ms. Thy for their kindness, helpfulness, and excellent service. They were absolutely wonderful and made us feel so welcome. It’s always the little things that make a stay special, and the staff here genuinely go out of their way to make sure guests feel comfortable and well taken care of.

The breakfast buffet deserves a special mention because it was absolutely fantastic! There was a great variety of options, and it was particularly good for vegetarians, which made the experience even better. It was such a pleasure to start our mornings with such a delicious spread.

The rooms were big, spacious, and comfortable, and what truly stood out throughout our stay was how kind, friendly, helpful, and smiley everyone was. The entire team made us feel welcome, and the hospitality really added to the overall experience.

We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would definitely love to come back! I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable stay, excellent hospitality, and a great breakfast experience. Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so lovely! Looking forward to visiting again. ❤️

I’ve kept it detailed and enthusiastic while making it sound natural for Google Reviews. You can post it as is\!
reviewList.author: Riya Salaria

reviewList.text:
Spacious room, not much to complain.
The facility design is great too, they have a main pool for the rooms and a smaller one by the private beach. It’s beautiful. Unfortunately, there aren’t much people hang out by the pool and the bar, so they are quite dead.

There are a lot to improve at the breakfast. The space is too tight for too many guests. Even they have great food and options, the experience isnt great.

The location is away from the main bar, tourist and beach streets. So you you will need to take a grab to everywhere. Grab offers a special 20% discount for the hotel, you just need to activate it manually.

Overall, it’s a great hotel if you want to be on your own. But not a social place.
reviewList.author: Lo Cosmo

reviewList.text:
Stayed here for 3 nights in 2 bedroom garden villa. The hotel manager Brian reached out to us a day before the check in date offering any assitance needed. As for the check in, as a villa guest, we didnt have to go through the usual check in at reception. We were seated at the lounge while they do the necessary. The front office staff Vy was truly helpful throughout our stay. Constantly checking our well being via whatsapp. Brian too was walking around the hotel like all the time engaging with all the guest.

As for the room, it's truly spacious. The design and layout is really luxurious. The breakfast has a wide spread. Villa guest get to order few special menus. Kids loved both the private and hotel pools. Kids club staff was friendly with kids. She even did a hair braid for our daughter. Thank you Anna!

The beach was clean and the tide just nice. Spectacular view. The complimentary access to Cove Lounge was one of the main highlight. We never missed a day. The staff the were highly attentive.

Overall, it's highly recommended. It's simply one of the best hotel we have ever stayed. We would definitely be returning in future. Kudos to all for the service provided!
reviewList.author: Tiras Devaraj Paul

reviewList.text: The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable. A special mention goes to Chi from the F&B team at the breakfast buffet. She was always smiling, energetic and so friendly. She was quick to help, checked on our table and made every morning feel warm and welcoming. She really stood out, and that kind of genuine hospitality makes a big difference. Thank you, Chi! 😊
reviewList.author: May Oo

places.name: Stella Maris Beach Danang Hotel
places.address: Võ Văn Kiệt/03 Ward, An Hải
places.summary: Refined hotel offering sleek rooms & suites, some with sea views, plus a rooftop pool & dining.

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful stay at Stella Maris! The hotel was beautiful, clean, and comfortable, with a fantastic location just a short walking distance from the beach. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help. Their exceptional hospitality made our stay even more special. Everything was convenient, relaxing, and enjoyable. A big thank you to the entire team for making our experience so memorable. Highly recommended, and we would definitely love to return!
reviewList.author: rushini warnasuriya

reviewList.text:
This was our first time in Danang and the location and service of this hotel was exceptional. They would even monitor our movements and help us with our luggage when we were leaving.
The rooms were clean however the layout of the bathroom sink is in the middle of the room which causes a splash area so for safety reasons, mind the wet areas. The toilet is also situated next to the shower and as there is no doors for the shower it causes the toilet area to get completely wet, you will need to mind the slip hazard when going to the washroom after a shower. The dining staff were so friendly and even remembered our special orders during our stay. Location is impeccable and the views are outstanding. In a few years time their views will be blocked by a hotel being constructed next to them which will block the full view of the ocean. Staff is great and I definitely recommend this hotel for your stay in Danang
reviewList.author: Jennie LeBeau

reviewList.text:
Excellent location! Rooftop bar 👌🏾”
Short stay but will definitely come back when we visit Da Nang again!! The rooms were superb and the food and drinks were amazing! You can’t beat the location as it was steps away from the beach and only a short, 5 min cab ride to the Dragon bridge and night market!
reviewList.author: Roma Oliveros

reviewList.text: I absolutely love the property manager here! She is outstanding and consistently goes above and beyond her job duties to accommodate guests. The spa is amazing, and the overall quality of service is top-notch. However, my only complaint is regarding housekeeping. I strongly recommend double-checking your room before checking out because if you accidentally leave personal belongings behind, you may not get them back. Unfortunately, in my experience, housekeeping denied that my items were ever left in the room. Aside from that disappointing experience, everything else was wonderful!
reviewList.author: Michelle Jesus is love.

reviewList.text:
Hotel is in fact right next to a huge construction site so its very noise
cant relax at the pool at all!
also there is zero soundproofing in rooms which you hear every motorbike and honking noises.
Many flies in the room its not that clean.
What a shame as it only looked good on internet pics but nothing like that in reality!
Restaurant menu has little variety of food and drinks too.
its not close to 4 stars establishment!
more like 2.5 stars hotels.
Bed was rather hard btw
reviewList.author: snowwhite

reviewList.text:
This is a very good hotel for the price, around 1 million VND per night.

I have stayed here twice. The first time, I stayed in a partial ocean view room, and the second time in an ocean view room. Both rooms had beautiful views.

Location: You can walk to the beach right in front of the hotel. However, if you want to go to the busier part of the beach, you need to walk about 1–2 km.

Staff: I was especially satisfied with the staff. They were extremely nice, proactive, and helpful.

Room: The room was clean, a reasonable size, and the furniture was not old.

One small downside: the bathroom has a bathtub without a separate glass shower enclosure, so the whole bathroom gets wet. The bathtub also had a drainage problem.

Overall, this is a good choice in terms of cost performance. I will come back when I visit Da Nang again.
reviewList.author: Dan Duong

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel in Vietnam. The hotel was beautiful, clean, well-organized, and very comfortable. The management was absolutely excellent, professional, and welcoming. I would also like to give special thanks to khánh and Trúc , who provided outstanding service and was extremely helpful, friendly, and attentive throughout my stay.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience. I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely love to stay here again!
reviewList.author: majid _.

reviewList.text:
My experience here was great. For me it was the staff that made me give this 5 stars. The only bad thing was due to us using a third party to book our room there was a misunderstanding on what floor we were staying on but even that the staff worked it out to give us a better room.
The best for me was a person named Khanh. He went above & beyond to help us find affordable ways to travel the area. We were extremely grateful for him. The hotel is lucky to have an employee like him. Thank you
reviewList.author: dal spinkle

reviewList.text:
The hotel is cheap, clean, and has a nice view of the ocean.

Pros
* Upgraded my room for free
* Great ocean side view
* Inexpensive hotel

Cons
* Far away from the more popular areas of Da Nang (you’ll end up driving a lot)
* Breakfast is underwhelming. It’s virtually the same every morning.
* Elevators are slow. Walking stairs is faster. But stairs full of hazards (used for storage) and has no lights.

Overall good experience. I would book this hotel again in the future.
reviewList.author: Lucius Kahng

reviewList.text:
The hotel has a very good location and the room was clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist whenever needed. One of the best things about the hotel is its convenient location, just beside a restaurant, making it very easy to find food nearby.

We stayed in a beachfront room and the view was absolutely fantastic. Waking up to the beautiful sea view was truly enjoyable. The swimming pool is quite small, but it still offers a very nice view and a relaxing atmosphere.

The only thing we did not quite understand was why a plant was placed in a position that blocked part of the TV view. Other than that, everything was great.

Overall, it is a nice hotel to stay in and we had an enjoyable experience
reviewList.author: chfs ag

places.name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas
places.address: 23 Trường Sa, Street, Ngũ H��nh Sơn

reviewList.text:
This is ideal place for family's holiday. The resort supplies the essential till the demand service.
The breakfast had many selection. The waitress took the order of drinks at our spot, special drink of the day was coconut coffee, good experience!
I would like to send the big thanks for operator, engineering, F&B service team who helped us to heat the food for our baby. And the bellman team was also super cool and friendly during our stay.
My family stayed only 1 night but this place was super impressive.
reviewList.author: Jade Nguyen

reviewList.text:
We had such a wonderful stay at Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas! Our group of eight stayed in two 2-bedroom villas, and we truly enjoyed every moment of our stay.

From check-in to check-out, every staff member we met was incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive. The villas and resort facilities were beautiful, spacious, and very well maintained, making our family trip even more special.

A special thank you to Alice, who assisted us with our check-in, for making us feel so welcome from the very beginning. We would also especially like to recognize Tony and Harry, our buggy drivers, who were always so friendly and helpful whenever he drove us around the resort. Their warm hospitality really stood out and made our stay even more memorable.

We had an amazing time as a family of eight and left with so many happy memories. Thank you to the entire team for taking such great care of us. We would absolutely love to come back again! ❤️
reviewList.author: My_0922

reviewList.text:
We stayed at the Marriott for 9 nights in a beautiful 3-bedroom villa with a private pool, and our experience was excellent from start to finish.

Everything about our stay was wonderful. The villa was spacious, comfortable, and very well maintained, and we also tried several of the restaurants during our stay — the food and service were consistently great.

What really stood out, though, was the team and their level of hospitality. Everyone was genuinely helpful, attentive, and always checking in to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.

A very special thank you to Hanh, who truly made our stay even more memorable. She was incredibly kind, thoughtful, and attentive throughout our stay, always going the extra mile to make sure we were happy and well taken care of. Her warmth and professionalism really stood out.

After 9 days, the Marriott genuinely felt like a home away from home. We had a wonderful experience and would absolutely recommend it, especially for families looking for a relaxing and comfortable stay. We would happily come back again!
reviewList.author: lujain aldakheel

reviewList.text:
We came here at rainy season but luckily only one day rain during 5-day stay. Delicious breakfast and varoius choices , nice staff (Tony and Aaron are very caring about our family).  Spa with special price maybe because of the slow season, spacious room with perfect facilities. We will come back again! Kids menu and normal menu are delicious too.
30 mins from the airport and 20 mins to dragon bridge/night market.
reviewList.author: pinky lin

reviewList.text:
Stayed in the 3 bedroom villa. Rooms are clean, spacious and generally well maintained. Upstairs bedrooms and the living room TV are smart TVs which is great. But bedroom downstairs is one of those older TVs so you’re stuck navigating through channels for something entertaining. Marriott should consider upgrading this TV to a smart TV.

The lobby area needs upgrading though. The air conditioning isn’t working well and the time it takes to get a buggy to bring you to your villa can take quite long - and it isn’t particularly comfortable waiting in the lobby since it can get hot and stuffy.

Had food at the beach restaurant and would not recommend it. But the breakfast buffets are fantastic! Distance of hotel from the city centre is not very near (~15-20 min).

Highlight of this resort is definitely the staff and service quality. Especially some of the guys who drive the buggy. So welcoming, friendly, and helpful, and they do everything with a smile on their face.

All in all, would recommend it here if you’re in a bigger group, especially if you have kids. The villas are great and decently priced, and warm and welcoming staff.
reviewList.author: AW

attribution.name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas
Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas

reviewList.text: Such an amazing foot massage at Onda! From the moment you walk in, the welcome tea and mango jelly set such a lovely tone. My therapist listened carefully when I requested different pressure levels throughout the service and adjusted perfectly. To top it off, I accidentally misplaced my phone, and the staff were so honest and helpful in finding it for me. Incredible service all around
reviewList.author: Shihoo Park

reviewList.text: What a great spa experience! My whole family came here on our last day in Da Nang. We wish we came earlier! Great experience from start to finish. The facility is really clean and the therapists are really good. We totally recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Joanne B

reviewList.text:
This is by far one of the best massages I've gotten. Hoi Bay was an exceptional masseuse. I've had plenty of massages in my life and this has been the best one yet! She was thorough and kept the intensity of pressure throughout the 60mins. After the massage, they offer you tea or juice.

The staff was very attentive and mindful. They provided great service. However? They only accept cash. This was worth the visit. I wanted to try it out because this is where Jungkook and Jimin got their massages in season 2 of Are You Sure? And this place did not disappoint. I'm coming back for round 2 before leaving vietnam!
reviewList.author: Aileen Dy

reviewList.text: Good service and friendly staff. The spa is very clean
reviewList.author: darlyn ambay

reviewList.text:
It was a great massage in Danang!
We had a massage on our first day right after our flight and massage gave us the best rest! We recommend!
reviewList.author: April Yun

places.name: Ha Spa Massage & Hair Wash - 전신 케어 - 洗头
places.address: K254A Võ Nguyên Giáp, An Hải

reviewList.text: The staff's massage technique is quite good, the reception is friendly and cute. Nice, cool space 🥰💯😎
reviewList.author: Nguyễn Thị Uyển Nhi

reviewList.text: Have been here several times - clean, good service. I could recommend it like a nice experience 👍
reviewList.author: Yelizaveta Bogunova

reviewList.text: Very good massage spot in da nang its new and staff here is also friendly and helping hand . Guide me with every step .
reviewList.author: ds king

reviewList.text:
After having coffee by the beach, I decided to get a massage on a whim. Seeing good reviews on Google, I went in. The masseuses were all friendly and lovely, and the prices were reasonable.
By the way, the mango jelly drops tasted good
reviewList.author: 吳宜蓁

reviewList.text:
AVERAGE - EXPENSIVE - POOR SERVICE - OVERCHARGED
my wife and I had been going there for years and they were a little more expensive and in the past done a good job, apparently management has changed and so have all the services.
living in SE Asia for about 20 years and DaNang for the last 10, I have never gone to a massage center which did not offer at least a glass of water or welcome you properly into the business.  We did not feel welcomed, only rushed into the rooms to start.
After about 5 minutes we realized we were being given the wrong massage treatment and questioned it.  Another 5 minutes and we had to ask for them to play some music (instead of listening to the creaking tables and aircondioner).  After we got these things organized and finished we were surprised to discover we were being charged extra.  Although all this was arranged through chats, in Vietnamese, the prices we were given we for different therapy although we had clearly communicated what we wanted (in Vietnamese).  This caused us to pay about 50% more.  We never would have agreed to these prices as there is better services at normal regular prices at most of the massage spas in town.
Service was definitely 1 star
but the therapists did OK, so I provided them 2 stars here, but a once regular customer will never return.
Reception continued to blame the therapists, but they we only doing what they were instructed to do, it was the interaction with the business that was simply awful and then to be forced to pay more than we had arranged simply added injury.
Even if they corrected the lack of music, inept communication and actually started welcoming customers I would not pay extra for average massage therapy.
Now retired, I was an Osteopath and my clinics did massage therapy, etc.  I would fire anyone who was this inept.

There's a T.V. that wasn't on, no music; just the deafening silence to listen to the nail-tech's phone incessantly ding with messages and the kid's cartoons on the cell phone. reviewList.text:
Overall Rating: ⭐️ 1.5/5

Atmosphere: ⭐️ 1/5
The room was very old and poorly maintained. Doors weren't fully closed, so you could hear cars from the street the whole time. At one point, a child walked into the room and was noisy—relaxing was impossible. Also, there was no calming music, which is usually standard in massage places.

Service: ⭐️ 1/5
There was no footbath beforehand, so they massaged my feet dirty. No slippers were offered, which made it worse. No tea or water before or after the massage, and no fruit either (which some better places offer). Overall, the service felt careless and unprofessional.

Massage: ⭐️ 2/5
The massage was mediocre at best. The therapist forgot to massage some spots on one side of my body, even though she did them on the other. The oil was barely removed—just wiped off with a dry towel—so I left feeling greasy and uncomfortable.

Price: ⭐️ 2/5
I paid 250,000 VND for a 60-minute body massage. It might sound cheap, but for what I got, it felt overpriced. Other places offer much better experiences for just a little more. On top of that, I was immediately asked to give a tip right after the massage, which felt very pushy.

Conclusion: ⭐️ 1.5/5
I do not recommend this place. It was a waste of money and far below the standard you can get elsewhere for a similar price.

reviewList.text:
Great staff and comfortable rooms, but facilities need improvement

We stayed at Awaken Da Nang for five nights. The staff were amazing throughout our stay, always friendly and happy to help. Our room was clean, comfortable and really nice to stay in.

The breakfast buffet was also great, with plenty of options. The chef was always polite and made a point of greeting us every morning, which was a nice touch.

Unfortunately, a few things let the hotel down, especially considering it’s rated five-star.

The restaurant was probably our biggest disappointment. A lot of the menu wasn’t available during our entire stay, and the pizza oven was broken the whole time. Breakfast finishes at 10am, but lunch doesn’t start until 2pm, which is a pretty long gap if you’re planning to spend the day at the hotel.

The pool was quite cold, and the jacuzzi was broken and instead being offered as a cold jacuzzi, which was disappointing. The fitness centre could also be much better equipped for a five-star hotel.

Another minor frustration was the laundry service being charged per item rather than per kilogram, making it quite expensive compared to other places we stayed in Vietnam.

Overall, the staff, breakfast and comfortable rooms were definitely the highlights of our stay. It’s a nice hotel, but the facilities and restaurant need some attention to bring it up to the standard you’d expect from a five-star property.
reviewList.author: Jarrod

reviewList.text:
We stayed at Awaken Hotel for 4 nights. Overall, our stay was fine, but I was a little disappointed given its 5-star rating.

On the positive side, the room was spacious, the bed was incredibly soft and comfortable, and the breakfast buffet had plenty of options. The beachfront location was excellent, with plenty of restaurants, markets, and convenient Grab access nearby. Most of the staff were also helpful and welcoming.

However, our check-in experience was disappointing. The staff member assisting us seemed cold and unwelcoming, and we were given the wrong keycard, leaving us waiting in the hot hallway. The hallways, elevators, gym, and pool area also lacked air conditioning, making them uncomfortably hot. In addition, there was a musty smell in the room, visible mold around the shower curtain and door frame, and although the blanket cover may have been changed daily, the blanket itself was heavily stained and was never replaced during housekeeping. The hairdryer was also inconvenient to use because the button had to be held down continuously.

Overall, the hotel has a great location and comfortable rooms, but the maintenance, housekeeping, and facilities need improvement to meet the expectations of a 5-star property. It was an okay stay, but not quite the luxurious experience I expected.

reviewList.text:
Unfortunately, this hotel didn't quite make us as "happy" as its name suggests. We encountered several inconveniences during our stay, and while I understand that no hotel is perfect, I believe these are areas that management could improve.

Here are the things we experienced:

1. Air Conditioning & Fridge
Our room had a rather old air conditioning unit that was noticeably noisy. It would make sudden blowing and rattling sounds throughout the night, even the fridge would make a sudden sound, making it difficult to get a peaceful rest.

2. Bathroom Maintenance
The shower area had visible mold, which could use better cleaning and maintenance. The water heater also took an unusually long time to work, and I eventually had to settle for a cold shower.

3. Noise and Soundproofing
The rooms don't seem to be adequately soundproofed. We could hear almost everything happening outside, from hallway conversations and elevator sounds to people's footsteps. It made relaxing quite difficult, especially during quieter hours.

4. Staff Hospitality
This was probably one of our biggest disappointments. We had quite a long stay in Vietnam, and this was already our 5th hotel. Our experiences at the previous hotels had been consistently pleasant, particularly when it came to staff hospitality. Their teams were welcoming, attentive, and genuinely enthusiastic about making our stay comfortable. They would even go the extra mile to assist us. Unfortunately, we didn't receive the same level of hospitality here. Upon arrival, the staff didn't seem particularly welcoming. Despite having several employees at the reception area, no one proactively offered to help with our luggage or guide us to our room. Most of them remained occupied in conversation among themselves. I understand that staff members may have other responsibilities, but a warm welcome and a little initiative in assisting arriving guests would have made a much better first impression.

5. Housekeeping and Privacy
Housekeeping knocked on our door early in the morning, which was quite disruptive. At the previous hotels we stayed in, reception staff were proactive in coordinating housekeeping schedules. They would usually ask whether we wanted our room cleaned before we headed out, ensuring that guests could enjoy their privacy without unnecessary interruptions. I wish this hotel practiced something similar.

6. Wi-Fi Connectivity
Lastly, one of the most frustrating issues was the unstable Wi-Fi connection, particularly when connecting multiple devices. Reliable internet access is important for travelers, especially those who need to work remotely or stay connected across several devices. This is something the hotel should seriously look into.

Overall Experience:
Considering all these factors, I would say this hotel is more suitable for travelers looking for a quick overnight stay, particularly those who simply need somewhere to rest before catching a flight. However, if you're looking for a comfortable and peaceful stay with attentive service and a genuinely welcoming hospitality experience, I would suggest exploring other options.

I hope management takes this feedback constructively. These may seem like small details individually, but together, they make a significant difference in a guest's overall experience.
reviewList.author: Aiko Kitane

attribution.name: Happy Day Riverside Hotel & Spa Danang By Haviland
Happy Day Riverside Hotel & Spa Danang By Haviland

places.name: HAIAN Riverfront Hotel Da Nang
places.summary: Upscale hotel featuring a restaurant & a rooftop bar, plus a spa, a gym & an open-air infinity pool.

reviewList.text:
A lovely stay in Hoi An! ❤️

The location is fantastic, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and local food spots within walking distance. The room was clean and comfortable, and the service was absolutely excellent.

I especially loved the breakfast! Although the dining area is quite small, it feels so cozy, warm, and spotless. The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and thoughtful. They really made us feel welcome. And of course, the food was delicious!

Honestly, everything about this stay was wonderful. It’s even better if you book in advance, as you can get a really good price for such great value.

The hotel has two branches: Riverfront and Beachfront. I’m honestly a little disappointed that I didn’t get the chance to stay at the other branch as well. Hopefully, next time!

Highly recommended if you’re visiting Hoi An. Would definitely love to come back! ✨
reviewList.author: Sharker N

reviewList.text:
Such a good hotel to stay. Thank you! Actually, we could not decide where to stay before we came to Da Nang. After much thoughts, we chose this hotel to ocean beachfront, we never regret especially as we took the dragon bridge view. The view is nothing close to comparing.

Staff at the counter here are all polite and helpful, can speak in English. Breakfast is complimentary and good variety too.

The location is close to all different massage parlour, apart from their hotel own one too, and street food counters. If ever we come back to Da Nang, this is the place. Btw, the hotel can help arrange for sight seeing too, of course you have to pay by yourselves…
reviewList.author: Manuni

reviewList.text: Do your research on the location. We arrived and were very surprised and disappointed with surrounding area. Inundated with spa massage joints underwhelmed with the choice of decent restaurants and bars near the Hotel. Quickly learned that the beach side provides best options there. We didn’t even check in (despite having paid two nights accommodation) so can’t comment on the room but suggest worth examining many reviews offering similar sentiment - that said plenty positive reviews too. For us the poor location was sufficient to relocate and enjoy Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Todd Lyons

reviewList.text:
Book Superior Double Room in mid Oct and Hotel upgrade our room to Deluxe Double Partial River View Room. They have also arrange bed decoration with rose petals and even has a small cake to celebrate my wedding anniversary. Room is spacious, bright, clean, and has a really big bathtub that can easily fit 2 person. It gets a while to fill up though.. Shower water pressure is strong though the hot water can be hotter. We can see the dragon bridge breathing fire and water from our Level6 room. Aircon is cold enough and can cool down the room after a while. Breakfast selection is quite good and taste ok too.
The major issue is the soundproofing, which hotel knows and do provide earplugs. The noise from the road traffic below as well as room next door are too loud for comfort and good sleep.
Also, the lights on every floor are sensor-lights. It is unpleasant for guest to see darkness upon lift door open and you have to walk out before the lights get turned on. The same goes when you first open ur room door. Energy saving is good, but not at the expense of good impression to your guest.
Location is really very good..  a short walk to Han Market and Pink Church, and all surrounded by restaurants and eateries. Con Market and Go Danang are just a short grabcar ride away.
reviewList.author: Serene

reviewList.text:
Haian Riverfront Hotel Da Nang

A great place to enjoy the Dragon Bridge’s spectacular fire and water show at night. The rooftop mini bar is a particular highlight, offering a lovely spot to unwind, enjoy a drink, and capture panoramic views of the illuminated bridge against the city skyline.

One minor downside is that the breakfast was not particularly impressive compared to what I have experienced at other hotels and resorts.

I hope you have a wonderful and memorable stay here, too
reviewList.author: Giang Hoàng

places.name: Son Tra Resort & Spa
places.summary: Warm villas with private pools in an informal beachfront resort featuring terrace dining & a spa.

reviewList.text:
This hotel has been the biggest surprise of my trip to Da Nang. It is situated on Son Tra Peninsula. Upon arrival, we were astonished by how spacious the villa is. Our accommodation is a two‑storey unit with a private swimming pool. It only costs around HK$1,000. A similar property would cost five to ten times as much in the Maldives.

What pleased us most is the service. Responses on WhatsApp are extremely prompt, and all staff are polite and well‑mannered. Even the doorman tried his best to communicate with us in English. The weather was poor during our stay, yet staying inside with family, watching the wind and rain outside, we felt wonderfully warm.

Our package originally included airport transfer. When the team learned we would not be heading to the airport, they thoughtfully arranged a car to the city centre for us instead. A great hotel is not only about views, but the people around you. We will absolutely come back. Thank you, lovely Candy, Hana, and all the other sweet team members.
reviewList.author: Patrick ZHU

reviewList.text:
Beautiful resort with private beach 15min out of the craziness of Da Nang.
We had a lovely stay here. Our rooms were huge, it was a villa with two bedrooms and 2 bathrooms upstairs and a kitchen, lounge and dining area downstairs with a toilet. Private pool for each of the villas in the garden.
More of a traditional style of room with dark wooden furniture but comfortable beds and very well air conditioned.
Direct access to a private beach with loungers and the main infinity pool overlooking the water. It truely is beautiful.
The staff were lovely and attentive, buffet breakfast had a good selection of east, west and all the usual items. All were delicious.
I highly recommend for a relaxing lazy stay.
reviewList.author: Stephanie Da Silva

reviewList.text: Paid $165/night for beach front villa with private pool (not so private) Rooms are old but nice right on a private beach great location with good views. I chose halfboard which was $59/day extra. Not worth it in my opinion.  Extras two way airport transfer, shuttle to Vincom plaza mall in Da Nang. Limited menu for lunch/dinner with only choice for drinks watermelon juice or lime juice, only fruit for dessert. The food was exceptional so far but staff did forget my appetizer at lunch and served it after dessert last night.
reviewList.author: John Payne

reviewList.text: We loved it here. Right on the private beach with awesome private pool. The service was great and the food was delicious. Nice and private and quiet. The security on the gate was excellent and would definitely love to stay there again. The villas are huge and the grounds and villas are clean and beautiful. The views are amazing. Great communication on whatsapp and very cheap grab rides into town. Also has a free shuttle bus to take you up town.
reviewList.author: Simone

reviewList.text:
We had a wonderful experience at the resort. The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. The pool villa was beautiful and thoughtfully equipped with all the amenities one could ask for.

The breakfast buffet was delicious, with a great variety of options to choose from. The easy access to the beach was another highlight, providing the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the surroundings.

Overall, it was a fantastic stay, and we would definitely love to visit again!
reviewList.author: Anil Ponappa

places.name: GỪNG SPA - Massage Y Học Cổ Truyền

reviewList.text: One of the best spas in the city. If you need privacy, highly skilled staff, and professional service, I think there's no better place than Gừng Spa. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: Cuong Huy Tran

reviewList.text:
Inspite of big booking on recommendation by tour guide Kim...the owners at Gung soa overcharged. And trolled for tips..I felt sad about 8 ladies trusting tour guide Kim and others felt job was useless..bean did a good job for me but ..don't visit this unethical spa.
I too wanted to find the truth about foot massage so when happy hours offer came I went in and was impressed with the transparency of 12 minutes each foot and 8 minutes shoulder...we tourist trust  and are bullied and cheating propagated.
Please avoid going to Gung spa..instead  where I researched na xinh..head there and see the difference
This spa is clean..air-conditioned..professional.
my foot massage was mesmerizing and was transparent about timing for both legs..neck and shoulders..her muscle touch and healing hands were a blessing...go with full trust to na Xinhua spa...superb value for money
reviewList.author: Dr Mohina S kulkarni

reviewList.text:
2 stars for masseur and 1 star for the boss.
- price is reasonable, ~16usd for 90 mins.
- In common area  it's freaking hot and they did not turn on air conditioners even they have them.
- massage room is old, air condition turned to maximum but both me and masseur and sweating. How can you enjoy a massage while dripping wet!
- the masseur techniques is not suite me. It is not deep tissue. He used a whole instead of fingers and/or elbow. He used a lot if power, but all I feel is heavy, not deep, not striking any tissue not any acupuncture point. I rated 2 stars because of his effort. Should be 1 star for techniques.
reviewList.author: Hung Chieu

reviewList.text:
The no. 1 item on their menu, is the traditional foot massage!  They of course try to sale you others combo items with more time and higher cost!
The service is not bad!
reviewList.author: Nam H. Nguyen

reviewList.text: I come here when I'm in the area and it never disappoints, excellent massages, clean and friendly Staff.
reviewList.author: Edwin D'costa

places.name: MASSAGE Khiếm Thị Hoàng Quân 88
places.address: Lô C1, 144 A Ông Ích Khiêm, Thanh Khê

reviewList.text:
I have been here twice. The first time, I was served by Thinh, who asked for a tip even though his massage skills were very poor. He also had a skin condition that made me feel quite uncomfortable and concerned.

I have experienced visually impaired massage services in many other places, and they were much more professional and well-organized than this place. Unfortunately, my experience here was genuinely disappointing.

Let me explain in detail so that people can understand what to expect. When you arrive, you choose your massage package and pay in advance. The receptionist then offers you the option of a private room or a shared room. I have tried both options on my two visits, and honestly, there was not much difference.

When you go upstairs for the massage, some therapists are visually impaired while others are sighted. Unfortunately, the massage skills were really weak. One therapist basically just pressed and shook my body, while another mainly used his elbow to push along my back. There was very little actual acupressure, massage technique, or relaxation involved.
reviewList.author: kim taehoo

reviewList.text: This place is excellent. Cleaner and easier to book than other Blind Massage spaces. I just reached out to them through Facebook and they responded right away. I booked 90 min, which I found out after came with a free session in the Sauna. I didnt have time for that today but will definitely note it for the future. My therapist was terrific. Very talented hands and super friendly. I will come back soon!
reviewList.author: Eric Wingerter

reviewList.text: My partner and I had the 90 minutes massage and the vision impared masseuses here asked us which parts of our bodies are tired and they did a wonderful job massaging the knots and tightness in those areas. This place is nothing fancy and we were put in an air conditioned room with 2 clean beds and the masseuses just went to work. After our session, we came out fresh and recharged.  210k vnd for 90 minutes massage and we tipped them 100k each. Money well spent. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: BD

reviewList.text:
Even I said several times the massage person to be more gentle, she was not. Now I'm full of bruises. Also, I can't understand why they are not focused enough to the trigger points, and they are violent towards healthy tissues.

Edit: after trying to negotiate about the terrible accident, the company refuses to compensate their mistakes.
reviewList.author: Minttu H.

reviewList.text: Massage is good, but unless you won't mind it on the street, I don't recommend.The moment another person occupied the neighbouring bed, the conversation between him and masseurs began and never stopped. Silence, privacy, here you won't find it
reviewList.author: Виолетта Кожерева

reviewList.text:
The facilities were very clean, with no smell or dust thanks to thorough room cleaning. However, the air conditioner was too cold and blew directly onto the bed. There were several modern groceries for night time.

The staff and service couldn't have been better. They spoke english fluently, arranged a taxi, kept my luggage. They even took care of my flight ticket issue by contacting the airport customer service center directly since I had no Vitenamese phone number.

I would love to visit this hotel again.
reviewList.author: Hehe

reviewList.text: Staff are very helpful and speak good English. They helped me with currency exchange and recommended restaurants. The room was fine, just needs a bit of modernisation
reviewList.author: Craig Brewster

reviewList.text:
Unhygienic rooms and predatory, unfair charges – AVOID this hotel
My stay here was deeply disappointing. Despite the 2025 Agoda award, the reality is far from acceptable. Upon check-in, the room was already in poor condition: the furniture was outdated, there were ants in the room, and the shower door was missing, which caused water to flood the bathroom floor and create a slip hazard. Most importantly, the linens and towels were stained upon arrival.

Despite reporting these pre-existing stains to the staff, the hotel attempted to scam us upon checkout by charging a "penalty" for them. They eventually insisted on charging 150,000 VND for a single towel, while arbitrarily dropping the claims for the bedding. They also attempted to add an unauthorized 3% credit card surcharge on top of this unfair penalty. When we challenged the charges, they simply processed the 150,000 VND anyway.

This hotel seems to rely on finding any excuse to extort money from guests. I strongly advise travelers, especially those who may face language barriers, to avoid this establishment. It is not worth the risk, the lack of hygiene, or the unprofessional management.
reviewList.author: Phoebe Chan

reviewList.text:
Absolute worst customer service - Extremely rude and unprofessional staff
I strongly recommend avoiding this hotel. The customer service here is by far the worst I have ever experienced.
When I called the hotel to ask a simple question, the staff member on the phone was extremely rude and unhelpful. To make matters worse, while I was answering their question, they completely hung up on me mid-conversation without any explanation.
Their attitude was shockingly disrespectful, and they showed zero basic manners or hospitality. A hotel with this level of service does not deserve any guests. Save your time and money and book somewhere else.
reviewList.author: 김민석

reviewList.text:
We chose this hotel mainly because of the good price compared to other options, and overall it was okay but nothing special.

The location is quite central, which makes it convenient to get around. The staff were friendly on arrival, which made for a good first impression.

The rooms are decent and do the job, but they feel a bit outdated and could use some refreshing.

The pool area has potential, but it felt quite neglected and not very well maintained, which was a bit disappointing.

All in all, a solid option if you’re looking for something simple and affordable, but don’t expect anything memorable.
reviewList.author: Ward Stynen

reviewList.text:
The price is the same regardless of whether your hair is long or short. I chose the 185,000 VND Intensive hair wash package, and the massage was incredibly comfortable and relaxing. Every pressure point was massaged thoroughly, which really helped relieve the tension in my shoulders.

The pressure was just right—not too light or half-hearted—and they washed my hair very thoroughly as well. My scalp felt so clean and refreshed afterwards!
reviewList.author: Weiting Tang

reviewList.text:
PSA if your wanting just a facial….
Myself and my friend came into La Spa, she wanted a hair wash and I wanted a facial.
Just so everyone is aware before going, you can’t just get a facial (facial was 40min), you have to get a facial and a hair wash. I went in after I had already had a hair wash and only wanted a facial and they denied me the service which I found strange. Also when we walked in the staff seemed off and didn’’t greet us which isn’t like Vietnam at all. It felt like they just wanted to stay on their phones and not do any work. I also got this vibe when other customers walked through the door as well.

I also found it strange that they made my friend pay before she received the treatement as this appears to not be common practice whilst in Vietnam.

I’m definitely not normally a complainer at all but maybe for future you could offer the service separately. Thanks for letting me wait in the foyer for an hour while my friend had her treatments done though.
reviewList.author: Alicia McMeeking

reviewList.text: Good place with reasonable prices. I wish the stuff could speak and understand little bit of English. The place is nice and clear. I enjoyed my hair spa.
reviewList.author: Annie 669

reviewList.text: Clean spa plus professional service with a very reasonable price. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Etta Lai

reviewList.text: experienced basic hair wash and facial care, the service was fantastic. Privacy can be improved though as there are seems only one big common room
reviewList.author: Jilei Z

places.name: Massage Hội người mù thanh khê - Đà Nẵng

reviewList.text:
A very nice place, clean with great atmosphere and a Perfect massage!
The best I had around here.
reviewList.author: מיכל יוחאי

reviewList.text: Clean spa, professional and excellent price. Hue did my hair spa, head and shoulder massage, was the best one I have had so far. Would recommend
reviewList.author: Sim M

reviewList.text: Excellent service, relaxing atmosphere, and wonderful staff. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Na Na

reviewList.text: Very good service, fast, friendly and clean space!
reviewList.author: Czarina Mendoza

reviewList.text: Very nice and relaxing spa
reviewList.author: Someone

reviewList.text: This was my first time here, and I was impressed by the luxurious atmosphere. From the cashier to the waitstaff, everyone was so lovely, enthusiastic, attentive, and sweet. Very friendly. I will visit often. 5 stars for quality. Wishing you even more customers in the future.
reviewList.author: Huy Lâm

reviewList.text: My first experience was a wonderful surprise! The environment was elegant and comfortable, the staff were warm and friendly, and the service was attentive and thoughtful. The massage techniques were professional and completely relaxing. I will definitely come back often and recommend it to my friends!
reviewList.author: 岘港上门服务Escort Vietnam看主页

reviewList.text: This restaurant boasts a luxurious yet tranquil ambiance, offering a comfortable and relaxing VIP experience from the moment you step inside. The staff are not only warm and friendly but also highly professional, with exquisite massage techniques that pinpoint fatigue points for complete relaxation. The service is attentive and thoughtful, with meticulous attention to every detail. There's no hard selling, and tea and snacks are provided. Even when busy, the wait time is reasonable, and you won't feel neglected. After the experience, I felt completely refreshed and have already recommended it to several friends, all of whom have been very satisfied and given it rave reviews. It offers excellent value for money, and I will definitely come back next time. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a high-quality relaxation experience. I believe you will also fall in love with this place and become a regular customer, enjoying its unique tranquility and comfort. It's a rare haven of relaxation in the city and deserves a five-star rating.
reviewList.author: 岘港外围Outcall&Incall

reviewList.text: The girls are hot, the service is enthusiastic, they're young and pretty, and their technique is excellent. I will definitely come back and support them again.
reviewList.author: Huy Huỳnh

reviewList.text: The space is clean, quiet, and creates a comfortable feeling from the moment you step inside. The staff are friendly and professional. The massage was completely relaxing, exactly what I needed. I will return if I have the chance.
reviewList.author: Đức Anh Nguyễn Ích

places.name: Balcona Hotel & Spa
places.address: 288 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Ngũ Hành Sơn
places.summary: Stylish rooms, most with balconies & views, in a striking hotel with 2 restaurants, 2 bars & a spa.

reviewList.text:
A BIG THANK YOU to Ma’am Shella, Supervisor of Balcona Hotel Da Nang, for the wonderful accommodation and the extra special surprise for my husband! ❤️🎂

We truly appreciate the effort you made to prepare a birthday cake and surprise for him. Since we couldn’t understand each other very well because of the language barrier, you personally took the initiative to join us, sing, and make the surprise even more special. Hahaha! Even I was so surprised and super happy! 🥰

It was such a wonderful experience celebrating my husband’s birthday at your hotel. We loved everything!

✨ Spacious rooms
✨ Clean and comfortable accommodation
✨ Very accommodating and friendly staff
✨ Delicious food, with Filipino food options too!

So, if you’re not yet used to Vietnamese cuisine, don’t worry because you can still enjoy Filipino dishes at the hotel. ❤️

Thank you so much, Ma’am Shella, and to the entire Balcona Hotel Da Nang team for making our stay extra memorable.

This is definitely not our last visit. We will surely come back with our family and friends on our next trip to Da Nang.

We will also highly recommend your hotel to our friends and family who are planning to visit Vietnam.

Great accommodation, excellent service, and unforgettable memories! ❤️

See you again, Balcona Hotel Da Nang! 🇻🇳🥰
reviewList.author: Wendell Bandala

reviewList.text: We spent 2 nights at the Balcona Spa Hotel. We got a room with a balcony seaview. I have to say the rooms were very spacious and the views we got were beautiful. No obstructions whatsoever. The access to the beach is the best part of this hotel. But I'm in my 50s and have stayed in a few hotels on Vietnam. This place really needs to upgrade it's decor and some of it's rules and policy. The breakfast halls I felt like I was eating in a retirement home instead of a fancy hotel. For 2 people we got 1 keycard for the room. The 1 keycard is used to power on/off the room and when u leave and take the keycard ur room has no power. Coming after a nice run on the beach and having to cool the room and yourself down will require some time we had to open the balcony door to let air in. Most hotels give us 2 keycard to fix this issue. The staff is very friendly and attentive to our concerns and accomodations. But the keycard issue was not in their control but instead the owners. Owners please allow for multiple keycards and really improve and update the decor of the hotel. You guys have the best view in town but also the oldest decor.
reviewList.author: Brandon Luong

reviewList.text:
I am writing this review with a rather heavy heart, as there were genuinely aspects of my stay at Hotel Balcona that I appreciated. The room was comfortable, and the staff were lovely, warm and pleasant throughout my interactions with them. Unfortunately, however, one recurring issue completely overshadowed what could otherwise have been an enjoyable stay.

The toilet in my room was repeatedly unable to flush properly. I contacted the front desk on four separate occasions, and each time I was assured that the issue had been rectified. Yet, a few hours later, the same problem would inevitably resurface.

After the second complaint, I was advised not to dispose of toilet paper in the toilet bowl, and I followed this instruction diligently. Despite my cooperation, the problem persisted.

What made this particularly frustrating was the sheer inconvenience it caused. This was supposed to be a holiday, a time to unwind and enjoy myself. Instead, I found myself spending upwards of 20 minutes repeatedly attempting to flush the toilet after each use. It was an unnecessarily unpleasant experience, and certainly not something one should have to contend with during a hotel stay.

By the fourth day, with another two nights remaining, I had simply had enough. Having raised the issue repeatedly, explained the inconvenience and given the hotel multiple opportunities to resolve it, I eventually decided to book another hotel down the road and cut my stay short. This meant incurring additional accommodation expenses, an entirely avoidable cost had the issue been properly addressed in the first place.

I want to be fair in acknowledging that the staff were lovely, and I have no particular grievances with their conduct. However, pleasant service alone cannot compensate for a fundamental failure in the facilities a hotel is expected to provide. What disappointed me most was not merely the recurring malfunction, but the repeated assurances that it had been fixed when, evidently, it had not.

It is genuinely disappointing that a stay which began on such a positive note ended this way. I gave Hotel Balcona ample opportunity to make things right, but unfortunately, the experience left me with little confidence in the hotel's ability to address even basic maintenance concerns.

I sincerely hope management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that future guests do not have to endure the same experience.
reviewList.author: Eca

reviewList.text:
Highly recommend this hotel ✅. Staff service is excellent; from arrival, they assist with luggage and open doors. Welcome drinks are also given during check-in. Even during checkout, they helped load bags into the Grab car we booked. Breakfast offers a broad buffet with new food each day. Rooms are cleaned daily, with fresh bottled water and towels provided. Prepare some cash, as they request a 500K VND deposit that is returned at checkout.  Hotel is near My Khe beach as well.

One area for improvement is adding a soap dish or rack in the shower. At times, hot water is not working, or perhaps the operation is unclear since no switch is inside; the light switch is also outside the bathroom so if someone switch it off everything gets off inside 😅 overall everything went well.

Thank you for this amazing hotel.
reviewList.author: Alo

reviewList.text: This place was great! A bit expensive but we also got a sea view room as that's all that was left! Room cleaning daily and the nicest staff. Being right across from the beach is great for sunrise swims. I wouldn't eat at their restaurant or use their laundry/spa as it's all extremely overpriced compared to surrounding businesses. Otherwise would definitely stay here again!!
reviewList.author: Serena Reynolds

reviewList.text: Loved my stay here. The staff are very friendly and helpful whenever I needed help or transport sorting out. Bedroom was very comfortable. The location was brilliant too, next to some good food places and shops. Also, easy to reach the beech from the hotel by walking. Highly recommend if traveling in the Da Nang area. As a solo traveller, had everything I needed for a fair price.
reviewList.author: Jakkie Sinner

reviewList.text: They always clean the room. Quiet part of An Hai for me. They are helpful, friendly and polite.
reviewList.author: Jomarie Kim (Jomarie)

reviewList.text:
very clean and decent room.
Good location for beach and city center
reviewList.author: Phil Nguyen

reviewList.text: The rooms were very clean and hygienic. The staff is very helpful. Da nang beach is just 7 min walking from the hotel and so is the market. The location is very quiet, convenient and peaceful. Had multiple options for breakfast. I would definitely recommend this place for a comfortable and peaceful stay!
reviewList.author: Simran Bhakhar

reviewList.text:
Sadly, I had a very disappointing experience here. Based on the photos and location, I felt comfortable making reservations and paying in advance. However, when I arrived, I quickly realized that the pics did not accurately reflect the current condition of the property. From the reception area, to the room itself, the space was old and worn. The carpet was dingy and the room smelled bad. Because of this, I was not comfortable staying here, despite the fact that it was very late at night. I shared my concerns and politely requested a refund, which they refused.

As a frequent traveler, I do not take pleasure in providing negative reviews. However, the property is misrepresented in its photos.

Its also important to note that while there is an elevator in the building, there are a lot of stairs you need to walk up to get to the entrance. There is someone to help with luggage, but this is not suitable for elders or people with limited mobility. 🙏🏽
reviewList.author: Thulani DeMarsay

reviewList.text: These ladies deserve a lot of praise. We are in Vietnam for three weeks now and this was the best massage we had! Our family of four (mom, dad, 13 year old girl and 7 year old girl) had footmassages and hair massage for the girls. They were so sweet! The massages were exeptional! Dont go for the obvious but go for Windy Spa!
reviewList.author: Erica Veen

reviewList.text: We had ear cleaning at the SPA they cleaned it very thoroughly. Highly recommend this service.
reviewList.author: Misinam Mize

reviewList.text: Good massage, good service. Relaxation, and professionally. I definitely come back
reviewList.author: Og Su

reviewList.text: Wanted to get a last minute massage before hoping on our flight back home and my husband wanted to try out the ear cleaning services. It was very well priced compared to the other places we had received massages from. The ladies were very nice and inviting. They sat us down, laid us back and put warm eye masks over our eyes while we waited for them to prepare and bring over the foot baths. Once we completed our foot baths we were able to still lie down while receiving our foot massages. This was really relaxing and the only place to have us do this during the massage. Towards the end of the massage they started doing assisted leg stretching which we hadn’t experienced before and was a good experience. They do take credit card which was a plus because we didn’t have much VND left on us since we were about to leave. Would recommend.

places.name: Khách sạn Eden Plaza Đà Nẵng
places.summary: Refined quarters in an upmarket hotel offering a restaurant, karaoke facilities & an outdoor pool.

reviewList.text:
Horrible service and hotel.

Booked the hotel 31st August - 5th September for 5 nights, checked in and everything was moldy, shower with no heater

Next morning on 1 September, I went to the receptionist to ask if a refund was possible, she said she would have to check

I returned in the evening on the same day and the receptionist told me we could get a refund for our remaining 3 nights and we could check out tmr morning if we wanted to and the refund would automatically be refunded through Agoda

We checked out that same night on 1st September and booked a different hotel

Few days later I checked my account and there was no refund given, so I contacted Agodas Customer service about it and went on with my day

A few days later I checked my account, still no refund given, went back to Agoda to see a message that gave me 8 hours to reply and confirm my refund of the remaining 3 nights, since i did not reply in that 8 hours, they considered my refund voided

Horrible ethics from the management, going back on a verbal promise made

reviewList.text: Facilities a bit dated. Had to get the safe fixed but they did it quick. Shower was backed. They tried to fix it but it persisted. Other than that, the place is ok for its value. Awesome breakfast buffet though so that makes up for it shortcomings.
reviewList.author: Eric A

reviewList.text:
It's a 4-star hotel strategically located in central Da Nang. Room rates are very reasonable and include complimentary breakfast. Amenities include a swimming pool, gym, spa, and restaurant. The hotel also offers free Wi-Fi, although the connection can be slow and spotty at times.
The breakfast buffet features a wide variety of dishes. It's always nice to start the day with a hearty meal and a hot cup of coffee.
Overall, Eden Plaza Da Nang is a good choice for travelers seeking a comfortable place to rest and enjoy a hot shower after a day of touring around the city.
reviewList.author: N8s Obregon

reviewList.text:
This is a very nice hotel. Upon arrival it is very gorgeous however is located in busy road.

The staff checked us in early and welcomed us to our room. The breakfast was good (not great) and we enjoyed it every day. We were here about a week and became familiar with most staff. The staff as a whole has a 50/50 chance of being friendly. The pool area is AMAZING with a lush garden surrounding it- was genuinely peaceful (as long as MY children weren’t being loud 🤦‍♀️) The gym area overlooks the pool/garden and seemed very up to date.

There is a walking street between the buildings. Very beautiful!

However- there is only one place to eat near by without having to cross a major highway. With little children this was not ideal. We ordered a lot of Grab.

8/10 would return
reviewList.author: Hollie Gustafson

reviewList.text:
Multiple visits

Of these types of establishments, this was the best I found in my short trip to Da Nang, this was by far the best...

I have been to many of these types of "massage" parlors and it was ok.  Are there better in Da Nang?  Maybe.  Are there leasers?  Definitely.

Secret to success....  Tip the elevator man on your way up and tell him what you want in 3 words or less.

Overall I had a great time here.

reviewList.text: This has easily become one of my favorite places in Da Nang. I ve already been here twice during my trip and enjoyed it every time. Great service, relaxing atmosphere, and friendly staff. I ll be back again before I leave!

reviewList.text: It's a very professional massage parlor. Whenever I'm in Da Nang on a business trip, I always come here for a massage.
reviewList.author: Chiang Paul

reviewList.text: SCAMMERS!! I Got scammed here today. The reviews are fake, stay away especially if you’re a westerner. They brought me a masseuse who instantly complained that I’m “too big” and she will not offer anything apart from “hand relief”. I asked for a change of waiters and they brought me another one with a worse attitude than the former. She also said no way she would do anything other than “hand relief”, using the excuse that I’m too big and a “westerner”. This was clearly an excuse and not reality, I would’ve appreciated the compliment if it was real. I settled for whatever she said she would offer and 5 minutes into the session she started barking at me in Vietnamese in a very loud voice for absolutely no reason. I was genuinely shocked and speechless, I had no idea what went wrong as I didn’t even move or open my mouth; the girl was clearly frustrated and had bruises on her chest; her eyes also looked swollen. I became very uncomfortable, ended the session instantly, and walked out. I got a bad sense of trafficking happening at this place, didn’t even bother to ask for my money back because I realized after the first masseuse interaction that I had just gotten scammed. The place is sketchy and I felt unsafe; you have been warned.
reviewList.author: Peter Haywood

reviewList.text: Worst service ever!!! Now I believe why the rating is low. The therapist is rushing to end the service, make me so uncomfortable, especially with her ANNOYED face, like she paid me for service. The package is an hour, but she is trying her best to end it in 30 minutes. Will never come back again.
